```cpp
        if (line.rfind("total=", 0) == 0) total = atoi(line.c_str() + 6);
        else if (line.rfind("a=", 0) == 0) { auto t = Tabs(line.substr(2)); if (t.size() >= 4) out.push_back({ t[0], t[1], t[2], (float)atof(t[3].c_str()) }); }
    }
    return true;
}

void EdClearFiles() {
    for (auto f : { L"\\editor_state.txt", L"\\props.txt", L"\\actors.txt", L"\\cam.txt", L"\\models.txt", L"\\npcs.txt" }) DeleteFileW((BridgeDir() + f).c_str());
}

bool BridgeResult(int id, bool& ok, std::string& msg) {
    std::string d;
    if (!ReadAll(BridgeDir() + L"\\result.txt", d) || d.empty()) return false;
    size_t a = d.find('|'); if (a == std::string::npos) return false;
    if (atoi(d.substr(0, a).c_str()) != id) return false;
    size_t b = d.find('|', a + 1);
    ok = d.substr(a + 1, b == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : b - a - 1) == "ok";
    msg = b == std::string::npos ? "" : d.substr(b + 1);
    while (!msg.empty() && (msg.back() == '\n' || msg.back() == '\r')) msg.pop_back();
    return true;
}

static std::wstring CacheFile() {
    std::wstring g = GameDisplayName();
    if (g.empty()) return L"";
    for (auto& c : g) if (wcschr(L"\\/:*?\"<>|", c)) c = L'_';
    return CacheDir() + L"\\" + g + L".txt";
}

// After a successful scan, keep a copy for this game so the list shows even when it isn't running.
void BridgeCacheLevels() {
    std::wstring cf = CacheFile();
    if (cf.empty()) return;
    std::string d;
    if (!ReadAll(BridgeDir() + L"\\levels.txt", d)) return;
    MakeDirs(CacheDir());
    // games that can only report the levels loaded right now: keep the ones seen before too (and any added by hand)
    std::string old;
    if (d.find("#method loaded worlds") != std::string::npos && ReadAll(cf, old)) {
        std::string add;
        std::istringstream ss(old); std::string line;
        while (std::getline(ss, line)) {
            if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
            if (line.empty() || line[0] == '#') continue;
            bool have = false;
            std::istringstream ns(d); std::string l2;
            while (!have && std::getline(ns, l2)) { if (!l2.empty() && l2.back() == '\r') l2.pop_back(); have = _stricmp(l2.c_str(), line.c_str()) == 0; }
            if (!have) add += line + "\n";
        }
        if (!d.empty() && d.back() != '\n') d += "\n";
        d += add;
    }
    WriteAtomic(cf, d);
}

static void ParseLevels(const std::string& data, std::vector<LevelEntry>& out, std::string& method) {
    std::istringstream ss(data);
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(ss, line)) {
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        if (line.empty()) continue;
        if (line[0] == '#') { if (line.rfind("#method ", 0) == 0) method = line.substr(8); continue; }
        AddEntry(out, line);
    }
}

// Loose .umap files (only for games that ship unpacked content)
static void ScanUmaps(const std::wstring& dir, const std::wstring& prefix, std::vector<LevelEntry>& out, int depth = 0) {
    if (depth > 12 || out.size() > 5000) return;
    WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd; HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW((dir + L"\\*").c_str(), &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    do {
        if (fd.cFileName[0] == L'.') continue;
        std::wstring n = fd.cFileName;
        if (fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) { if (Lower(n) != L"paks") ScanUmaps(dir + L"\\" + n, prefix + L"/" + n, out, depth + 1); }
        else if (ExtOf(n) == L".umap") {
            AddEntry(out, W2U(prefix) + "/" + W2U(StemOf(n)));
        }
    } while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
}

// ================================================================ .pak index reader
// Lists *.umap files straight from the game's .pak files (no injection, nothing runs in the game).
// Supports pak versions 3-11 with an unencrypted index; UE5 IoStore-only games fall back to the in-game scan.
struct PakFile {
    HANDLE h = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    ~PakFile() { if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(h); }
    bool Read(long long off, void* buf, DWORD n) {
        LARGE_INTEGER li; li.QuadPart = off;
        if (!SetFilePointerEx(h, li, nullptr, FILE_BEGIN)) return false;
        DWORD rd = 0; return ReadFile(h, buf, n, &rd, nullptr) && rd == n;
    }
};
struct Buf {
    const std::string& b; size_t o = 0; bool bad = false;
    explicit Buf(const std::string& s) : b(s) {}
    template <class T> T get() { T v{}; if (o + sizeof(T) > b.size()) { bad = true; return v; } memcpy(&v, b.data() + o, sizeof(T)); o += sizeof(T); return v; }
    void skip(size_t n) { if (o + n > b.size()) bad = true; else o += n; }
    std::string str() {
        int n = get<int>(); if (bad) return "";
        if (n == 0) return "";
        if (n > 0) { if (n > 4096 || o + n > b.size()) { bad = true; return ""; } std::string r(b.data() + o, n - 1); o += n; return r; }
        n = -n; if (n > 4096 || o + 2ull * n > b.size()) { bad = true; return ""; }
        std::wstring w((const wchar_t*)(b.data() + o), n - 1); o += 2ull * n; return W2U(w);
    }
};

// "../../../Hk_project/Content/Map/X.umap" -> "/Game/Map/X"
static std::string ToPackagePath(std::string full) {
    while (full.rfind("../", 0) == 0) full = full.substr(3);
    size_t dot = full.find_last_of('.'), sl = full.find_last_of('/');
    if (dot == std::string::npos || (sl != std::string::npos && dot < sl)) return "";
    full = full.substr(0, dot);
    if (full.rfind("Engine/Content/", 0) == 0) return "/Engine/" + full.substr(15);
    size_t pl = full.find("/Plugins/");
    if (pl != std::string::npos) {           // .../Plugins/[...]/<Name>/Content/...
        size_t c = full.find("/Content/", pl);
        if (c == std::string::npos) return "";
        size_t ns = full.rfind('/', c - 1);
        return "/" + full.substr(ns + 1, c - ns - 1) + "/" + full.substr(c + 9);
    }
    size_t c = full.find("/Content/");
    if (c == std::string::npos) return "";
    return "/Game/" + full.substr(c + 9);
}

typedef bool (*PakFilter)(const std::string& fileName);
static bool IsUmap(const std::string& fn) { return fn.size() > 5 && _stricmp(fn.c_str() + fn.size() - 5, ".umap") == 0; }
static bool ReadPakFiles(const std::wstring& path, PakFilter keep, std::vector<std::string>& maps, std::string& note) {
    PakFile f;
    f.h = CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_RANDOM_ACCESS, nullptr);
    if (f.h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;
    LARGE_INTEGER sz; GetFileSizeEx(f.h, &sz);
    if (sz.QuadPart < 64) return false;
    // footer: find magic in the last 512 bytes
    long long tailOff = std::max(0LL, sz.QuadPart - 512);
    std::string tail((size_t)(sz.QuadPart - tailOff), '\0');
    if (!f.Read(tailOff, &tail[0], (DWORD)tail.size())) return false;
    const uint32_t magic = 0x5A6F12E1;
    long long m = -1;
    for (long long i = (long long)tail.size() - 4; i >= 0; i--) if (memcmp(tail.data() + i, &magic, 4) == 0) {
        // magic must be followed by version, index offset/size that fit in the file
        if (i + 24 > (long long)tail.size()) continue;
        uint32_t v; long long io, is; memcpy(&v, tail.data() + i + 4, 4); memcpy(&io, tail.data() + i + 8, 8); memcpy(&is, tail.data() + i + 16, 8);
        if (v >= 1 && v <= 20 && io > 0 && is > 0 && io + is <= sz.QuadPart) { m = i; break; }
    }
    if (m < 0) { note = "unrecognised pak format"; return false; }
    uint32_t ver; long long idxOff, idxSize;
    memcpy(&ver, tail.data() + m + 4, 4); memcpy(&idxOff, tail.data() + m + 8, 8); memcpy(&idxSize, tail.data() + m + 16, 8);
    bool encIndex = ver >= 4 && m >= 1 && tail[(size_t)m - 1] != 0;
    if (encIndex) { note = "index is encrypted"; return false; }
    if (idxSize > 256ll * 1024 * 1024) return false;
    std::string idx((size_t)idxSize, '\0');
    if (!f.Read(idxOff, &idx[0], (DWORD)idxSize)) return false;
    Buf b(idx);
    std::string mount = b.str();
    int num = b.get<int>();
    if (b.bad || num < 0) return false;

    auto add = [&](const std::string& full) { std::string pp = ToPackagePath(full); if (!pp.empty()) maps.push_back(pp); };
    if (ver >= 10) {
        b.get<unsigned long long>();                       // path hash seed
        if (b.get<uint32_t>()) b.skip(8 + 8 + 20);         // path hash index
        if (!b.get<uint32_t>()) { note = "pak has no directory index"; return false; }
        long long fdOff = b.get<long long>(), fdSize = b.get<long long>();
        if (b.bad || fdOff <= 0 || fdSize <= 0 || fdOff + fdSize > sz.QuadPart || fdSize > 512ll * 1024 * 1024) return false;
        std::string fd((size_t)fdSize, '\0');
        if (!f.Read(fdOff, &fd[0], (DWORD)fdSize)) return false;
        Buf d(fd);
        int dirs = d.get<int>();
        for (int i = 0; i < dirs && !d.bad; i++) {
            std::string dir = d.str();
            int files = d.get<int>();
            for (int j = 0; j < files && !d.bad; j++) {
                std::string fn = d.str(); d.get<int>();
                if (keep(fn)) add(mount + dir + fn);
            }
        }
        return !d.bad;
    }
    // v3-v9: filename followed by a serialized FPakEntry
    for (int i = 0; i < num && !b.bad; i++) {
        std::string fn = b.str();
        b.skip(8 + 8 + 8);                                 // offset, size, uncompressed size
        uint32_t comp = b.get<uint32_t>();                 // compression method (index in v8+)
        if (ver == 1) b.skip(8);                           // timestamp
        b.skip(20);                                        // SHA1
        if (ver >= 3) {
            if (comp != 0) { int blocks = b.get<int>(); if (blocks < 0 || blocks > 1000000) { b.bad = true; break; } b.skip(16ull * blocks); }
            b.skip(1 + 4);                                 // flags, compression block size
        }
        if (keep(fn.substr(fn.find_last_of('/') + 1))) add(mount + fn);
    }
    return !b.bad;
}

// All levels found in the game's .pak files (cached per pak set until the files change)
static std::vector<std::string> PakLevels(std::string& note) {
    static std::wstring cachedKey; static std::vector<std::string> cached; static std::string cachedNote;
    std::wstring paks = PaksDir();
    std::vector<std::string> maps;
    if (paks.empty()) return maps;
    std::vector<std::wstring> files;
    std::wstring key = paks;
    auto collect = [&](const std::wstring& dir) {
        WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd; HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW((dir + L"\\*.pak").c_str(), &fd);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
        do {
            files.push_back(dir + L"\\" + fd.cFileName);
            key += L"|" + std::wstring(fd.cFileName) + L":" + std::to_wstring(fd.nFileSizeLow) + L":" + std::to_wstring(fd.ftLastWriteTime.dwLowDateTime);
        } while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    };
    collect(paks); collect(paks + L"\\~mods"); collect(paks + L"\\LogicMods");
    if (key == cachedKey) { note = cachedNote; return cached; }
    int okCount = 0, enc = 0;
    for (auto& f : files) {
        std::string n;
        if (ReadPakFiles(f, IsUmap, maps, n)) okCount++;
        else if (n == "index is encrypted") enc++;
    }
    std::sort(maps.begin(), maps.end());
    maps.erase(std::unique(maps.begin(), maps.end()), maps.end());
    note = enc && maps.empty() ? "the game's files are encrypted" : "";
    cachedKey = key; cached = maps; cachedNote = note;
    return maps;
}

// Model-looking assets in the game's .pak files. A .pak only lists file names (not what each asset is),
// so this goes by the usual naming: SM_ prefix, or a mesh/prop/model folder, minus obvious non-models.
static bool IsModelName(const std::string& fn) {
    if (fn.size() < 8 || _stricmp(fn.c_str() + fn.size() - 7, ".uasset") != 0) return false;
    std::string u; for (char c : fn.substr(0, fn.size() - 7)) u += (char)toupper((unsigned char)c);
    if (u.rfind("SM_", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("S_", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("MESH_", 0) == 0) return true;
    static const char* notPre[] = { "M_", "MI_", "MF_", "MM_", "T_", "TX_", "BP_", "ABP_", "SK_", "SKM_", "SKEL_", "PHYS_", "PA_", "AM_", "AS_", "BS_",
        "PS_", "P_", "NS_", "FX_", "VFX_", "SFX_", "SC_", "SW_", "A_", "W_", "WBP_", "UI_", "DA_", "DT_", "CT_", "CV_", "E_", "F_", "ST_", "MPC_", "RT_",
        "LUT_", "TEX_", "MAT_", "ANIM_", "SEQ_", "LS_", "SND_", "COL_", "UCX_", "UBX_", "USP_", "ATLAS" };
    for (auto x : notPre) if (u.rfind(x, 0) == 0) return false;
    static const char* notSuf[] = { "_PHYSICSASSET", "_SKELETON", "_BUILTDATA", "_MAT", "_MATERIAL", "_TEX", "_ANIM", "_BP", "_CUE",
        "_D", "_N", "_NRM", "_NORMAL", "_BC", "_BASECOLOR", "_ALBEDO", "_ORM", "_MRA", "_RMA", "_R", "_M", "_AO", "_E", "_MASK", "_MASKS", "_H", "_HEIGHT",
        "_DIFFUSE", "_EMISSIVE", "_ROUGHNESS", "_METALLIC", "_SPEC", "_A", "_S", "_O", "_ALPHA", "_OPACITY", "_MI", "_INST", "_INSTANCE",
        "_COLOR", "_PHYSICS", "_CUSTOMCOLLISION", "_COLLISION", "_ATLAS", "_LUT", "_CURVE" };
    for (auto x : notSuf) { size_t l = strlen(x); if (u.size() > l && u.compare(u.size() - l, l, x) == 0) return false; }
    // texture-size endings like _2K or _512X512
    size_t us = u.find_last_of('_');
    if (us != std::string::npos && us + 1 < u.size()) {
        std::string t = u.substr(us + 1);
        bool digitsK = t.size() >= 2 && t.back() == 'K' && t.find_first_not_of("0123456789") == t.size() - 1;
        size_t x = t.find('X');
        bool dims = x != std::string::npos && x > 0 && x + 1 < t.size() && t.find_first_not_of("0123456789X") == std::string::npos;
        if (digitsK || dims) return false;
    }
    return true;   // the folder decides (below)
}
static bool LooksLikeModelPath(const std::string& pp) {
    std::string name = pp.substr(pp.find_last_of('/') + 1), u;
    for (char c : name) u += (char)toupper((unsigned char)c);
    if (u.rfind("SM_", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("S_", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("MESH_", 0) == 0) return true;
    std::string l; for (char c : pp) l += (char)tolower((unsigned char)c);
    for (auto x : { "/sound/", "/audio/", "/animation/", "/anims", "/textures/", "/texture/", "/materials/", "/material/", "/gui/", "/ui/", "/dialogue/",
                    "/fx/", "/vfx/", "/particles/", "/blueprints/", "/sequences/", "/cinematics/", "/maps/", "/map/", "/decal", "/font", "/localization",
                    "/movies", "/collisions/", "/collision/", "/poster" })
        if (l.find(x) != std::string::npos) return false;
    for (auto x : { "/mesh", "/meshes/", "/staticmesh", "/props/", "/prop/", "/props_", "/models/", "/model/", "/geometry/", "/geo/", "/archi/",
                    "/architecture/", "/vegetation/", "/foliage/", "/vehicle", "/background/", "/building", "/furniture/", "/environment/", "/env/", "/pipe" })
        if (l.find(x) != std::string::npos) return true;
    return false;
}
std::vector<std::string> PakModels(std::string& note) {
    static std::wstring cachedKey; static std::vector<std::string> cached; static std::string cachedNote;
    std::wstring paks = PaksDir();
    std::vector<std::string> all;
    if (paks.empty()) { note = "no game selected"; return all; }
    std::vector<std::wstring> files; std::wstring key = paks;
    auto collect = [&](const std::wstring& dir) {
        WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd; HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW((dir + L"\\*.pak").c_str(), &fd);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
        do { files.push_back(dir + L"\\" + fd.cFileName); key += L"|" + std::wstring(fd.cFileName) + L":" + std::to_wstring(fd.nFileSizeLow); } while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    };
    collect(paks); collect(paks + L"\\~mods"); collect(paks + L"\\LogicMods");
    if (key == cachedKey) { note = cachedNote; return cached; }
    int enc = 0;
    for (auto& f : files) { std::string n; if (!ReadPakFiles(f, IsModelName, all, n) && n == "index is encrypted") enc++; }
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    for (auto& p : all) if (LooksLikeModelPath(p)) out.push_back(p);
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
    note = out.empty() ? (enc ? "the game's files are encrypted" : files.empty() ? "no .pak files found" : "no model files recognised by name") : "";
    cachedKey = key; cached = out; cachedNote = note;
    return out;
}

// Developer / debug / cheat menus left in the game's files (widgets, going by their names)
static bool IsDevMenuName(const std::string& fn) {
    if (fn.size() < 8 || _stricmp(fn.c_str() + fn.size() - 7, ".uasset") != 0) return false;
    std::string u; for (char c : fn.substr(0, fn.size() - 7)) u += (char)toupper((unsigned char)c);
    bool widget = false;
    for (auto pre : { "W_", "WBP_", "WB_", "UI_", "UMG_", "WD_", "BPW_", "HUD_" }) if (u.rfind(pre, 0) == 0) widget = true;
    for (auto x : { "WIDGET", "MENU", "PANEL", "HUD" }) if (u.find(x) != std::string::npos) widget = true;
    if (!widget) return false;
    for (auto x : { "DEBUG", "CHEAT", "DEVMENU", "DEV_MENU", "DEVELOPER", "DEVTOOL", "DEV_TOOL", "DEVPANEL", "DEV_PANEL", "ADMIN", "GODMODE", "TESTMENU", "TEST_MENU", "QAMENU", "QA_MENU" })
        if (u.find(x) != std::string::npos) return true;
    return u.rfind("W_DEV", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("WBP_DEV", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("UI_DEV", 0) == 0;
}
// Cheat manager blueprints left in the game's files (BP_CheatManager, B_MyGameCheats...)
static bool IsCheatManagerName(const std::string& fn) {
    if (fn.size() < 8 || _stricmp(fn.c_str() + fn.size() - 7, ".uasset") != 0) return false;
    std::string u; for (char c : fn.substr(0, fn.size() - 7)) u += (char)toupper((unsigned char)c);
    if (u.find("CHEATMANAGER") != std::string::npos || u.find("CHEAT_MANAGER") != std::string::npos) return true;
    bool bp = u.rfind("BP_", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("B_", 0) == 0;
    return bp && (u.find("CHEATS") != std::string::npos || u.find("DEBUGMANAGER") != std::string::npos);
}
std::vector<std::string> PakDevMenus(std::string& note, std::vector<std::string>* cheatMgrs) {
    std::wstring paks = PaksDir();
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    if (paks.empty()) { note = "no game selected"; return out; }
    // all the game's files, packed or IoStore (with the game's key when it has one)
    std::vector<std::string> all; std::string n2;
    if (ModelListGameFiles(paks, [](const std::string& fn) { return IsDevMenuName(fn) || IsCheatManagerName(fn); }, all, n2)) {
        // pieces of a menu (its buttons, toggles, rows...) aren't menus of their own: leave them out
        auto piece = [](const std::string& k) {
            std::string u; for (char c : k) u += (char)toupper((unsigned char)c);
            if (u.find("/WIDGETS/") != std::string::npos || u.find("/COMPONENTS/") != std::string::npos) return true;
            std::string n = u.substr(u.find_last_of('/') + 1);
            for (auto x : { "BUTTON", "TOGGLE", "ENTRY", "LABEL", "_ITEM", "ITEMCATEGORY", "STATUS", "BACK.", "GREY", "_ROW", "ROW.", "SLOT", "ICON", "CHECKBOX", "SLIDER", "TOOLTIP", "_TAB", "LISTITEM", "HEADER" })
                if (n.find(x) != std::string::npos) return true;
            return false;
        };
        for (auto& k : all) {
            std::string fn = k.substr(k.find_last_of('/') + 1);
            if (IsDevMenuName(fn) && !piece(k)) out.push_back(k);
            if (cheatMgrs && IsCheatManagerName(fn)) cheatMgrs->push_back(k);
        }
        auto rank = [](const std::string& k) {
            std::string n = k.substr(k.find_last_of('/') + 1);
            if (n.find("debugmainmenu") != std::string::npos || n.rfind("debugmenu.", 0) == 0 || n.find("devmenu.") != std::string::npos || n.find("cheatmenu.") != std::string::npos) return 0;
            return 1;
        };
        std::stable_sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [&](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) { return rank(a) < rank(b); });
        note = out.empty() ? (n2.empty() ? "no developer menus found in the game's files" : n2) : "";
        return out;
    }
    std::vector<std::wstring> files;
    auto collect = [&](const std::wstring& dir) {
        WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd; HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW((dir + L"\\*.pak").c_str(), &fd);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
        do files.push_back(dir + L"\\" + fd.cFileName); while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    };
    collect(paks); collect(paks + L"\\~mods"); collect(paks + L"\\LogicMods");
    int enc = 0;
    for (auto& f : files) { std::string n; if (!ReadPakFiles(f, IsDevMenuName, out, n) && n == "index is encrypted") enc++; }
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
    note = out.empty() ? (enc ? "the game's files are encrypted, so its menus can't be listed" : "no developer menus found in the game's files") : "";
    return out;
}

// Character blueprints in the game's files, going by the usual naming (BP_ + a character-ish folder or name)
static bool IsBlueprintName(const std::string& fn) {
    if (fn.size() < 8 || _stricmp(fn.c_str() + fn.size() - 7, ".uasset") != 0) return false;
    std::string u; for (char c : fn) u += (char)toupper((unsigned char)c);
    return u.rfind("BP_", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("B_", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("CH_", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("CHR_", 0) == 0 || u.rfind("NPC_", 0) == 0;
}
std::vector<std::string> PakCharacters(std::string& note) {
    std::wstring paks = PaksDir();
    std::vector<std::string> all, out;
    if (paks.empty()) { note = "no game selected"; return out; }
    std::vector<std::wstring> files;
    auto collect = [&](const std::wstring& dir) {
        WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd; HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW((dir + L"\\*.pak").c_str(), &fd);
        if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
        do files.push_back(dir + L"\\" + fd.cFileName); while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    };
    collect(paks); collect(paks + L"\\~mods"); collect(paks + L"\\LogicMods");
    int enc = 0;
    for (auto& f : files) { std::string n; if (!ReadPakFiles(f, IsBlueprintName, all, n) && n == "index is encrypted") enc++; }
    for (auto& p : all) {
        std::string l; for (char c : p) l += (char)tolower((unsigned char)c);
        std::string name = l.substr(l.find_last_of('/') + 1);
        bool folder = false, named = false, bad = false;
        for (auto x : { "/character", "/characters/", "/npc", "/npcs/", "/enemies/", "/enemy/", "/creatures/", "/creature/", "/animals/", "/animal/", "/pawns/", "/pawn/", "/ai/", "/mobs/", "/monsters/", "/humans/", "/robots/" })
            if (l.find(x) != std::string::npos) folder = true;
        for (auto x : { "character", "npc", "enemy", "creature", "animal", "pawn", "player", "human", "robot", "monster", "zombie", "soldier", "guard", "boss", "mob" })
            if (name.find(x) != std::string::npos) named = true;
        for (auto x : { "anim", "abp_", "controller", "_ai", "aic_", "bt_", "bb_", "task", "service", "decorator", "eqs", "spawner", "spawnpoint", "manager", "component",
                        "widget", "gamemode", "gamestate", "playerstate", "camera", "cheat", "save", "interface", "_enum", "struct", "_dt", "datatable", "notify", "projectile",
                        "weapon", "pickup", "trigger", "volume", "sound", "_fx", "effect", "damage", "ability", "_ge_", "_ga_", "hud", "input", "settings", "_lib", "library", "macro" })
            if (name.find(x) != std::string::npos) bad = true;
        if ((folder || named) && !bad) out.push_back(p.substr(0, p.size() - 7));   // package path without .uasset
    }
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
    note = out.empty() ? (enc ? "the game's files are encrypted" : "no character blueprints recognised in the game's files") : "";
    return out;
}

bool ReadEdSwap(std::vector<EdSwapModel>& out, int& total) {
    static ULONGLONG stamp = 0;
    std::wstring p = BridgeDir() + L"\\swaplist.txt";
    if (!Changed(p, stamp)) return false;
    std::string d; if (!ReadAll(p, d)) return false;
    out.clear(); total = 0;
    std::istringstream ss(d); std::string line;
    while (std::getline(ss, line)) {
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        if (line.rfind("total=", 0) == 0) total = atoi(line.c_str() + 6);
        else if (line.rfind("s=", 0) == 0) { auto t = Tabs(line.substr(2)); if (t.size() >= 3) out.push_back({ t[0], t[1], t[2], t.size() > 3 ? atoi(t[3].c_str()) : 0 }); }
    }
    return true;
}

bool ReadEdCheats(EdCheats& out) {
    static ULONGLONG stamp = 0;
    std::wstring p = BridgeDir() + L"\\cheats.txt";
    if (!Changed(p, stamp)) return false;
    std::string d; if (!ReadAll(p, d)) return false;
    EdCheats c; c.scanned = true;
    std::istringstream ss(d); std::string line;
    while (std::getline(ss, line)) {
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        if (line == "cheatmanager=1") c.cheatMgr = true;
        else if (line == "console=1") c.console = true;
        else if (line.rfind("consolekeys=", 0) == 0) c.consoleKeys = line.substr(12);
        else if (line.rfind("view=", 0) == 0) c.view = line.substr(5);
        else if (line == "fog=0") c.fog = false;
        else if (line.rfind("cheat=", 0) == 0) { auto t = Tabs(line.substr(6)); if (!t.empty()) c.cheats.push_back({ t[0], t.size() > 1 ? t[1] : "", t.size() > 2 ? t[2] : "" }); }
        else if (line.rfind("menu=", 0) == 0) { auto t = Tabs(line.substr(5)); if (t.size() >= 2) c.menus.push_back({ t[0], t[1], t.size() > 2 && t[2] == "1" }); }
        else if (line.rfind("cheatclass=", 0) == 0) { auto t = Tabs(line.substr(11)); if (t.size() >= 2) c.cheatClasses.push_back({ t[0], t[1], t.size() > 2 && t[2] == "1" }); }
        else if (line.rfind("cheatcurrent=", 0) == 0) c.cheatCurrent = line.substr(13);
    }
    out = std::move(c);
    return true;
}

bool ReadEdModels(std::vector<EdModel>& out, int& total) {
    static ULONGLONG stamp = 0;
    std::wstring p = BridgeDir() + L"\\models.txt";
    if (!Changed(p, stamp)) return false;
    std::string d; if (!ReadAll(p, d)) return false;
    out.clear(); total = 0;
    std::istringstream ss(d); std::string line;
    while (std::getline(ss, line)) {
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        if (line.rfind("total=", 0) == 0) total = atoi(line.c_str() + 6);
        else if (line.rfind("m=", 0) == 0) { auto t = Tabs(line.substr(2)); if (t.size() >= 2) out.push_back({ t[0], t[1] }); }
    }
    return true;
}

// Big games split one playable level into many streamed pieces (lighting, sound, layout...).
// Those pieces can't be opened on their own, so we recognise them by their usual name endings.
bool LooksLikeSubLevel(const std::string& path) {
    std::string n = path.substr(path.find_last_of('/') + 1), u;
    for (char c : n) u += (char)toupper((unsigned char)c);
    static const char* suf[] = { "_LD", "_GD", "_GRAPH", "_SOUND", "_SND", "_AUDIO", "_ZONE", "_LIGHTS", "_LIGHT", "_LIGHTING",
        "_COL", "_COLLISION", "_BKGD", "_BG", "_BACKGROUND", "_FEEDBACK", "_POST", "_POSTPROCESS", "_FORBAKINGONLY", "_TRANS",
        "_FX", "_VFX", "_ART", "_GEO", "_GEOMETRY", "_ENV", "_GAMEPLAY", "_GP", "_SCRIPT", "_SCRIPTING", "_BLOCKOUT", "_DECO",
        "_PROPS", "_NAV", "_NAVMESH", "_FOLIAGE", "_LANDSCAPE", "_DESIGN", "_LOGIC", "_STREAMING", "_SUB", "_SUBLEVEL", "_BUILTDATA",
        "_ARTTEMP", "_ART_STATELESS", "_ART_STATEFUL", "_ARTSTATELESS", "_ARTSTATEFUL", "_STATELESS", "_STATEFUL", "_SHARED",
        "_TECHART", "_VISTA", "_VISTAS", "_SE", "_VFX_SE", "_SCRIPTEDEVENTS", "_SCRIPTEDEVENT", "_QAPERF", "_ANIMALS", "_RAIN-ASSETS",
        "_ALSHARED", "_PREHOOKS", "_LIGHTS_DEFAULT", "_PERFVOLUMES", "_PERFVOLUMES_TEMP", "_AUDIO", "_SFX", "_MUSIC", "_CINEMATICS", "_CINE" };
    for (auto x : suf) { size_t l = strlen(x); if (u.size() > l && u.compare(u.size() - l, l, x) == 0) return true; }
    // lighting / art / design pieces with a number or tag after them (ZA_GLOBAL_LIGHTING_02, ZoneC_01_LightingTEMP_ART1, ZA_01_New_Design)
    for (auto x : { "LIGHTING", "_ART_", "_ARTSTATE", "_ARTTEMP", "_DESIGN", "_VFX_", "_SCRIPTEDEVENT", "_QAPERF" }) if (u.find(x) != std::string::npos) return true;
    for (auto pre : { "BACKGROUND_", "BG_", "SUB_", "SL_" }) if (u.rfind(pre, 0) == 0) return true;
    return false;
}

static void AddEntry(std::vector<LevelEntry>& out, const std::string& path) {
    LevelEntry e; e.path = path;
    size_t s = path.find_last_of('/');
    e.name = s == std::string::npos ? path : path.substr(s + 1);
    e.folder = s == std::string::npos ? "" : path.substr(0, s);
    e.sub = LooksLikeSubLevel(path);
    out.push_back(e);
}

std::string NormalizeLevelPath(std::string in) {
    // trim spaces and quotes, unify slashes
    while (!in.empty() && strchr(" \t\r\n\"'", in.back())) in.pop_back();
    size_t a = 0; while (a < in.size() && strchr(" \t\"'", in[a])) a++;
    in = in.substr(a);
    for (auto& c : in) if (c == '\\') c = '/';
    if (in.empty()) return in;
    auto endsI = [](const std::string& s, const char* x) { size_t l = strlen(x); return s.size() >= l && _stricmp(s.c_str() + s.size() - l, x) == 0; };
    // file path form: ../../../Proj/Content/Map/X.umap, Proj/Content/..., C:/Games/.../Content/...
    if (in.find("/Content/") != std::string::npos || in.rfind("Content/", 0) == 0) {
        std::string f = in.rfind("Content/", 0) == 0 ? "Game/" + in : in;
        if (!endsI(f, ".umap")) f += ".umap";
        std::string p = ToPackagePath(f);
        if (!p.empty()) return p;
    }
    if (endsI(in, ".umap")) in = in.substr(0, in.size() - 5);
    if (in[0] == '/') {
        size_t dot = in.find('.', in.find_last_of('/'));   // /Game/Maps/X.X -> /Game/Maps/X
        if (dot != std::string::npos) in = in.substr(0, dot);
    }
    return in;
}

LevelSource LoadLevels(std::vector<LevelEntry>& out, std::string& method) {
    out.clear(); method.clear();
    LevelSource src = LS_NONE;
    // 1) straight from the game's .pak files (safe; works without the game running)
    std::string note;
    for (auto& p : PakLevels(note)) AddEntry(out, p);
    if (!out.empty()) { src = LS_FILES; method = "pak files"; }
    // 2) loose .umap files (games that ship unpacked)
    if (out.empty()) {
        std::wstring paks = PaksDir();
        if (!paks.empty()) ScanUmaps(DirOf(paks), L"/Game", out);
        if (!out.empty()) { src = LS_FILES; method = "game folder"; }
    }
    // 3) merge in whatever the game itself reported (cached per game)
    std::string d; std::wstring cf = CacheFile();
    if (!cf.empty() && ReadAll(cf, d)) {
        std::vector<LevelEntry> game; std::string gm;
        ParseLevels(d, game, gm);
        size_t before = out.size();
        for (auto& g : game) {
            bool dup = false;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < before && !dup; i++) if (_stricmp(out[i].path.c_str(), g.path.c_str()) == 0) dup = true;
            if (!dup) out.push_back(g);
        }
        if (src == LS_NONE && !out.empty()) { src = LS_CACHE; method = gm; }
    }
    // 4) no game selected yet: show the connected game's latest scan directly
    if (out.empty() && cf.empty() && GetBridgeStatus().connected) {
        std::string ld;
        if (ReadAll(BridgeDir() + L"\\levels.txt", ld)) { std::string gm; ParseLevels(ld, out, gm); if (!out.empty()) { src = LS_CACHE; method = gm; } }
    }
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end(), [](const LevelEntry& a, const LevelEntry& b) { return _stricmp(a.path.c_str(), b.path.c_str()) < 0; });
    if (out.empty() && !note.empty()) method = note;
    return src;
}

void WriteFreecamConfig(const FreecamConfig& c) {
    MakeDirs(BridgeDir());
    char buf[256];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "enabled=%d\nkey=%s\nmode=%s\nhidetext=%d\nspeed=%.2f\n", c.enabled ? 1 : 0, c.key.c_str(), c.mode.c_str(), c.hideText ? 1 : 0, c.speed);
    WriteAtomic(BridgeDir() + L"\\config.txt", buf);
}
```

`build.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds UE4SS-Launcher.exe with MinGW-w64 (Linux, WSL or MSYS2).
# Needs: x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ / gcc / windres, and Dear ImGui (fetched below into ./imgui).
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
IMGUI=${IMGUI:-imgui}
[ -f "$IMGUI/imgui.h" ] || git clone --depth 1 --branch v1.91.9 https://github.com/ocornut/imgui.git "$IMGUI"
mkdir -p obj
CXX="x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -municode -DUNICODE -D_UNICODE -DIMGUI_USER_CONFIG=\"imgui_user_config.h\" -I. -I$IMGUI -I$IMGUI/backends"
for f in imgui imgui_draw imgui_tables imgui_widgets; do [ -f obj/$f.o ] || $CXX -c $IMGUI/$f.cpp -o obj/$f.o; done
for f in imgui_impl_win32 imgui_impl_dx11; do [ -f obj/$f.o ] || $CXX -c $IMGUI/backends/$f.cpp -o obj/$f.o; done
x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ -O2 -shared -static -s -municode -DUNICODE input_block.cpp -o res/LauncherInput.dll
x86_64-w64-mingw32-windres app.rc -O coff -o obj/app.res
for f in core bridge updater classic; do $CXX -Wall -Wno-unknown-pragmas -c $f.cpp -o obj/$f.o; done
$CXX -Wno-unknown-pragmas -Ithird_party/acl -Ithird_party/rtm -c models.cpp -o obj/models.o
for f in simplifier allocator; do [ -f obj/mo_$f.o ] || $CXX -c third_party/meshopt/$f.cpp -o obj/mo_$f.o; done
x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc -O2 -c puff.c -o obj/puff.o
[ -f obj/ufbx.o ] || x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc -O2 -c third_party/ufbx/ufbx.c -o obj/ufbx.o
$CXX -Wall -Wno-unknown-pragmas -c app.cpp -o obj/app.o
LIBS="-ld3d11 -ld3dcompiler_47 -ldxgi -ldwmapi -lcomdlg32 -lshlwapi -lshell32 -lole32 -luuid -lgdi32 -limm32 -lwinhttp -lbcrypt -lwinmm -lwindowscodecs -ldxguid -s"
$CXX -mwindows -static obj/*.o obj/app.res -o UE4SS-Launcher.exe $LIBS
ls -la UE4SS-Launcher.exe

```

`bundle/Mods/BPML_GenericFunctions/Scripts/main.lua`:

```lua
--[[
    This is a mod where all BP functions available to BP mods goes.
    Only functions that don't need any information from BPModLoader goes in here.
]]

local VerboseLogging = true

local function Log(Message, AlwaysLog)
    if not VerboseLogging and not AlwaysLog then return end
    print(Message)
end

-- Explodes a string by a delimiter into a table
local function Explode(String, Delimiter)
    local ExplodedString = {}
    local Iterator = 1
    local DelimiterFrom, DelimiterTo = string.find(String, Delimiter, Iterator)

    while DelimiterTo do
        table.insert(ExplodedString, string.sub(String, Iterator, DelimiterFrom-1))
        Iterator = DelimiterTo + 1
        DelimiterFrom, DelimiterTo = string.find(String, Delimiter, Iterator)
    end
    table.insert(ExplodedString, string.sub(String, Iterator))

    return ExplodedString
end

RegisterCustomEvent("PrintToModLoader", function(ParamContext, ParamMessage)
    -- Retrieve the param value from the param container.
    local Message = ParamMessage:get()

    -- We must do type-checking here!
    -- This is to guard against mods that don't use the correct params for their custom event.
    -- There's no way to avoid it.
    if Message:type() ~= "FString" then error(string.format("PrintToModLoader Param #1 must be FString but was %s", Message:type())) end

    -- Now the 'Message' param is validated and we're safe to use it.
    local NameParts = Explode(ParamContext:get():GetClass():GetFullName(), "/");
    local ModName = NameParts[#NameParts - 1]
    Log(string.format("[%s] %s\n", ModName, Message:ToString()))
end)

local UClassStaticRef = nil
RegisterCustomEvent("ConstructPersistentObject", function(ParamContext, ParamClass, OutParam)
    -- Param Type Checking
    local Class = ParamClass:get()
    if not Class:IsValid() then error("ConstructPersistentObject Param #1 must be a valid UClass") end
    if not UClassStaticRef then
        UClassStaticRef = StaticFindObject("/Script/CoreUObject.Class")
    end
    if not UClassStaticRef:IsValid() then error("ConstructPersistentObject could not find /Script/CoreUObject.Class") end
    if not Class:IsA(UClassStaticRef) then error("ConstructPersistentObject Param #1 must be a UClass or UClass derivative") end
    local OutValue = OutParam:get()
    if not OutValue:type() == "UObject" then error("ConstructPersistentObject Return Value must be a UObject") end

    -- Function Logic
    local GameInstance = FindFirstOf("GameInstance")
    local GarbageCollectionKeepFlags = 0x0E000000
    local PersistentObject = StaticConstructObject(Class, GameInstance, 0, 0, GarbageCollectionKeepFlags, false, false, nil, nil, nil)
    if not PersistentObject:IsValid() then
        Log(string.format("Was unable to construct persistent object: %s\n", Class:GetFullName()))
    end

    -- Return Value
    OutParam:set(PersistentObject)
end)
```

`bundle/Mods/BPModLoaderMod/Scripts/main.lua`:

```lua
local UEHelpers = require("UEHelpers")

local VerboseLogging = false

local function Log(Message, OnlyLogIfVerbose)
    if not VerboseLogging and OnlyLogIfVerbose then return end
    print("[BPModLoaderMod] " .. Message)
end

package.path = '.\\Mods\\ModLoaderMod\\?.lua;' .. package.path
package.path = '.\\Mods\\ModLoaderMod\\BPMods\\?.lua;' .. package.path

Mods = {}
local OrderedMods = {}

-- Contains mod names from Mods/BPModLoaderMod/load_order.txt and is used to determine the load order of BP mods.
local ModOrderList = {}

local DefaultModConfig = {}
DefaultModConfig.AssetName = "ModActor_C"
DefaultModConfig.AssetNameAsFName = UEHelpers.FindOrAddFName("ModActor_C")

-- Checks if the beginning of a string contains a certain pattern.
local function StartsWith(String, StringToCompare)
    return string.sub(String, 1, string.len(StringToCompare)) == StringToCompare
end

local function FileExists(file)
    local f = io.open(file, "rb")
    if f then f:close() end
    return f ~= nil
end

-- Reads lines from the specified file and returns a table of lines read.
-- Second argument takes a string that can be used to exclude lines starting with that string. Default ;
local function LinesFrom(file, ignoreLinesStartingWith)
    if not FileExists(file) then return {} end

    if ignoreLinesStartingWith == nil then
        ignoreLinesStartingWith = ";"
    end

    local lines = {}
    for line in io.lines(file) do
        if not StartsWith(line, ignoreLinesStartingWith) then
            lines[#lines + 1] = line
        end
    end
    return lines
end

-- Loads mod order data from load_order.txt and pushes it into ModOrderList.
local function LoadModOrder()
    local file = 'Mods/BPModLoaderMod/load_order.txt'
    local lines = LinesFrom(file)

    local entriesAdded = 0

    for _, line in pairs(lines) do
        ModAlreadyExists = false
        for _, ModName in pairs(ModOrderList) do
            if ModName == line then
                ModAlreadyExists = true
            end
        end
        -- Checks for double mod entries in the file and if a mod was already included, skip it.
        if not ModAlreadyExists then
            table.insert(ModOrderList, line)
            entriesAdded = entriesAdded + 1
        end
    end

    if entriesAdded <= 0 then
        Log(string.format("Mods/BPModLoaderMod/load_order.txt not present or no matching mods, loading all BP mods in random order.\n"))
    end
end

local function SetupModOrder()
    local Priority = 1

    -- Adds priority mods first by their respective order as specified in load_order.txt
    for _, ModOrderEntry in pairs(ModOrderList) do
        for ModName, ModInfo in pairs(Mods) do
            if type(ModInfo) == "table" then
                if ModOrderEntry == ModName then
                    OrderedMods[Priority] = ModInfo
                    OrderedMods[Priority].Name = ModName
                    OrderedMods[Priority].Priority = Priority
                    Priority = Priority + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Adds the remaining mods in a random order after the prioritized mods.
    for ModName, ModInfo in pairs(Mods) do
        ModAlreadyIncluded = false
        for _, OrderedModInfo in ipairs(OrderedMods) do
            if type(OrderedModInfo) == "table" then
                if OrderedModInfo.Name == ModName then
                    ModAlreadyIncluded = true
                end
            end
        end

        if not ModAlreadyIncluded then
            ModInfo.Name = ModName
            table.insert(OrderedMods, ModInfo)
        end
    end
end

local function LoadModConfigs()
    -- Load configurations for mods.
    local Dirs = IterateGameDirectories();
    if not Dirs then
        error("[BPModLoader] UE4SS does not support loading mods for this game.")
    end
    local LogicModsDir = Dirs.Game.Content.Paks.LogicMods
    if not Dirs then error("[BPModLoader] IterateGameDirectories failed, cannot load BP mod configurations.") end
    if not LogicModsDir then
        CreateLogicModsDirectory();
        Dirs = IterateGameDirectories();
        LogicModsDir = Dirs.Game.Content.Paks.LogicMods
        if not LogicModsDir then error("[BPModLoader] Unable to find or create Content/Paks/LogicMods directory. Try creating manually.") end
    end
    for ModDirectoryName, ModDirectory in pairs(LogicModsDir) do
        Log(string.format("Mod: %s\n", ModDirectoryName))
        for _, ModFile in pairs(ModDirectory.__files) do
            Log(string.format("    ModFile: %s\n", ModFile.__name))
            if ModFile.__name == "config.lua" then
                dofile(ModFile.__absolute_path)
                if type(Mods[ModDirectoryName]) ~= "table" then break end
                if not Mods[ModDirectoryName].AssetName then break end
                Mods[ModDirectoryName].AssetNameAsFName = UEHelpers.FindOrAddFName(Mods[ModDirectoryName].AssetName)
                break
            end
        end
    end

    local Files = LogicModsDir.__files
    for _, ModDirectory in pairs(LogicModsDir) do
        for _, ModFile in pairs(ModDirectory.__files) do
            table.insert(Files, ModFile)
        end
    end

    -- Load a default configuration for mods that didn't have their own configuration.
    for _, ModFile in pairs(Files) do
        local ModName = ModFile.__name
        local ModNameNoExtension = ModName:match("(.+)%..+$")
        local FileExtension = ModName:match("^.+(%..+)$");
        if FileExtension == ".pak" and not Mods[ModNameNoExtension] then
            --Log("--------------\n")
            --Log(string.format("ModFile: '%s'\n", ModFile.__name))
            --Log(string.format("ModNameNoExtension: '%s'\n", ModNameNoExtension))
            --Log(string.format("FileExtension: %s\n", FileExtension))
            Mods[ModNameNoExtension] = {}
            Mods[ModNameNoExtension].AssetName = DefaultModConfig.AssetName
            Mods[ModNameNoExtension].AssetNameAsFName = DefaultModConfig.AssetNameAsFName
            Mods[ModNameNoExtension].AssetPath = string.format("/Game/Mods/%s/ModActor", ModNameNoExtension)
        end
    end

    LoadModOrder()

    SetupModOrder()
end

LoadModConfigs()

for _, v in ipairs(OrderedMods) do
    Log(string.format("%s == %s\n", v.Name, v))
    if type(v) == "table" then
        for k2, v2 in pairs(v) do
            Log(string.format("    %s == %s\n", k2, v2))
        end
    end
end

local AssetRegistryHelpers = nil
local AssetRegistry = nil

local function LoadMod(ModName, ModInfo, World)
    if ModInfo.Priority ~= nil then
        Log(string.format("Loading mod [Priority: #%i]: %s\n", ModInfo.Priority, ModName))
    else
        Log(string.format("Loading mod: %s\n", ModName))
    end

    if ModInfo.AssetPath == nil or ModInfo.AssetPath == nil then
        Log(string.format("Could not load mod '%s' because it has no asset path or name.\n", ModName))
        return
    end

    local AssetData = nil
    if UnrealVersion.IsBelow(5, 1) then
        AssetData = {
            ["ObjectPath"] = UEHelpers.FindOrAddFName(string.format("%s.%s", ModInfo.AssetPath, ModInfo.AssetName)),
        }
    else
        AssetData = {
            ["PackageName"] = UEHelpers.FindOrAddFName(ModInfo.AssetPath),
            ["AssetName"] = UEHelpers.FindOrAddFName(ModInfo.AssetName),
        }
    end

    local ModClass = AssetRegistryHelpers:GetAsset(AssetData)
    if not ModClass:IsValid() then
        local ObjectPath = AssetData.ObjectPath and AssetData.ObjectPath:ToString() or ""
        local PackageName = AssetData.PackageName and AssetData.PackageName:ToString() or ""
        local AssetName = AssetData.AssetName and AssetData.AssetName:ToString() or ""
        Log(string.format("ModClass for '%s' is not valid\nObjectPath: %s\nPackageName: %s\nAssetName: %s\n", ModName, ObjectPath,PackageName, AssetName))
        return
    end

    if not World then error("A `nil` World parameter was passed to LoadMod function. It's most likely a bug in BPModLoaderMod!") end
    if not World:IsValid() then
        Log(string.format("World is not valid for '%s' to spawn in\n", ModName))
        return
    end

    local Actor = World:SpawnActor(ModClass, {}, {})
    if not Actor:IsValid() then
        Log(string.format("Actor for mod '%s' is not valid\n", ModName))
    else
        Log(string.format("Actor: %s\n", Actor:GetFullName()))
        local PreBeginPlay = Actor.PreBeginPlay
        if PreBeginPlay:IsValid() then
            Log(string.format("Executing 'PreBeginPlay' for mod '%s', with path: '%s'\n", ModName, Actor:GetFullName()))
            PreBeginPlay()
        else
            Log(string.format("PreBeginPlay not valid for mod %s\n", ModName), true)
        end
    end
end

local function CacheAssetRegistry()
    if AssetRegistryHelpers and AssetRegistry then return end

    AssetRegistryHelpers = StaticFindObject("/Script/AssetRegistry.Default__AssetRegistryHelpers")
    if not AssetRegistryHelpers:IsValid() then Log("AssetRegistryHelpers is not valid\n") end

    if AssetRegistryHelpers then
        AssetRegistry = AssetRegistryHelpers:GetAssetRegistry()
        if AssetRegistry:IsValid() then return end
    end

    AssetRegistry = StaticFindObject("/Script/AssetRegistry.Default__AssetRegistryImpl")
    if AssetRegistry:IsValid() then return end

    error("AssetRegistry is not valid\n")
end

local function LoadMods(World)
    if not World or not World:IsValid() then
        Log("[Warning] Invalid UWorld object was passed to LoadMods.\n")
        return
    end

    CacheAssetRegistry()
    for _, ModInfo in ipairs(OrderedMods) do
        if type(ModInfo) == "table" then
            LoadMod(ModInfo.Name, ModInfo, World)
        end
    end
end

RegisterKeyBind(Key.INS, function()
    ExecuteInGameThread(function()
        LoadMods(UEHelpers.GetWorld())
    end)
end)

RegisterBeginPlayPostHook(function(ContextParam)
    local Context = ContextParam:get()
    for _, ModConfig in ipairs(OrderedMods) do
        if Context:GetClass():GetFName() ~= ModConfig.AssetNameAsFName then return end
        local AssetPathWithClassPrefix = string.format("BlueprintGeneratedClass %s.%s", ModConfig.AssetPath, ModConfig.AssetName)
        if AssetPathWithClassPrefix == Context:GetClass():GetFullName() then
            local PostBeginPlay = Context.PostBeginPlay
            if PostBeginPlay:IsValid() then
                Log(string.format("Executing 'PostBeginPlay' for mod '%s'\n", Context:GetFullName()))
                PostBeginPlay()
            else
                Log(string.format("PostBeginPlay not valid for mod %s\n", Context:GetFullName()), true)
            end
        end
    end
end)

RegisterLoadMapPostHook(function(Engine, World)
    LoadMods(World:get())
end)

ExecuteInGameThread(function()
    local ExistingActor = FindFirstOf("Actor")
    if ExistingActor:IsValid() then
        LoadMods(ExistingActor:GetWorld())
    end
end)
```

```lua
---@param self RemoteUnrealParam<APlayerController>
---@param NewPawn RemoteUnrealParam<APawn>
RegisterHook("/Script/Engine.PlayerController:ClientRestart", function(self, NewPawn)
    local PlayerController = self:get()

    if PlayerController.CheatManager:IsValid() then
        print("[CheatManagerEnabler] CheatManager already exist, skipping restoration\n")
        return
    end

    local CheatManagerClass = PlayerController.CheatClass
    if not CheatManagerClass:IsValid() then
        print("[CheatManagerEnabler] Controller:CheatClass is nullptr, using default CheatClass instead\n")

        CheatManagerClass = StaticFindObject("/Script/Engine.CheatManager") --[[@as UClass]]
    end

    if not CheatManagerClass:IsValid() then
        print("[CheatManagerEnabler] Couldn't find default CheatClass, therefore, could not enable Cheat Manager\n")
        return
    end

    local CreatedCheatManager = StaticConstructObject(CheatManagerClass, PlayerController)
    if CreatedCheatManager:IsValid() then
        print(string.format("[CheatManagerEnabler] Constructed CheatManager [0x%X]\n", CreatedCheatManager:GetAddress()))

        PlayerController.CheatManager = CreatedCheatManager
        print("[CheatManagerEnabler] Enabled CheatManager\n")
    else
        print("[CheatManagerEnabler] Was unable to construct CheatManager, therefore, could not enable Cheat Manager\n")
    end
end)
```

`bundle/Mods/ConsoleCommandsMod/Scripts/dump_object.lua`:

```lua
-- This is a custom implementation of UEs "obj dump <obj>" command.
-- It doesn't have a 1:1 feature set.

local UEHelpers = require("UEHelpers")

--[[
    TODO: Expand on the console command format.
          You should be able to specify a sub-object, sub-struct, sub-array, sub-map, etc.
          You do 'dump_object /Engine/Transient.GameEngine_2147482624'.
          You notice '(ArrayProperty) ShaderComplexityColors=StructProperty ...'.
          To get the first element, you do: 'dump_object /Engine/Transient.GameEngine_2147482624 ShaderComplexityColors 0'.
          This will likely see the type-prefix (i.e. UClass /Engine/Script/...) needing to be unsupported just to simplify the code.
          UPDATE: This is currently working with ArrayProperty and StructProperty.
                  Need to add support eventually for MapProperty when UE4SS Lua supports MapProperty.
]]

string.padleft = function(InString, Length, PadWithChar)
    -- We pad with spaces by default.
    if not PadWithChar then PadWithChar = " " end
    return InString .. PadWithChar:rep(Length - #InString)
end

local OriginalLog = Log
local Buffer = ""
function Log(Message)
    Buffer = string.format("%s%s\n", Buffer, Message)
    OriginalLog(Message)
end

local UClassStaticClass = StaticFindObject("/Script/CoreUObject.Class")
local UScriptStructStaticClass = StaticFindObject("/Script/CoreUObject.ScriptStruct")
local UEnumStaticClass = StaticFindObject("/Script/CoreUObject.Enum")
local UPropertyStaticClass = StaticFindObject("/Script/CoreUObject.Property")

local DumpPropertyWithinObject = nil
local DumpObject = nil

DumpPropertyWithinObject = function(Object, Property, DumpRecursively)
    local ValueStr = ""

    -- Cannot resolve the value here because of unhandled types.
    if Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.Int8Property) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value)
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.Int16Property) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value)
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.IntProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value)
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.Int64Property) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value)
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.NameProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value:ToString())
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.FloatProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value)
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.StrProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value:ToString())
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.ByteProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value)
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.ArrayProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        local Inner = Property:GetInner()

        -- Inner Type
        if Inner:IsA(PropertyTypes.StructProperty) then
            ValueStr = string.format("%s\n", Inner:GetStruct():GetFullName())
        else
            ValueStr = string.format("%s\n", Inner:GetFullName())
        end
        
        -- Size & Capacity
        if Value:GetArrayNum() == 0 then
            ValueStr = string.format("%s    ---empty---", ValueStr)
        else
            ValueStr = string.format("%s    %i/%i", ValueStr, Value:GetArrayNum(), Value:GetArrayMax())
        end
        
        -- Inner Value
        if Value:GetArrayNum() > 0 then
            ValueStr = string.format("%s\n", ValueStr)
            if Inner:IsA(PropertyTypes.ObjectProperty) then
                Value:ForEach(function(Index, Elem)
                    ValueStr = string.format("%s    [%i]: %s\n", ValueStr, Index - 1, Elem:get():GetFullName())
                end)
            end
        end
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.MapProperty) then
        ValueStr = "UNHANDLED_VALUE"
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.StructProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value:GetFullName())
        if DumpRecursively then
            DumpObject(Value)
        end
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.ClassProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value:GetFullName())
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.WeakObjectProperty) then
        --local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = "UNHANDLED_VALUE"
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.EnumProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s(%s)", Property:GetEnum():GetNameByValue(Value):ToString(), Value)
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.TextProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value:ToString())
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.ObjectProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        if DumpRecursively then
            DumpObject(Value)
        else
            ValueStr = string.format("%s", Value:GetFullName())
        end
    elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.BoolProperty) then
        local Value = Object[Property:GetFName():ToString()]
        local FieldMask = Property:GetFieldMask()
        if FieldMask == 255 then
            ValueStr = string.format("%s", (Value and "True" or "False"))
        else
            ValueStr = string.format("%s (FM: 0x%X, BM: 0x%X)", (Value and "True" or "False"), FieldMask, Property:GetByteMask())
        end
    else
        ValueStr = "UNHANDLED_VALUE"
    end

    return string.format("0x%04X    %s %s=%s", Property:GetOffset_Internal(), Property:GetClass():GetFName():ToString(), Property:GetFName():ToString(), ValueStr)
end

local function GetObjectByName(ObjectName)
    local Object = nil
    if FPackageName.IsShortPackageName(ObjectName) then
        Object = FindObject(nil, ObjectName, nil, nil)
    else
        Object = FindObject(nil, nil, ObjectName, false)
    end
    return Object
end

local function GetPropertyByName(ObjectIn, PropertyName)
    local PropertyFName = UEHelpers.FindOrAddFName(PropertyName)
    local Object = nil

    if ObjectIn:IsA(UClassStaticClass) or ObjectIn:IsA(UScriptStructStaticClass) then
        Object = ObjectIn
    else
        Object = ObjectIn:GetClass()
    end

    local PropertyFound = nil
    while Object:IsValid() do
        Object:ForEachProperty(function(Property)
            if Property:GetFName():Equals(PropertyFName) then
                PropertyFound = Property
                return true
            end
        end)
        Object = Object:GetSuperStruct()
    end

    return PropertyFound
end

DumpObject = function(Object)
    Log(string.format("*** Property dump for object '%s ***", Object:GetFullName()))

    -- Lets make sure that this is an object type that can be dumped.
    local IsClassCompatible = false
    if Object:IsA(UClassStaticClass) then IsClassCompatible = true end
    local IsUScriptStruct = Object:IsA(UScriptStructStaticClass)
    if IsUScriptStruct and not Object:IsMappedToObject() then IsClassCompatible = true end

    if IsClassCompatible then
        -- A UClass or UScriptStruct.
        local Class = Object
        while Class and Class:IsValid() do
            Log(string.format("=== %s properties ===", Class:GetFullName()))
            Class:ForEachProperty(function(Property)
                local OutputBuffer = string.format("0x%04X    %s %s", Property:GetOffset_Internal(), Property:GetClass():GetFName():ToString(), Property:GetFName():ToString())
                if Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.ObjectProperty) then
                    OutputBuffer = string.format("%s (%s)", OutputBuffer, Property:GetPropertyClass():GetFullName())
                elseif Property:IsA(PropertyTypes.BoolProperty) then
                    local FieldMask = Property:GetFieldMask()
                    if FieldMask ~= 255 then
                        OutputBuffer = string.format("%s (FM: 0x%X, BM: 0x%X)", OutputBuffer, FieldMask, Property:GetByteMask())
                    end
                end
                Log(OutputBuffer)
            end)

            Class = Class:GetSuperStruct()
        end
    elseif Object:IsA(UEnumStaticClass) then
        Object:ForEachName(function(Name, Value)
            Log(string.format("%s (%i)", Name:ToString(), Value))
        end)
    elseif not Object:IsA(UPropertyStaticClass) then
        -- A UObject that isn't a UClass, UScriptStruct, or UProperty (<4.25 only)
        local ObjectClass = nil
        if IsUScriptStruct then
            ObjectClass = Object
        else
            ObjectClass = Object:GetClass()
        end
        while ObjectClass and ObjectClass:IsValid() do
            Log(string.format("=== %s ===", ObjectClass:GetFullName()))
            ObjectClass:ForEachProperty(function(Property)
                Log(DumpPropertyWithinObject(Object, Property))
            end)

            ObjectClass = ObjectClass:GetSuperStruct()
        end
    end
end

local State = {
    ["StoreObjectContext"] = 1,
    ["FindProperty"] = 2,
    ["FoundObject"] = 3,
    ["FoundProperty"] = 4,
}

local ObjectContext = nil
local PropertyContext = nil
local CurrentState = State.StoreObjectContext

function ExecStateMachine(Param)
    if CurrentState == State.StoreObjectContext then
        if not Param or Param == "" or Param == " " then
            Log("No object name supplied")
            return true
        else
            ObjectContext = GetObjectByName(Param)
            if (ObjectContext:IsA(UScriptStructStaticClass)) or (ObjectContext and ObjectContext:IsValid()) then
                CurrentState = State.FindProperty
            else
                Log(string.format("No class found with name %s", Param))
                return true
            end
        end
    elseif CurrentState == State.FindProperty then
        PropertyContext = GetPropertyByName(ObjectContext, Param)
        if PropertyContext and PropertyContext:IsValid() then
            if PropertyContext:IsA(PropertyTypes.ObjectProperty) then
                --CurrentState = State.FindProperty
                --return ExecStateMachine(Param)
            end
            CurrentState = State.FoundProperty
        else
            Log(string.format("Property '%s' not found in '%s'", Param, ObjectContext:GetFullName()))
            return true
        end
    elseif CurrentState == State.FoundProperty then
        if PropertyContext:IsA(PropertyTypes.ArrayProperty) then
            PropertyContext = PropertyContext:GetInner()
            ObjectContext = ObjectContext[PropertyContext:GetFName():ToString()]

            local ArrayIndex = tonumber(Param)
            if not ArrayIndex then
                Log(string.format("Value '%s' is not a valid array index", Param))
                return true
            elseif ObjectContext:GetArrayNum() < ArrayIndex + 1 then
                Log(string.format("Array index '%i' out of bounds.", ArrayIndex))
                return true
            else
                ObjectContext = ObjectContext[ArrayIndex + 1]
                CurrentState = State.FindProperty
                return false
            end
        end

        ObjectContext = ObjectContext[PropertyContext:GetFName():ToString()]
        CurrentState = State.FindProperty
        return ExecStateMachine(Param)
    end
end

RegisterConsoleCommandHandler("dump_object", function(FullCommand, Parameters, Ar)
    ObjectContext = nil
    PropertyContext = nil
    CurrentState = State.StoreObjectContext

    if #Parameters < 1 then return false end
    local ShouldSaveToFile = Parameters[1]:find(".txt")
    if ShouldSaveToFile and #Parameters < 2 then return false end

    GlobalAr = Ar

    for i = ShouldSaveToFile and 2 or 1, #Parameters, 1 do
        local Param = Parameters[i]
        if ExecStateMachine(Param) then
            Buffer = ""
            return true
        end
    end

    if CurrentState == State.FoundProperty then
        Log(DumpPropertyWithinObject(ObjectContext, PropertyContext, true))
    else
        DumpObject(ObjectContext)
    end

    if ShouldSaveToFile then
        local File = io.open(Parameters[1], "w+")
        File:write(Buffer)
        File:close()

    end
    Buffer = ""
    return true
end)
```

`bundle/Mods/ConsoleCommandsMod/Scripts/set.lua`:

```lua
RegisterConsoleCommandHandler("set", function(FullCommand, Parameters, Ar)
    -- If we have no parameters then just let someone else handle this command
    if #Parameters < 3 then return false end
    
    GlobalAr = Ar
    
    local ClassOrObjectName = Parameters[1]
    local PropertyName = Parameters[2]
    local NewPropertyValue = Parameters[3]
    
    local BannedFlags = EObjectFlags.RF_ClassDefaultObject | EObjectFlags.RF_ArchetypeObject
    
    if not ClassOrObjectName or ClassOrObjectName == "" or ClassOrObjectName == " " then
        Log("No class or object name supplied")
        return true
    end
    
    local ObjectOrClass = FindObject(nil, ClassOrObjectName, nil, BannedFlags)
    if not ObjectOrClass:IsValid() then
        Log(string.format("Unrecognized class or object %s", ClassOrObjectName))
        return true
    end
    
    -- Replace with a call to "IsA" when it exists
    if (ObjectOrClass:IsClass()) then
        local Property = ObjectOrClass:Reflection():GetProperty(PropertyName)
        if Property:IsValid() then
            local Objects = FindObjects(0, ObjectOrClass, nil, nil, BannedFlags, false)
            for ObjectNum, Object in pairs(Objects) do
                Property:ImportText(NewPropertyValue, Property:ContainerPtrToValuePtr(Object), 0, Object)
            end
            
            if #Objects == 0 then
                Log(string.format("No objects found with class %s", ClassOrObjectName))
            end
        else
            Log(string.format("Unrecognized property %s on class %s", PropertyName, ClassOrObjectName))
        end
    else
        local Property = ObjectOrClass:Reflection():GetProperty(PropertyName)
        if Property:IsValid() then
            Property:ImportText(NewPropertyValue, Property:ContainerPtrToValuePtr(ObjectOrClass), 0, ObjectOrClass)
        else
            Log(string.format("Unrecognized property %s on class %s", PropertyName, ClassOrObjectName))
        end
    end
    
    return true
end)
```

`bundle/Mods/ConsoleEnablerMod/Scripts/main.lua`:

```lua
--########################
-- DEFINITIONS
--########################
-- state
local UEHelpers = require("UEHelpers")
local Pre, Post = -1, -1
local WasConsoleCreated = false
-- CONFIGURATION
-- you can edit the key names to your liking, make sure they match UE names
local IsDynamicViewport = false
local KeysToAdd = {
    UEHelpers.FindFName("Tilde"),
    UEHelpers.FindFName("F10")
}
local KeysToRemove = {
    -- Add keys here if you want to stop them from toggling the console.
    --UEHelpers.FindFName("@"),
}


--########################
-- OWN LOGIC
--########################
local function CopyArrayAsTable(A)
    local T = {}
    if type(A) ~= "userdata" then return T end
    if A:type() ~= "TArray" then return T end
    for i = 1, #A do
        -- Must actually re-create the struct, because it's owned by UE, and can be mutated by the owning array.
        -- For example, if TArray::Empty is called.
        T[i] = {KeyName = A[i].KeyName}
    end
    return T
end

local function TableContains(T, V)
    if type(T) ~= "table" then return false end
    for i = 1, #T do
        if T[i] == V then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function RemapConsoleKeys()
    -- Change console key
    local InputSettings = StaticFindObject("/Script/Engine.Default__InputSettings") ---@cast InputSettings UInputSettings
    if not InputSettings:IsValid() then print("[ConsoleEnabler] InputSettings not found, could not change console key\n") return end

    local ConsoleKeys = InputSettings.ConsoleKeys
    for _, KeyName in ipairs(KeysToAdd) do
        if KeyName ~= NAME_None then
            local KeyIsAlreadySet = false
            for i = 1, #ConsoleKeys do
                if ConsoleKeys[i].KeyName == KeyName then
                    KeyIsAlreadySet = true
                    break
                end
            end
            if not KeyIsAlreadySet then
                ConsoleKeys[#ConsoleKeys + 1].KeyName = KeyName
            end
        end
    end

    if #KeysToRemove > 0 then
        -- Shenanigans required because the Lua API doesn't expose any way of removing elements from arrays.
        local ConsoleKeysCopy = CopyArrayAsTable(ConsoleKeys)
        ConsoleKeys:Empty()
        local NewConsoleArrayCount = 1
        for i = 1, #ConsoleKeysCopy do
            local Key = ConsoleKeysCopy[i]
            if not TableContains(KeysToRemove, Key.KeyName) then
                ConsoleKeys[NewConsoleArrayCount] = Key
                NewConsoleArrayCount = NewConsoleArrayCount + 1
            end
        end
    end

    for i = 1, #ConsoleKeys do
        print(string.format("[ConsoleEnabler] ConsoleKey[%d]: %s\n", i, ConsoleKeys[i].KeyName:ToString()))
    end
end

local function CreateConsole()
    local Engine = UEHelpers.GetEngine()
    if not Engine:IsValid() then print("[ConsoleEnabler] Was unable to find an instance of UEngine\n") return end

    local ConsoleClass = StaticFindObject("/Script/Engine.Console") ---@type UClass
    local GameViewport = Engine.GameViewport
    if (GameViewport:IsValid() and GameViewport.ViewportConsole:IsValid()) then
        -- Console already exists, let's just remap the keys
        WasConsoleCreated = true
        RemapConsoleKeys()
    elseif (ConsoleClass:IsValid() and GameViewport:IsValid()) then
        local CreatedConsole = StaticConstructObject(ConsoleClass, GameViewport) ---@cast CreatedConsole UConsole
        if not CreatedConsole:IsValid() then print("[CreateConsole] Was unable to construct an UConsole object\n") return end

        GameViewport.ViewportConsole = CreatedConsole
        WasConsoleCreated = true
        RemapConsoleKeys()
    else
        print("ConsoleClass, GameViewport, or ViewportConsole is invalid\n")
    end
end


--########################
-- ENTRY POINT
--########################

--- In cases where ClientRestart runs earlier than ExecuteInGameThread
if (not WasConsoleCreated or IsDynamicViewport) then
    ExecuteInGameThread(CreateConsole)
end

--- We only need to create console once since it is a VP singleton
Pre, Post = RegisterHook("/Script/Engine.PlayerController:ClientRestart",
---@param Context RemoteUnrealParam<APlayerController>
function(Context)
    if (not WasConsoleCreated or IsDynamicViewport) then
        CreateConsole()
    end
    if (WasConsoleCreated and not IsDynamicViewport) then
        UnregisterHook("/Script/Engine.PlayerController:ClientRestart", Pre, Post)
    end
end)
```

`bundle/Mods/LauncherBridge/Scripts/editor.lua`:

```lua
-- In-game editor backend for the UE4SS Launcher overlay (F2).
-- The overlay sends ed_* commands; this module applies them inside the game and writes
-- editor_state.txt (player + selection, ~3x a second), props.txt (selected actor's values, ~1x a second)
-- and actors.txt (on request). All engine calls use the parameter types the engine expects.
local UEHelpers = require("UEHelpers")

local E = { open = false }
local Dir = nil
local Freecam = nil
local selected, selectedPath = nil, ""
local actorCache = {}            -- path -> actor from the last list
local msgs, msgId = {}, 0

local function Log(m) print("[LauncherBridge] [Editor] " .. tostring(m) .. "\n") end
local function Valid(o)
    if o == nil then return false end
    local ok, v = pcall(function() return o:IsValid() end)
    return ok and v == true
end
local function Str(v)
    if v == nil then return "" end
    local t = type(v)
    if t == "string" or t == "number" or t == "boolean" then return tostring(v) end
    local ok, s = pcall(function() return v:ToString() end)
    if ok and s ~= nil then return tostring(s) end
    return tostring(v)
end
local function Clean(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("[\t\r\n]", " ")) end
local function Vec(x, y, z) return { X = x, Y = y, Z = z } end
local function Rot(p, y, r) return { Pitch = p, Yaw = y, Roll = r } end
local function Num3(s)
    local a, b, c = tostring(s or ""):match("^%s*([%-%d%.eE]+)%s*,%s*([%-%d%.eE]+)%s*,%s*([%-%d%.eE]+)")
    if not a then return nil end
    return tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c)
end
local function F3(v) if not v then return "0,0,0" end return string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", v.X or 0, v.Y or 0, v.Z or 0) end
local function R3(v) if not v then return "0,0,0" end return string.format("%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", v.Pitch or 0, v.Yaw or 0, v.Roll or 0) end

-- Loads a game asset from its files. The engine's own loader (KismetSystemLibrary.LoadAsset_Blocking) works in
-- games where UE4SS's LoadAsset doesn't (it needs the asset registry, which games like Hogwarts Legacy cook
-- without most assets). UE4SS's is still tried after it.
local UE4SSLoadAsset = LoadAsset
local function LoadAsset(path)
    if not path or path == "" then return nil end
    if not path:find("%.") then path = path .. "." .. (path:match("([^/]+)$") or "") end
    local ok, r = pcall(function()
        local ksl = StaticFindObject("/Script/Engine.Default__KismetSystemLibrary")
        local sp = ksl:MakeSoftObjectPath(path)
        local ref = ksl:Conv_SoftObjPathToSoftObjRef(sp)
        return ksl:LoadAsset_Blocking(ref)
    end)
    if ok and r ~= nil and Valid(r) then return r end
    if type(UE4SSLoadAsset) == "function" then
        local ok2, r2 = pcall(UE4SSLoadAsset, path)
        if ok2 then return r2 end
    end
    return nil
end
local function Msg(m, isErr)
    msgId = msgId + 1
    table.insert(msgs, string.format("%d\t%s\t%s", msgId, isErr and "err" or "ok", Clean(m)))
    if #msgs > 12 then table.remove(msgs, 1) end
    Log(m)
end

local function WriteFile(path, data)
    local tmp = path .. ".tmp"
    local f = io.open(tmp, "w")
    if not f then return false end
    f:write(data); f:close()
    os.remove(path)
    return os.rename(tmp, path)
end

-- The real player controller/pawn (not the debug camera's controller).
local Fast = require("fast")
local slowPC, slowAt = nil, -100
local function PlayerPC()
    local pc = Fast.PlayerPC()   -- straight from the engine (searching every object made big games stutter)
    if Valid(pc) then
        local okp, pawn = pcall(function() return pc.Pawn end)
        if okp and Valid(pawn) then return pc, pawn end
    end
    -- some games keep the player elsewhere: search, but at most every 2 seconds, and keep the answer
    if Valid(slowPC) then
        local okp, pawn = pcall(function() return slowPC.Pawn end)
        if okp and Valid(pawn) then return slowPC, pawn end
    end
    if os.clock() - slowAt >= 2 then
        slowAt = os.clock()
        for _, c in ipairs(FindAllOf("PlayerController") or {}) do
            if Valid(c) and not Fast.IsDebugPC(c) then
                local okp, pawn = pcall(function() return c.Pawn end)
                if okp and Valid(pawn) then slowPC = c; return c, pawn end
            end
        end
    end
    if Valid(pc) then return pc, pc.Pawn end
    return nil, nil
end
local function World()
    local pc = PlayerPC()
    if Valid(pc) then return pc:GetWorld() end
    return UEHelpers.GetWorld()
end
local function ViewPC()
    if Freecam then return Freecam.ActivePC() end
    return PlayerPC()
end
local function Movement(pawn)
    if not Valid(pawn) then return nil end
    local ok, m = pcall(function() return pawn.CharacterMovement end)
    if ok and Valid(m) then return m end
    return nil
end
local function ObjectPath(a)
    local ok, full = pcall(function() return a:GetFullName() end)
    if not ok or not full then return "" end
    return full:match("^%S+%s+(.+)$") or full
end
local function IsActor(o)
    local ok, r = pcall(function() return o:IsA("/Script/Engine.Actor") end)
    return ok and r == true
end
-- Turns a component / instance / sub-object into the actor that owns it.
local function ToActor(o)
    for _ = 1, 8 do
        if not Valid(o) then return nil end
        if IsActor(o) then return o end
        local ok, own = pcall(function() return o:GetOwner() end)
        if ok and Valid(own) then o = own
        else
            local ok2, outer = pcall(function() return o:GetOuter() end)
            if ok2 and Valid(outer) then o = outer else return nil end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function FindActor(path)
    local a = actorCache[path]
    if Valid(a) then return ToActor(a) end
    if selectedPath == path and Valid(selected) then return ToActor(selected) end
    local ok, o = pcall(function() return StaticFindObject(path) end)
    if ok and Valid(o) then return ToActor(o) end
    return nil
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- state files
local function PlayerSection()
    local out = {}
    local pc, pawn = PlayerPC()
    if not Valid(pawn) then table.insert(out, "pawn="); return out end
    table.insert(out, "pawn=" .. Clean(Str(pawn:GetClass():GetFName())))
    if E.SwappedTo and E.SwappedTo() then table.insert(out, "swapped=" .. Clean(E.SwappedTo()))
    elseif E.PossessActive and E.PossessActive() then table.insert(out, "playingas=" .. Clean(Str(pawn:GetFName()))) end
    if E.LookingAs and E.LookingAs() then table.insert(out, "lookingas=" .. Clean(E.LookingAs())) end
    local okL, l = pcall(function() return pawn:K2_GetActorLocation() end)
    local okR, r = pcall(function() return pawn:K2_GetActorRotation() end)
    table.insert(out, "loc=" .. (okL and F3(l) or "0,0,0"))
    table.insert(out, "rot=" .. (okR and R3(r) or "0,0,0"))
    local m = Movement(pawn)
    if m then
        local function num(k) local ok, v = pcall(function() return m[k] end); return ok and type(v) == "number" and v or 0 end
        table.insert(out, string.format("walk=%.2f", num("MaxWalkSpeed")))
        table.insert(out, string.format("jump=%.2f", num("JumpZVelocity")))
        table.insert(out, string.format("gravity=%.3f", num("GravityScale")))
        table.insert(out, string.format("mode=%d", math.floor(num("MovementMode"))))
    end
    local okD, dmg = pcall(function() return pawn.bCanBeDamaged end)
    table.insert(out, "god=" .. ((okD and dmg == false) and "1" or "0"))
    local okC, col = pcall(function() return pawn:GetActorEnableCollision() end)
    table.insert(out, "ghost=" .. ((okC and col == false) and "1" or "0"))
    local w = World()
    local okT, td = pcall(function() return UEHelpers.GetGameplayStatics():GetGlobalTimeDilation(w) end)
    table.insert(out, string.format("timescale=%.3f", (okT and type(td) == "number") and td or 1))
    local vpc = ViewPC()
    local okF, fov = pcall(function() return vpc.PlayerCameraManager:GetFOVAngle() end)
    table.insert(out, string.format("fov=%.1f", (okF and type(fov) == "number") and fov or 90))
    return out
end

local function SelectedSection()
    if not Valid(selected) then
        selected = nil
        return { "sel=" }
    end
    local out = { "sel=" .. selectedPath }
    table.insert(out, "selname=" .. Clean(Str(selected:GetFName())))
    table.insert(out, "selclass=" .. Clean(Str(selected:GetClass():GetFName())))
    local okL, l = pcall(function() return selected:K2_GetActorLocation() end)
    local okR, r = pcall(function() return selected:K2_GetActorRotation() end)
    local okS, s = pcall(function() return selected:GetActorScale3D() end)
    table.insert(out, "selloc=" .. (okL and F3(l) or "0,0,0"))
    table.insert(out, "selrot=" .. (okR and R3(r) or "0,0,0"))
    table.insert(out, "selscale=" .. (okS and F3(s) or "1,1,1"))
    local okH, h = pcall(function() return selected.bHidden end)
    table.insert(out, "selhidden=" .. ((okH and h == true) and "1" or "0"))
    -- centre of the object (middle of its bounding box), used for the gizmo and as the rotation pivot
    local cx3, cy3, cz3 = nil, nil, nil
    pcall(function()
        local origin, extent = {}, {}
        local ok = pcall(function() selected:GetActorBounds(false, origin, extent, false) end)
        if not ok then origin, extent = {}, {}; selected:GetActorBounds(false, origin, extent) end
        if origin.X and extent.X and (extent.X > 0 or extent.Y > 0 or extent.Z > 0) and extent.X < 1e6 then
            cx3, cy3, cz3 = origin.X, origin.Y, origin.Z
        end
    end)
    if okL and l and not cx3 then cx3, cy3, cz3 = l.X, l.Y, l.Z end
    if cx3 then table.insert(out, string.format("selcenter=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f", cx3, cy3, cz3)) end
    -- where it is on screen (0-1) plus where its X/Y/Z axes point, so the overlay can draw the gizmo
    if cx3 then
        local l = { X = cx3, Y = cy3, Z = cz3 }
        pcall(function()
            local vpc = ViewPC()
            local size = {}
            vpc:GetViewportSize(size, size)
            local w, hh = tonumber(size.SizeX) or 0, tonumber(size.SizeY) or 0
            if w <= 0 or hh <= 0 then return end
            local function proj(x, y, z)
                local scr = {}
                local ok, vis = pcall(function() return vpc:ProjectWorldLocationToScreen({ X = x, Y = y, Z = z }, scr, false) end)
                if ok and vis and scr.X then return scr.X / w, scr.Y / hh end
                return nil
            end
            local cx, cy = proj(l.X, l.Y, l.Z)
            if not cx then return end
            table.insert(out, string.format("selscreen=%.4f,%.4f", cx, cy))
```
