```lua
    return ok and k or ""
end
-- a change made in the material editor on an imported model: keep it with the model too
function MI.ModelEdit(path, a, comp, slot, kind, param, value)
    local inst = MI.ModelOf(path); if not inst then return end
    local c = MI.FindComp(a, comp); if not c then return end
    local pm = MI.PartMat(inst, c); if pm == nil then return end
    local list = MI.LoadEdits(inst.file)
    local keep = {}
    if kind == "reset" or kind == "mat" then
        for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e.mat ~= pm then table.insert(keep, e) end end
        if kind == "mat" and value ~= "" then table.insert(keep, { mat = pm, kind = "mat", param = "", role = "", value = value }) end
    else
        if kind == "tex" and (value == "" or value:find("^/Engine/Transient")) then return end     -- the model's own pictures: nothing to keep
        local role = kind == "tex" and MI.TexRole(param, value) or E.ParamRole(kind, param)
        local done = false
        for _, e in ipairs(list) do
            if e.mat == pm and e.kind == kind and e.param == param then e.value, e.role, done = value, role, true end
            table.insert(keep, e)
        end
        if not done then table.insert(keep, { mat = pm, kind = kind, param = param, role = role, value = value }) end
    end
    MI.SaveEdits(inst.file, keep)
    MI.edits[inst.file] = nil
end
-- put a model's kept changes on a freshly built copy
function E.ApplyModelEdits(a, inst)
    if not (a and inst and inst.file) then return end
    local list = MI.LoadEdits(inst.file)
    if #list == 0 then return end
    for i, c in ipairs(inst.comps or {}) do
        local p = inst.m.parts[i]
        if Valid(c) and p and p.mat ~= nil then
            local mine = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e.mat == p.mat then table.insert(mine, e) end end
            if #mine > 0 then pcall(MI.ApplyEditsTo, a, c, mine) end
        end
    end
end
function MI.ApplyEditsTo(a, c, mine)
    -- a swapped material first (only if this game has it)
    for _, e in ipairs(mine) do if e.kind == "mat" then
        local m = nil; pcall(function() m = StaticFindObject(e.value) end)
        if not Valid(m) then m = LoadAsset(e.value) end
        if Valid(m) then pcall(function() c:SetMaterial(0, m) end) end
    end end
    local cur = nil; pcall(function() cur = c:GetMaterial(0) end)
    if not Valid(cur) then return end
    local P = MI.Params(cur)
    local have = { tex = {}, vec = {}, sca = {} }
    for _, k in ipairs({ "tex", "vec", "sca" }) do for _, x in ipairs(P[k]) do have[k][x.name] = x end end
    local mid = nil
    local function M() if not mid then mid = MI.Mid(c, 0) end return mid end
    local tint, tinted = { 1, 1, 1, 1 }, false
    local byRole = { vec = {}, sca = {}, tex = {} }
    for _, e in ipairs(mine) do
        if e.kind ~= "mat" then
            if have[e.kind] and have[e.kind][e.param] then
                pcall(MI.SetOn, M(), e.kind, e.param, e.value)                          -- the same setting exists: use it as-is
            elseif e.role == "tint" and e.kind == "vec" then                              -- tints combine (several can be set)
                local r, g, b = tostring(e.value):match("^([%-%d%.eE]+),([%-%d%.eE]+),([%-%d%.eE]+)")
                if r then tint[1], tint[2], tint[3] = tint[1] * tonumber(r), tint[2] * tonumber(g), tint[3] * tonumber(b); tinted = true end
            elseif e.role ~= "" then byRole[e.kind][e.role] = e.value end
        end
    end
    if tinted then byRole.vec.tint = string.format("%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,1", tint[1], tint[2], tint[3]) end
    -- by role: onto this game's settings that do the same thing
    for kind, roles in pairs(byRole) do for role, value in pairs(roles) do
        for _, x in ipairs(P[kind]) do
            local xr = kind == "tex" and (MI.TexRoleOf and MI.TexRoleOf(x) or "") or E.ParamRole(kind, x.name)
            if xr == role then pcall(MI.SetOn, M(), kind, x.name, value) end
        end
    end end
end
-- back to how a slot was before any change: its original material, with its original settings
function MI.Restore(c, slot)
    local key = MI.Key(c, slot)
    local o = MI.origs[key]
    if Valid(o) then pcall(function() c:SetMaterial(slot, o) end) end
    local P = MI.snaps[key]
    if P and Valid(o) and IsA(o, "/Script/Engine.MaterialInstanceDynamic") then
        for _, k in ipairs({ "vec", "sca", "tex" }) do for _, x in ipairs(P[k]) do
            if not (k == "tex" and x.value == "") then pcall(MI.SetOn, o, k, x.name, x.value) end
        end end
    end
    MI.mids[key], MI.snaps[key] = nil, nil
end
function MI.TexRoleOf(x) local t = MI.Texture(x.value); if not t then return "" end; local ok, k = pcall(TexKind, x.name, t); return ok and k or "" end
function MI.SetOn(mid, kind, param, value)
    if not mid then return end
    if kind == "tex" then local t = MI.Texture(value); if t then mid:SetTextureParameterValue(FName(param), t) end
    elseif kind == "vec" then
        local r, g, b, al = tostring(value):match("^([%-%d%.eE]+),([%-%d%.eE]+),([%-%d%.eE]+),?([%-%d%.eE]*)$")
        if r then mid:SetVectorParameterValue(FName(param), { R = tonumber(r), G = tonumber(g), B = tonumber(b), A = tonumber(al) or 1 }) end
    elseif kind == "sca" then mid:SetScalarParameterValue(FName(param), tonumber(value) or 0) end
end
-- arg: actor \t component \t slot \t kind \t parameter \t value
handlers.ed_matset = function(arg)
    local t = {}; for x in ((arg or "") .. "\t"):gmatch("([^\t]*)\t") do table.insert(t, x) end
    local path, comp, slot, kind, param, value = t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4], t[5] or "", t[6] or ""
    if not (path and comp and slot and kind) then return end
    local a = FindActor(path); if not a then Msg("That object isn't there any more.", true); return end
    local ok, err = MI.Apply(a, comp, slot, kind, param, value)
    if not ok then Msg(err or "Couldn't change the material.", true); return end
    MI.Save(path, comp, slot, kind, param, value)
    pcall(MI.ModelEdit, path, a, comp, slot, kind, param, value)
end
-- reset every material of an object
handlers.ed_matresetall = function(path)
    local a = FindActor(path); if not a then return end
    local n = 0
    for _, c in ipairs(MI.Comps(a)) do
        local nm = 0; pcall(function() nm = c:GetNumMaterials() end)
        for s = 0, nm - 1 do
            local key = MI.Key(c, s)
            if Valid(MI.origs[key]) then MI.Restore(c, s); n = n + 1 end
        end
    end
    if Lay then
        local id = Lay.byPath[path]
        local e = (id and Lay.added[id]) or Lay.actors[path]
        if e and e.mats then e.mats = nil; Touch() end
    end
    local inst = MI.ModelOf(path)
    if inst then pcall(MI.SaveEdits, inst.file, {}) end
    Msg(n > 0 and "Put the original materials back" or "Nothing to reset")
end

-- a picture of the material on a sphere (lit like the model pictures): arg id \t actor \t component \t slot
handlers.ed_matprev = function(arg)
    local id, path, comp, slot = (arg or ""):match("^([%w_]+)\t([^\t]+)\t([^\t]+)\t(%d+)$")
    if not id then return end
    local dir = thumbDir or Dir
    local function fail() WriteFile(dir .. id .. ".fail", "x") end
    local a = FindActor(path); if not a then fail(); return end
    local c = MI.FindComp(a, comp); if not c then fail(); return end
    local mat = nil; pcall(function() mat = c:GetMaterial(tonumber(slot)) end)
    if not Valid(mat) then fail(); return end
    local mesh = nil
    for _, p in ipairs({ "/Engine/BasicShapes/Sphere.Sphere", "/Engine/EngineMeshes/Sphere.Sphere", "/Engine/EditorMeshes/EditorSphere.EditorSphere" }) do
        pcall(function() mesh = StaticFindObject(p) end)
        if not Valid(mesh) then mesh = LoadAsset(p) end
        if Valid(mesh) then break end
    end
    if not Valid(mesh) then fail(); return end
    local st = MakeStudio(); if not st then fail(); return end
    local world, krl = World(), KRL()
    local cx, cy, cz = ViewLocation()
    local base = { X = cx, Y = cy, Z = cz + 60000 }
    local sc = st.mesh.StaticMeshComponent
    sc:SetStaticMesh(mesh)
    pcall(function() sc:SetMaterial(0, mat) end)
    local hit = {}
    st.mesh:K2_SetActorLocationAndRotation(base, Rot(0, 0, 0), false, hit, true)
    local cxm, cym, czm, r = base.X, base.Y, base.Z, 50
    pcall(function()
        local b = mesh:GetBounds()
        if b and b.Origin and b.SphereRadius then cxm, cym, czm = base.X + b.Origin.X, base.Y + b.Origin.Y, base.Z + b.Origin.Z; r = math.max(1, b.SphereRadius) end
    end)
    local dist = r / math.sin(math.rad(15)) * 1.05
    local yaw, pitch = math.rad(180), math.rad(-10)
    local dx, dy, dz = math.cos(pitch) * math.cos(yaw), math.cos(pitch) * math.sin(yaw), math.sin(pitch)
    local camLoc = { X = cxm - dx * dist, Y = cym - dy * dist, Z = czm - dz * dist }
    st.cam:K2_SetActorLocationAndRotation(camLoc, Rot(math.deg(pitch), math.deg(yaw), 0), false, hit, true)
    local spots = { { side = 0.7, up = 0.9, k = 1.0 }, { side = -0.9, up = 0.2, k = 0.35 } }
    local dm = dist / 100
    for i, l in ipairs(st.lights or {}) do
        local sp = spots[i]
        local rx, ry = -dy, dx
        local ll = { X = camLoc.X + (rx * sp.side) * dist, Y = camLoc.Y + (ry * sp.side) * dist, Z = camLoc.Z + sp.up * dist }
        pcall(function() l:K2_SetActorLocation(ll, false, hit, true) end)
        pcall(function() local lc = l.PointLightComponent; lc:SetAttenuationRadius(dist * 4); lc:SetIntensity(3000 * dm * dm * sp.k) end)
    end
    local cc = st.cam.CaptureComponent2D
    st.mesh:SetActorHiddenInGame(false)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        pcall(function() cc.CaptureSource = 2 end)
        cc:CaptureScene()
        krl:ExportRenderTarget(world, st.rt, dir, id .. ".png")
    end)
    st.mesh:SetActorHiddenInGame(true)
    pcall(function() sc:SetMaterial(0, nil) end)
    if not ok then fail() end
end

-- "Export texture" for a texture the game made from a picture file (an imported model's own textures): copy that
-- file into the export folder. arg: texture path \t destination without extension
handlers.ed_texcopy = function(arg)
    local tp, dest = (arg or ""):match("^([^\t]+)\t(.+)$")
    if not tp then return end
    local src = E.TextureSource and E.TextureSource(tp)
    if not src then Msg("Can't export that texture: the game made it and there's no file behind it.", true); return end
    local ext = src:match("(%.[%w]+)$") or ".png"
    local fi = io.open(src, "rb"); if not fi then Msg("Couldn't read " .. src, true); return end
    local data = fi:read("*a"); fi:close()
    local fo = io.open(dest .. ext, "wb"); if not fo then Msg("Couldn't write " .. dest .. ext, true); return end
    fo:write(data); fo:close()
    Msg("Exported texture: " .. (dest .. ext):match("([^\\/]+)$"))
end
-- every texture / material loaded in the game right now (for the pickers)
handlers.ed_texlist = function()
    local lines, n = {}, 0
    for _, t in ipairs(FindAllOf("Texture2D") or {}) do
        if n >= 30000 then break end
        local p = ObjectPath(t)
        if p ~= "" and p:sub(1, 1) == "/" and not p:find(":", 1, true) then
            local w, h = 0, 0
            pcall(function() w = t:Blueprint_GetSizeX(); h = t:Blueprint_GetSizeY() end)
            n = n + 1; lines[n] = string.format("%s\t%d\t%d", p, tonumber(w) or 0, tonumber(h) or 0)
        end
    end
    table.sort(lines)
    WriteFile(Dir .. "textures.txt", table.concat(lines, "\n") .. "\n")
end
handlers.ed_matlist = function()
    local lines, n = {}, 0
    for _, cls in ipairs({ "MaterialInstanceConstant", "Material" }) do
        for _, m in ipairs(FindAllOf(cls) or {}) do
            if n >= 40000 then break end
            local p = ObjectPath(m)
            if p ~= "" and p:sub(1, 1) == "/" and not p:find(":", 1, true) then n = n + 1; lines[n] = p .. "\t" .. (cls == "Material" and "m" or "i") end
        end
    end
    table.sort(lines)
    WriteFile(Dir .. "materiallist.txt", table.concat(lines, "\n") .. "\n")
end
end)()

-- Game objects remembered for reuse belong to the level they were found in: when another level loads, Unreal frees
-- the ones nothing else uses (a material only that level used, textures made from files, parts of objects), and using
-- a freed one crashes the game. So they're all forgotten on every level change (and found again when needed).
function E.ForgetLevelObjects()
    origCache, texPick, micList, slotCache, texCache = {}, {}, nil, {}, {}
    Models.live, Models.order = {}, {}
    if E.MatsMapChanged then pcall(E.MatsMapChanged) end
end
function E.OnMapChanged()
    pcall(E.ForgetLevelObjects)
    Undo.stack, Undo.lastPath, E.softDeleted = {}, nil, {}
    selected, selectedPath, actorCache, camPC = nil, "", {}, nil
    look = nil
    madeMovable, warnedStuck, inputLocked, studio, thumbQ, thumbPending = {}, {}, nil, nil, {}, false
    if E.open then ExecuteInGameThread(function() pcall(LockGameInput, true) end) end
end

function E.Init(bridgeDir, freecam) Dir, Freecam = bridgeDir, freecam end

return E
```

`bundle/Mods/LauncherBridge/Scripts/fast.lua`:

```lua
-- Fast lookups for the local player controller and world.
-- FindAllOf goes through every object in the game. In a big game (Hogwarts Legacy has about two million objects)
-- one call can take tens of milliseconds, so doing it every frame or every second made the game stutter.
-- Here the controller comes straight from the engine: GameEngine -> GameInstance -> LocalPlayers[1] -> PlayerController.
local UEHelpers = require("UEHelpers")
local M = {}

local function Valid(o)
    if o == nil then return false end
    local ok, v = pcall(function() return o:IsValid() end)
    return ok and v == true
end
M.Valid = Valid

local slowGetPC = UEHelpers.GetPlayerController    -- UE4SS's version (searches every object)
local engine = nil
local fallbackPC, fallbackAt = nil, -100

local function Engine()
    if Valid(engine) then return engine end
    local e = FindFirstOf("GameEngine")
    if not Valid(e) then e = FindFirstOf("Engine") end
    engine = e
    return Valid(e) and e or nil
end

-- The controller that owns the local player right now (the debug camera's controller while that camera is on).
function M.LocalPC()
    local ok, pc = pcall(function()
        local e = Engine(); if not e then return nil end
        local gi = e.GameInstance
        if not Valid(gi) then return nil end
        local lps = gi.LocalPlayers
        local lp = lps[1]
        if not Valid(lp) then return nil end
        return lp.PlayerController
    end)
    if ok and Valid(pc) then return pc end
    -- engine path not available in this game: search, but at most every 2 seconds, and keep the answer
    if Valid(fallbackPC) then return fallbackPC end
    if os.clock() - fallbackAt < 2 then return nil end
    fallbackAt = os.clock()
    local s = slowGetPC()
    fallbackPC = Valid(s) and s or nil
    return fallbackPC
end

function M.IsDebugPC(pc)
    if not Valid(pc) then return false end
    local ok, n = pcall(function() return pc:GetClass():GetFName():ToString() end)
    return ok and type(n) == "string" and n:find("DebugCamera") ~= nil
end

-- The real player's controller (not the debug camera's).
function M.PlayerPC()
    local pc = M.LocalPC()
    if M.IsDebugPC(pc) then
        local ok, orig = pcall(function() return pc.OriginalControllerRef end)
        if ok and Valid(orig) then return orig end
        return nil
    end
    return pc
end

-- How long UE4SS's own search takes in this game (for the perf test)
function M.SlowSearch() return slowGetPC() end

-- Make UE4SS's helpers fast for this mod too (GetWorld uses GetPlayerController)
UEHelpers.GetPlayerController = function()
    local pc = M.LocalPC()
    if pc then return pc end
    return CreateInvalidObject()
end

return M

```

`bundle/Mods/LauncherBridge/Scripts/freecam.lua`:

```lua
-- Freecam for any Unreal Engine game.
-- 1) Unreal's own debug camera (CheatManager:ToggleDebugCamera) - full mouse/WASD flying, built into most games.
-- 2) If a game has that compiled out, a simple built-in freecam: spawns a CameraActor, views through it and
--    flies it with WASD / mouse / arrow keys. Every engine call uses exactly the parameter types it expects.
local UEHelpers = require("UEHelpers")

local F = {}
F.cfg = { enabled = true, key = "INS", mode = "auto", hideText = true, speed = 1.0 }
F.active = false
F.kind = "off"            -- "debug" | "builtin" | "off"
F.camText = ""            -- "x,y,z" of the current view
F.rotText = ""            -- "pitch,yaw"
F.speed = 1.0             -- current speed multiplier (shared by both camera types)
F.ext = false             -- flown by the launcher (in-game editor: controller / right mouse + WASD) instead of keys
F.dir = nil               -- bridge folder (set by main.lua), where the launcher writes fly.txt
local MIN_SPEED, MAX_SPEED = 0.05, 50
local lastCfgSpeed = nil  -- last speed read from the launcher's config

local state = {}
local debugUnavailable = false
local mouseOK = true

local function Log(m) print("[LauncherBridge] [Freecam] " .. tostring(m) .. "\n") end
local function Valid(o)
    if o == nil then return false end
    local ok, v = pcall(function() return o:IsValid() end)
    return ok and v == true
end
local function FN(s) return UEHelpers.FindOrAddFName(s) end
local function Vec(x, y, z) return { X = x, Y = y, Z = z } end
local function Rot(p, y, r) return { Pitch = p, Yaw = y, Roll = r } end

-- The controller that currently owns the local player (switches to the DebugCameraController while it's active).
local Fast = require("fast")
function F.ActivePC()
    return Fast.LocalPC()      -- straight from the engine (searching every object made big games stutter)
end

local function IsDebugController(pc)
    if not Valid(pc) then return false end
    local ok, n = pcall(function() return pc:GetClass():GetFName():ToString() end)
    return ok and type(n) == "string" and n:find("DebugCamera") ~= nil
end

local function EnsureCheatManager(pc)
    local cm = pc.CheatManager
    if Valid(cm) then return cm end
    local cls = pc.CheatClass
    if not Valid(cls) then cls = StaticFindObject("/Script/Engine.CheatManager") end
    if not Valid(cls) then return nil end
    cm = StaticConstructObject(cls, pc)
    if Valid(cm) then pc.CheatManager = cm; return cm end
    return nil
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- speed
local baseMove = nil  -- spectator pawn's original movement values (for games without SetPawnMovementSpeedScale)

local function ApplyDebugSpeed(dcc, scale)
    if not Valid(dcc) then return false end
    -- UE 4.25+: one call does it (also used by the mouse wheel)
    if pcall(function() dcc:SetPawnMovementSpeedScale(scale) end) then return true end
    -- older engines: scale the spectator pawn's movement component directly
    local ok = pcall(function()
        dcc.SpeedScale = scale
        local pawn = dcc.Pawn
        if not Valid(pawn) then pawn = dcc:GetSpectatorPawn() end
        local mc = pawn.MovementComponent
        if not Valid(mc) then return end
        if not baseMove then baseMove = { mc.MaxSpeed, mc.Acceleration, mc.Deceleration } end
        mc.MaxSpeed, mc.Acceleration, mc.Deceleration = baseMove[1] * scale, baseMove[2] * scale, baseMove[3] * scale
    end)
    return ok
end

local function DebugController()
    local pc = F.ActivePC()
    if Valid(pc) then
        local ok, n = pcall(function() return pc:GetClass():GetFName():ToString() end)
        if ok and type(n) == "string" and n:find("DebugCamera") then return pc end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Sets the speed for whichever freecam is running (game thread).
function F.SetSpeed(v)
    F.speed = math.max(MIN_SPEED, math.min(MAX_SPEED, v))
    if F.active and F.kind == "debug" then ApplyDebugSpeed(DebugController(), F.speed) end
    return F.speed
end

function F.ChangeSpeed(factor)
    if not F.active then return end
    local v = F.SetSpeed(F.speed * factor)
    Log(string.format("Speed %.2fx", v))
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1) Unreal debug camera
local function DebugCamOn()
    local pc = F.ActivePC()
    if not Valid(pc) then return false, "No player yet - load into the game first." end
    local cm = EnsureCheatManager(pc)
    if not cm then return false, "Couldn't create a CheatManager." end
    local ok, err = pcall(function() cm:ToggleDebugCamera() end)
    if not ok then return false, tostring(err) end
    local now = F.ActivePC()
    if IsDebugController(now) then
        if F.cfg.hideText then pcall(function() now:ToggleDisplay() end) end
        baseMove = nil
        ApplyDebugSpeed(now, F.speed)
        return true
    end
    return false, "unavailable"
end

local function DebugCamOff()
    local pc = F.ActivePC()
    if not IsDebugController(pc) then return true end
    local cm = EnsureCheatManager(pc)
    if cm then pcall(function() cm:ToggleDebugCamera() end) end
    if IsDebugController(F.ActivePC()) then
        pcall(function() UEHelpers.GetKismetSystemLibrary():ExecuteConsoleCommand(pc:GetWorld(), "ToggleDebugCamera", pc) end)
    end
    return not IsDebugController(F.ActivePC())
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2) built-in simple freecam
local keys = {}
local function K(name)
    if not keys[name] then keys[name] = { KeyName = FN(name) } end
    return keys[name]
end

local function BuiltinOn()
    local pc = F.ActivePC()
    if not Valid(pc) then return false, "No player yet - load into the game first." end
    local pcm = pc.PlayerCameraManager
    if not Valid(pcm) then return false, "The game has no camera manager right now." end
    local loc, rot = pcm:GetCameraLocation(), pcm:GetCameraRotation()
    state.x, state.y, state.z = loc.X, loc.Y, loc.Z
    state.pitch, state.yaw = rot.Pitch, rot.Yaw
    local cls = StaticFindObject("/Script/Engine.CameraActor")
    if not Valid(cls) then return false, "CameraActor class not found." end
    local world = pc:GetWorld()
    local loc, rot = Vec(state.x, state.y, state.z), Rot(state.pitch, state.yaw, 0)
    local okS, cam = pcall(function() return world:SpawnActor(cls, loc, rot) end)
    if not (okS and Valid(cam)) then
        -- the engine's own spawn (works where UE4SS's SpawnActor isn't available)
        local gs = StaticFindObject("/Script/Engine.Default__GameplayStatics")
        local tf = { Translation = loc, Rotation = { X = 0, Y = 0, Z = 0, W = 1 }, Scale3D = Vec(1, 1, 1) }
        okS, cam = pcall(function() return gs:BeginDeferredActorSpawnFromClass(world, cls, tf, 1, nil) end)
        if okS and Valid(cam) then pcall(function() gs:FinishSpawningActor(cam, tf) end) end
    end
    if not Valid(cam) then return false, "Couldn't spawn a camera." end
    pcall(function() cam:K2_TeleportTo(loc, rot) end)
    state.cam, state.pc = cam, pc
    local okT, tgt = pcall(function() return pc:GetViewTarget() end)
    state.oldTarget = okT and tgt or nil
    pcall(function() pc:SetIgnoreMoveInput(true) end)
    pcall(function() pc:SetIgnoreLookInput(true) end)
    pc:SetViewTargetWithBlend(cam, 0.0, 0, 0.0, false)
    return true
end

local function BuiltinOff()
    local pc = state.pc
    if Valid(pc) then
        pcall(function() pc:SetIgnoreMoveInput(false) end)
        pcall(function() pc:SetIgnoreLookInput(false) end)
        local target = Valid(state.oldTarget) and state.oldTarget or pc.Pawn
        if Valid(target) then pcall(function() pc:SetViewTargetWithBlend(target, 0.0, 0, 0.0, false) end) end
    end
    if Valid(state.cam) then pcall(function() state.cam:K2_DestroyActor() end) end
    state = {}
    return true
end

-- Launcher-driven flying: fly.txt = "seq yawTotal pitchTotal forward right up speed"
-- (look totals only ever grow, so a missed update loses nothing; movement is a -1..1 stick value per axis)
local ext = { seq = -1, yaw = nil, pitch = nil, f = 0, r = 0, u = 0, speed = 1, at = 0 }
local function ReadExt()
    if not F.dir then return end
    local fh = io.open(F.dir .. "fly.txt", "r"); if not fh then return end
    local line = fh:read("*l"); fh:close()
    if not line then return end
    local seq, yw, pt, f, r, u, sp = line:match("^(%d+) (%S+) (%S+) (%S+) (%S+) (%S+) (%S+)")
    seq = tonumber(seq); if not seq then return end
    yw, pt = tonumber(yw), tonumber(pt)
    if seq ~= ext.seq then
        if ext.yaw and yw and pt then              -- new look input goes to where the camera is heading
            state.tyaw = (state.tyaw or state.yaw) + (yw - ext.yaw)
            state.tpitch = math.max(-89, math.min(89, (state.tpitch or state.pitch) + (pt - ext.pitch)))
        end
        ext.seq, ext.yaw, ext.pitch = seq, yw, pt
        ext.f, ext.r, ext.u, ext.speed = tonumber(f) or 0, tonumber(r) or 0, tonumber(u) or 0, tonumber(sp) or 1
        ext.at = os.clock()
    end
end

-- One smooth step of the launcher-flown camera: turning eases towards where you're looking (no stepping),
-- and movement speeds up / slows down over a fraction of a second instead of starting and stopping dead.
local LOOK_SMOOTH, MOVE_SMOOTH = 0.06, 0.14        -- seconds
local function ExtStep(dt)
    ReadExt()
    local now = os.clock()
    local stale = (now - ext.at) > 0.3             -- launcher stopped sending: glide to a stop
    local f, r, u = stale and 0 or ext.f, stale and 0 or ext.r, stale and 0 or ext.u
    state.tyaw = state.tyaw or state.yaw
    state.tpitch = state.tpitch or state.pitch
    local kl = 1 - math.exp(-dt / LOOK_SMOOTH)
    state.yaw = state.yaw + (state.tyaw - state.yaw) * kl
    state.pitch = math.max(-89, math.min(89, state.pitch + (state.tpitch - state.pitch) * kl))
    local p, y = math.rad(state.pitch), math.rad(state.yaw)
    local fx, fy, fz = math.cos(p) * math.cos(y), math.cos(p) * math.sin(y), math.sin(p)
    local rx, ry = -math.sin(y), math.cos(y)
    local sp = 1200 * ext.speed
    local wx, wy, wz = (fx * f + rx * r) * sp, (fy * f + ry * r) * sp, (fz * f + u) * sp
    state.vx, state.vy, state.vz = state.vx or 0, state.vy or 0, state.vz or 0
    local km = 1 - math.exp(-dt / MOVE_SMOOTH)
    state.vx = state.vx + (wx - state.vx) * km
    state.vy = state.vy + (wy - state.vy) * km
    state.vz = state.vz + (wz - state.vz) * km
    state.x, state.y, state.z = state.x + state.vx * dt, state.y + state.vy * dt, state.z + state.vz * dt
end

local updating = false
local lastClock = nil
local function BuiltinUpdate(dt)
    local pc, cam = state.pc, state.cam
    if not Valid(pc) or not Valid(cam) then F.active = false; F.kind = "off"; state = {}; return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if lastClock then
        if now - lastClock < 0.0005 then return end   -- already stepped this frame
        dt = math.min(0.1, now - lastClock)
    end
    lastClock = now
    if F.ext then
        ExtStep(dt)
        pcall(function() cam:K2_TeleportTo(Vec(state.x, state.y, state.z), Rot(state.pitch, state.yaw, 0)) end)
        return
    end
    local function down(k)
        local ok, v = pcall(function() return pc:IsInputKeyDown(K(k)) end)
        return ok and v == true
    end
    -- look: mouse (if the game reports it) and arrow keys
    if mouseOK then
        local t = {}
        local ok = pcall(function() pc:GetInputMouseDelta(t, t) end)
        if ok and type(t.DeltaX) == "number" then
            state.yaw = state.yaw + t.DeltaX * 2.5
            state.pitch = state.pitch + t.DeltaY * 2.5
        else mouseOK = false end
    end
    local turn = 90 * dt
    if down("Left") then state.yaw = state.yaw - turn end
    if down("Right") then state.yaw = state.yaw + turn end
    if down("Up") then state.pitch = state.pitch + turn end
    if down("Down") then state.pitch = state.pitch - turn end
    state.pitch = math.max(-89, math.min(89, state.pitch))
    -- move
    local speed = 1200 * F.speed * dt
    if down("LeftShift") then speed = speed * 4 end
    if down("LeftControl") then speed = speed * 0.25 end
    local p, y = math.rad(state.pitch), math.rad(state.yaw)
    local fx, fy, fz = math.cos(p) * math.cos(y), math.cos(p) * math.sin(y), math.sin(p)
    local rx, ry = -math.sin(y), math.cos(y)
    local mx, my, mz = 0, 0, 0
    if down("W") then mx, my, mz = mx + fx, my + fy, mz + fz end
    if down("S") then mx, my, mz = mx - fx, my - fy, mz - fz end
    if down("D") then mx, my = mx + rx, my + ry end
    if down("A") then mx, my = mx - rx, my - ry end
    if down("E") or down("SpaceBar") then mz = mz + 1 end
    if down("Q") then mz = mz - 1 end
    state.x, state.y, state.z = state.x + mx * speed, state.y + my * speed, state.z + mz * speed
    pcall(function() cam:K2_TeleportTo(Vec(state.x, state.y, state.z), Rot(state.pitch, state.yaw, 0)) end)
end

-- Launcher-driven flying of Unreal's debug camera: we move its spectator pawn and set its look direction
-- ourselves (its own keyboard / mouse / controller input is held back by the editor while it's open).
local dbgReady = false
local dbgLast = nil
local dbgPcm = nil
local diag = { at = 0, frames = 0, moved = 0, turned = 0, maxd = 0, maxa = 0 }
local CalmDebugCam, RestoreCalm
local calmed = {}            -- what CalmDebugCam changed, put back by RestoreCalm
local function Kismet() return UEHelpers.GetKismetSystemLibrary() end
-- Makes the editing camera steady: no game camera shakes / effects on it, its own input held back, and the
-- game's motion blur off while flying it (like Unreal's editor viewport). Everything is put back afterwards.
CalmDebugCam = function(dcc, pawn)
    RestoreCalm()
    dbgPcm = nil
    pcall(function() dbgPcm = dcc.PlayerCameraManager end)
    local info = {}
    pcall(function() info[#info + 1] = "controller " .. dcc:GetClass():GetFName():ToString() end)
    pcall(function() info[#info + 1] = "pawn " .. pawn:GetClass():GetFName():ToString() end)
    if Valid(dbgPcm) then
        pcall(function() info[#info + 1] = "camera manager " .. dbgPcm:GetClass():GetFName():ToString() end)
        -- camera modifiers only when the debug camera has its own camera manager (never touch the game's)
        local gamePcm = nil
        pcall(function() local o = dcc.OriginalControllerRef; if Valid(o) then gamePcm = o.PlayerCameraManager end end)
        local shared = Valid(gamePcm) and gamePcm:GetFullName() == dbgPcm:GetFullName()
        if not shared then
            local n = 0
            pcall(function()
                dbgPcm.ModifierList:ForEach(function(_, m)
                    local mod = m:get()
                    if Valid(mod) then pcall(function() mod:DisableModifier(true) end); n = n + 1 end
                end)
            end)
            if n > 0 then info[#info + 1] = n .. " camera modifiers off" end
        end
        pcall(function() dbgPcm:StopAllCameraShakes(true) end)
    end
    pcall(function() if not dcc:IsLookInputIgnored() then dcc:SetIgnoreLookInput(true) end end)
    pcall(function() if not dcc:IsMoveInputIgnored() then dcc:SetIgnoreMoveInput(true) end end)
    -- the game's motion blur and depth of field (South of Midnight blurs everything not near the player) off
    -- while flying, like Unreal's editor viewport; put back to what they were afterwards
    calmed.cvars = {}
    local pcArg = nil
    pcall(function() pcArg = dcc end)
    for _, cv in ipairs({ { "r.MotionBlurQuality", 4 }, { "r.DepthOfFieldQuality", 2 } }) do
        local was = nil
        pcall(function() was = Kismet():GetConsoleVariableIntValue(cv[1]) end)
        if type(was) ~= "number" then was = cv[2] end
        if was ~= 0 then
            local ok = pcall(function() Kismet():ExecuteConsoleCommand(dcc:GetWorld(), cv[1] .. " 0", pcArg) end)
            local now = "?"
            pcall(function() now = tostring(Kismet():GetConsoleVariableIntValue(cv[1])) end)
            if ok then calmed.cvars[#calmed.cvars + 1] = { cv[1], was }; info[#info + 1] = cv[1] .. " " .. was .. " -> " .. now end
        end
    end
    -- and in case the game won't take those commands: a post-process volume over the whole level that turns
    -- motion blur and depth of field off (removed again when the editor closes)
    pcall(function()
        local cls = StaticFindObject("/Script/Engine.PostProcessVolume")
        if not Valid(cls) then return end
        local w = dcc:GetWorld()
        local l = pawn:K2_GetActorLocation()
        -- set up before it's finished spawning: the level keeps its volumes sorted by priority when they're added
        local function Setup(vol)
            vol.bUnbound = true
            vol.bEnabled = true
            vol.Priority = 1000000
            vol.BlendWeight = 1.0
            local st = vol.Settings
            st.bOverride_MotionBlurAmount = true;          st.MotionBlurAmount = 0.0
            st.bOverride_MotionBlurMax = true;             st.MotionBlurMax = 0.0
            st.bOverride_DepthOfFieldFocalDistance = true; st.DepthOfFieldFocalDistance = 0.0
            st.bOverride_DepthOfFieldFstop = true;         st.DepthOfFieldFstop = 32.0
            st.bOverride_DepthOfFieldMinFstop = true;      st.DepthOfFieldMinFstop = 32.0
            st.bOverride_DepthOfFieldScale = true;         st.DepthOfFieldScale = 0.0
            st.bOverride_DepthOfFieldNearBlurSize = true;  st.DepthOfFieldNearBlurSize = 0.0
            st.bOverride_DepthOfFieldFarBlurSize = true;   st.DepthOfFieldFarBlurSize = 0.0
        end
        local vol = nil
        local gs = StaticFindObject("/Script/Engine.Default__GameplayStatics")
        local tf = { Translation = l, Rotation = { X = 0, Y = 0, Z = 0, W = 1 }, Scale3D = Vec(1, 1, 1) }
        pcall(function() vol = gs:BeginDeferredActorSpawnFromClass(w, cls, tf, 1, nil) end)
        local okS, eS = true, nil
        if Valid(vol) then
            okS, eS = pcall(Setup, vol)
            pcall(function() gs:FinishSpawningActor(vol, tf) end)
        else
            pcall(function() vol = w:SpawnActor(cls, l, Rot(0, 0, 0)) end)
            if Valid(vol) then okS, eS = pcall(Setup, vol) end
        end
        if not okS then info[#info + 1] = "blur volume setup: " .. tostring(eS) end
        if not Valid(vol) then info[#info + 1] = "no blur volume"; return end
        calmed.vol = vol
        info[#info + 1] = "blur volume on"
    end)
    pcall(function()
        calmed.cursor = dcc.bShowMouseCursor
        info[#info + 1] = "pointer " .. (calmed.cursor and "shown -> hidden" or "hidden")
        dcc.bShowMouseCursor = false
    end)
    calmed.dcc = dcc
    Log("editing camera: " .. table.concat(info, ", "))
end
RestoreCalm = function()
    if Valid(calmed.dcc) then
        pcall(function() calmed.dcc:ResetIgnoreLookInput() end)
        pcall(function() calmed.dcc:ResetIgnoreMoveInput() end)
        if calmed.cursor then pcall(function() calmed.dcc.bShowMouseCursor = true end) end
    end
    if Valid(calmed.vol) then pcall(function() calmed.vol:K2_DestroyActor() end) end
    for _, cv in ipairs(calmed.cvars or {}) do
        pcall(function()
            local pc = F.ActivePC()
            Kismet():ExecuteConsoleCommand(pc and pc:GetWorld() or nil, cv[1] .. " " .. cv[2], nil)
        end)
    end
    calmed = {}
end

local function Norm(a) a = a % 360; if a > 180 then a = a - 360 end; return a end
local function DebugExtUpdate()
    local dcc = DebugController()
    if not Valid(dcc) then return end
    local pawn = nil
    pcall(function() pawn = dcc.Pawn end)
    if not Valid(pawn) then pcall(function() pawn = dcc:GetSpectatorPawn() end) end
    if not Valid(pawn) then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if not dbgReady then
        CalmDebugCam(dcc, pawn)
        local l = pawn:K2_GetActorLocation()
        local r = dcc:GetControlRotation()
        state.x, state.y, state.z = l.X, l.Y, l.Z
        state.pitch, state.yaw = Norm(r.Pitch), r.Yaw
        state.tyaw, state.tpitch, state.vx, state.vy, state.vz = nil, nil, 0, 0, 0
        dbgReady, dbgLast = true, now
        diag.x = nil
        ext.seq, ext.yaw, ext.pitch = -1, nil, nil
    end
    local dt = math.min(0.1, math.max(0, now - (dbgLast or now))); dbgLast = now
    if dt <= 0 then return end
    -- check whether something else moved / turned the camera since our last frame (logged every few seconds)
    if diag.x then
        pcall(function()
            local l, r = pawn:K2_GetActorLocation(), dcc:GetControlRotation()
            local d = math.sqrt((l.X - diag.x) ^ 2 + (l.Y - diag.y) ^ 2 + (l.Z - diag.z) ^ 2)
            local a = math.max(math.abs(Norm(r.Yaw - diag.yaw)), math.abs(Norm(r.Pitch - diag.pitch)))
            if d > 0.5 then diag.moved = diag.moved + 1; diag.maxd = math.max(diag.maxd, d) end
            if a > 0.05 then diag.turned = diag.turned + 1; diag.maxa = math.max(diag.maxa, a) end
        end)
    end
    diag.frames = diag.frames + 1
    if now - diag.at > 3 then
        if diag.moved > 0 or diag.turned > 0 then
            Log(string.format("editing camera: %d frames, moved by the game %d times (up to %.0f), turned by the game %d times (up to %.1f deg)",
                diag.frames, diag.moved, diag.maxd, diag.turned, diag.maxa))
        end
        diag.at, diag.frames, diag.moved, diag.turned, diag.maxd, diag.maxa = now, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    end
    ExtStep(dt)
    local hit = {}
    pcall(function() pawn:K2_SetActorLocation(Vec(state.x, state.y, state.z), false, hit, true) end)
    pcall(function() dcc:SetControlRotation(Rot(state.pitch, state.yaw, 0)) end)
    diag.x, diag.y, diag.z, diag.yaw, diag.pitch = state.x, state.y, state.z, state.yaw, state.pitch
    -- some games (South of Midnight) keep shaking the camera and feed their own mouse / stick look into the
    -- debug camera too, so the view wobbles between the two: keep both held back every frame
    -- (these are counters in Unreal, so only add one when it isn't held back already)
    pcall(function() if not dcc:IsLookInputIgnored() then dcc:SetIgnoreLookInput(true) end end)
    pcall(function() if not dcc:IsMoveInputIgnored() then dcc:SetIgnoreMoveInput(true) end end)
    if Valid(dbgPcm) then pcall(function() dbgPcm:StopAllCameraShakes(true) end) end
    -- South of Midnight's debug camera shows the game's hand pointer and steers the view with it: keep it hidden
    -- (Unreal's normal debug camera has no pointer, and then the editor holds back its mouse look)
    pcall(function() if dcc.bShowMouseCursor then dcc.bShowMouseCursor = false end end)
    pcall(function() if dcc.bEnableMouseOverEvents then dcc.bEnableMouseOverEvents = false end end)
    pcall(function() if dcc.bEnableClickEvents then dcc.bEnableClickEvents = false end end)
end
-- Unreal's F key: put the flying camera in front of a point, looking at it the way it looks now, dist away
function F.FocusOn(x, y, z, dist)
    if not F.active or not state.x then return false end
    local p, yw = math.rad(state.pitch or 0), math.rad(state.yaw or 0)
    local fx, fy, fz = math.cos(p) * math.cos(yw), math.cos(p) * math.sin(yw), math.sin(p)
    state.x, state.y, state.z = x - fx * dist, y - fy * dist, z - fz * dist
    state.vx, state.vy, state.vz = 0, 0, 0
    return true
end
-- the launcher stopped flying the camera (editor closed, freecam stays on): give it back its own input / blur
function F.EndExt()
    pcall(RestoreCalm)
    dbgReady = false
end
function F.ResetExt()
    dbgReady = false; ext.seq, ext.yaw, ext.pitch = -1, nil, nil
    state.tyaw, state.tpitch, state.vx, state.vy, state.vz = nil, nil, 0, 0, 0
end

-- Called every frame from main.lua's single game-thread job.
F.hooked = false            -- true once Unreal's per-frame camera update is driving us
function F.Frame()
    if not F.active then return end
    if F.kind == "builtin" then pcall(BuiltinUpdate, 1 / 60)
    elseif F.kind == "debug" and F.ext then
        local ok, err = pcall(DebugExtUpdate)
        if not ok then Log("editing camera: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- public API (call from the game thread)
function F.Toggle(want, forceKind)
    if want == nil then want = not F.active end
    if not want then
        if not F.active then return true, "Freecam is already off." end
        if F.kind == "debug" then DebugCamOff() else BuiltinOff() end
        pcall(RestoreCalm)
        dbgReady = false
        F.active, F.kind = false, "off"
        return true, "Freecam off"
    end
    if F.active then return true, "Freecam is already on." end
    local order
    if forceKind then order = { forceKind }
    elseif F.cfg.mode == "debug" then order = { "debug" }
    elseif F.cfg.mode == "builtin" then order = { "builtin" }
    else order = debugUnavailable and { "builtin" } or { "debug", "builtin" } end
    local lastErr = "Couldn't start freecam."
    for _, kind in ipairs(order) do
        local ok, a, b = pcall(kind == "debug" and DebugCamOn or BuiltinOn)
        if ok and a then
            F.active, F.kind = true, kind
            mouseOK = true
            ext.seq, ext.yaw, ext.pitch = -1, nil, nil
            state.tyaw, state.tpitch, state.vx, state.vy, state.vz = nil, nil, 0, 0, 0
            lastClock = nil
            return true, kind == "debug" and "Freecam on (Unreal debug camera)" or "Freecam on (simple freecam)"
        end
        local err = ok and b or a
        if kind == "debug" and err == "unavailable" then
            debugUnavailable = true
            err = "This game has Unreal's debug camera removed."
        end
        lastErr = tostring(err)
    end
    return false, lastErr
end

-- Moves the player character to where the camera is, then turns freecam off.
function F.TeleportPlayer()
    if not F.active then return false, "Turn freecam on and fly to where you want to go first." end
    local x, y, z, yaw
    if F.kind == "builtin" then
        x, y, z, yaw = state.x, state.y, state.z, state.yaw
    else
        local pc = F.ActivePC()
        local pcm = pc.PlayerCameraManager
        local l, r = pcm:GetCameraLocation(), pcm:GetCameraRotation()
        x, y, z, yaw = l.X, l.Y, l.Z, r.Yaw
    end
    F.Toggle(false)
    ExecuteInGameThread(function()
        local pawn = UEHelpers.GetPlayer()
        if not Valid(pawn) then Log("No player character to teleport."); return end
        local ok = pcall(function() pawn:K2_TeleportTo(Vec(x, y, z), Rot(0, yaw, 0)) end)
        Log(ok and string.format("Teleported player to %.0f, %.0f, %.0f", x, y, z) or "Teleport failed")
    end)
    return true, string.format("Teleporting player to %.0f, %.0f, %.0f", x, y, z)
end

-- Refreshes F.camText / F.rotText (game thread).
function F.UpdateCameraInfo()
    if F.active and F.kind == "debug" then
        local dcc = DebugController()
        if dcc then
            local ok, sc = pcall(function() return dcc.SpeedScale end)
            if ok and type(sc) == "number" and sc > 0 then F.speed = sc end
        end
    end
    if F.active and F.kind == "builtin" and state.x then
        F.camText = string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", state.x, state.y, state.z)
        F.rotText = string.format("%.1f,%.1f", state.pitch, state.yaw)
        return
    end
    local pc = F.ActivePC()
    if not Valid(pc) then F.camText, F.rotText = "", ""; return end
    local pcm = pc.PlayerCameraManager
    if not Valid(pcm) then return end
    local ok, l = pcall(function() return pcm:GetCameraLocation() end)
    local ok2, r = pcall(function() return pcm:GetCameraRotation() end)
    if ok and l then F.camText = string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", l.X, l.Y, l.Z) end
    if ok2 and r then F.rotText = string.format("%.1f,%.1f", r.Pitch, r.Yaw) end
end

-- A new level destroys our camera / the debug controller.
function F.OnMapChanged()
    F.active, F.kind = false, "off"
    state = {}
end

function F.ApplyConfig(text)
    for k, v in string.gmatch(text or "", "([%w_]+)=([^\r\n]*)") do
        if k == "enabled" then F.cfg.enabled = (v == "1")
        elseif k == "key" then F.cfg.key = v
        elseif k == "mode" then F.cfg.mode = v
        elseif k == "hidetext" then F.cfg.hideText = (v == "1")
        elseif k == "speed" then
            local sp = tonumber(v) or 1.0
            F.cfg.speed = sp
            if lastCfgSpeed == nil or math.abs(sp - lastCfgSpeed) > 0.001 then
                lastCfgSpeed = sp
                if math.abs(sp - F.speed) > 0.001 then ExecuteInGameThread(function() F.SetSpeed(sp) end) end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Speed keys while freecam is on: + / - (main keyboard or numpad)
function F.RegisterSpeedKeys()
    local function bind(name, factor)
        if Key[name] then
            RegisterKeyBind(Key[name], function()
                if F.active then ExecuteInGameThread(function() F.ChangeSpeed(factor) end) end
            end)
        end
    end
    bind("OEM_PLUS", 1.5); bind("ADD", 1.5)
    bind("OEM_MINUS", 1 / 1.5); bind("SUBTRACT", 1 / 1.5)
end

-- Hotkeys: register every allowed key once and react only to the one chosen in the launcher,
-- so changing the key takes effect without restarting the game.
F.HotkeyNames = { "INS", "HOME", "END", "DEL", "PAGE_UP", "PAGE_DOWN", "F5", "F6", "F7", "F8", "F9", "F11", "F12" }
function F.RegisterHotkeys()
    for _, name in ipairs(F.HotkeyNames) do
        local code = Key[name]
        if code then
            RegisterKeyBind(code, function()
                if F.cfg.enabled and F.cfg.key == name then
                    ExecuteInGameThread(function()
                        local ok, msg = F.Toggle()
                        Log(msg)
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

return F
```

`bundle/Mods/LauncherBridge/Scripts/main.lua`:

```lua
-- LauncherBridge: lets the UE4SS Launcher list this game's levels and switch between them.
-- It talks to the launcher through small text files in %TEMP%\UE4SS-LauncherBridge.
--   command.txt  (launcher -> game)  "<id>|<verb>|<arg>"   verbs: list, open, reload
--   result.txt   (game -> launcher)  "<id>|ok|<message>" or "<id>|error|<message>"
--   levels.txt   (game -> launcher)  one level package path per line
--   status.txt   (game -> launcher)  heartbeat with the current level

local UEHelpers = require("UEHelpers")
local Freecam = require("freecam")
local Editor = require("editor")

local function Log(msg) print("[LauncherBridge] " .. tostring(msg) .. "\n") end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- bridge folder
local function FindBridgeDir()
    local temp = os.getenv("TEMP") or os.getenv("TMP")
    if temp then
        local dir = temp .. "\\UE4SS-LauncherBridge\\"
        local probe = io.open(dir .. "probe.tmp", "w")   -- the launcher creates this folder
        if probe then probe:close(); os.remove(dir .. "probe.tmp"); return dir end
    end
    -- Fallback: a "bridge" folder next to this mod (shipped with it).
    for p in string.gmatch(package.path or "", "[^;]+") do
        local base = p:match("^(.-[/\\]LauncherBridge)[/\\]Scripts[/\\]")
        if base then return base .. "\\bridge\\" end
    end
    local src = debug.getinfo(1, "S").source:gsub("^@", "")
    local base = src:match("^(.-[/\\]LauncherBridge)[/\\]Scripts[/\\]")
    return (base or ".") .. "\\bridge\\"
end
local BridgeDir = FindBridgeDir()
Log("Using bridge folder " .. BridgeDir)

local function ReadFile(path)
    local f = io.open(path, "r")
    if not f then return nil end
    local d = f:read("a")
    f:close()
    return d
end
local function WriteFile(path, data)
    local tmp = path .. ".tmp"
    local f = io.open(tmp, "w")
    if not f then return false end
    f:write(data)
    f:close()
    os.remove(path)
    return os.rename(tmp, path)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
local function Str(v)
    if v == nil then return nil end
    if type(v) == "string" then return v end
    local ok, s = pcall(function() return v:ToString() end)
    if ok and s then return s end
    return tostring(v)
end
local function Field(obj, key)
    local ok, v = pcall(function() return obj[key] end)
    if ok then return v end
    return nil
end
-- Out-param array elements may come back as the struct itself or wrapped (needing :get()).
local function Unwrap(e)
    local direct = Field(e, "PackageName") or Field(e, "ObjectPath")
    if direct ~= nil then return e end
    local ok, g = pcall(function() return e:get() end)
    if ok and g ~= nil then return g end
    return e
end
local function FN(s) return UEHelpers.FindOrAddFName(s) end

-- "World /Game/Maps/Level01.Level01" -> "/Game/Maps/Level01"
local function PackageFromFullName(full)
    if not full then return nil end
    local path = full:match("^%S+%s+(%S+)") or full
    return path:match("^([^%.:]+)") or path
end

local CurrentMap = "unknown"
local function UpdateCurrentMap(world)
    local ok, full = pcall(function() return world:GetFullName() end)
    if ok and full then CurrentMap = PackageFromFullName(full) or CurrentMap end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- finding levels
local function GetAssetRegistry()
    local candidates = {}
    local helpers = StaticFindObject("/Script/AssetRegistry.Default__AssetRegistryHelpers")
    if helpers and helpers:IsValid() then
        local ok, reg = pcall(function() return helpers:GetAssetRegistry() end)
        if ok and reg and reg.IsValid and reg:IsValid() then table.insert(candidates, reg) end
    end
    local impl = StaticFindObject("/Script/AssetRegistry.Default__AssetRegistryImpl")
    if impl and impl:IsValid() then table.insert(candidates, impl) end
    return candidates
end

local function CollectWorlds(out, into, seen, needClassCheck)
    for _, e in ipairs(out) do
        local a = Unwrap(e)
        local pkg = Str(Field(a, "PackageName"))
        if not pkg or pkg == "" or pkg == "None" then
            pkg = PackageFromFullName(Str(Field(a, "ObjectPath")))
        end
        local isWorld = true
        if needClassCheck then
            local cls = Str(Field(a, "AssetClass"))
            if not cls or cls == "None" or cls == "" then
                local cp = Field(a, "AssetClassPath")
                cls = cp and Str(Field(cp, "AssetName")) or nil
            end
            isWorld = (cls == "World")
        end
        if isWorld and pkg and pkg ~= "" and pkg ~= "None" and not seen[pkg] then
            seen[pkg] = true
            table.insert(into, pkg)
        end
    end
end

-- The asset-registry query is only safe when we call it with exactly the parameter types the engine
-- expects. UE4SS doesn't type-check FName/struct parameters, so a mismatch can crash the game
-- (this happened on Stray / UE 4.27). We therefore only use the UE 5.1+ signature, and on older
-- engines fall back to the worlds already loaded (the launcher reads the rest from the .pak files).
local function RegistryIsSafe()
    local ok, below = pcall(function() return UnrealVersion.IsBelow(5, 1) end)
    return ok and below == false
end

local function FindLevels()
    local levels, seen, method = {}, {}, "none"
    local registries = RegistryIsSafe() and GetAssetRegistry() or {}
    for _, reg in ipairs(registries) do
        -- UE 5.1+: GetAssetsByClass(FTopLevelAssetPath, out, bSearchSubClasses)
        local out = {}
        local ok = pcall(function() reg:GetAssetsByClass({ PackageName = FN("/Script/Engine"), AssetName = FN("World") }, out, false) end)
        if ok and #out > 0 then CollectWorlds(out, levels, seen, false); method = "AssetRegistry (UE5)" end
        if #levels > 0 then break end
    end
    -- Always include worlds that are loaded in memory right now.
    local worlds = FindAllOf("World")
    if worlds then
        for _, w in ipairs(worlds) do
            local pkg = PackageFromFullName(Str(w:GetFullName()))
            if pkg and pkg:sub(1, 1) == "/" and not seen[pkg] and not pkg:find("/Temp/") then
                seen[pkg] = true
                table.insert(levels, pkg)
                if method == "none" then method = "loaded worlds only" end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(levels)
    return levels, method
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- commands
local function Reply(id, ok, msg)
    WriteFile(BridgeDir .. "result.txt", string.format("%s|%s|%s", id, ok and "ok" or "error", msg or ""))
end

local function OpenLevel(id, path)
    ExecuteInGameThread(function()
        local world = UEHelpers.GetWorld()
        if not world or not world:IsValid() then Reply(id, false, "No world is loaded yet."); return end
        Log("Opening level " .. path)
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            UEHelpers.GetGameplayStatics():OpenLevel(world, FN(path), true, "")
        end)
        if not ok then
            Log("OpenLevel failed (" .. tostring(err) .. "), trying the 'open' console command")
            ok, err = pcall(function()
                UEHelpers.GetKismetSystemLibrary():ExecuteConsoleCommand(world, "open " .. path, UEHelpers.GetPlayerController())
            end)
        end
        if ok then Reply(id, true, "Opening " .. path) else Reply(id, false, "Couldn't open " .. path .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
    end)
end

local function ListLevels(id)
    ExecuteInGameThread(function()
        local ok, levels, method = pcall(FindLevels)
        if not ok then Reply(id, false, "Level scan failed: " .. tostring(levels)); return end
        local data = "#method " .. method .. "\n" .. table.concat(levels, "\n") .. "\n"
        WriteFile(BridgeDir .. "levels.txt", data)
        Log(string.format("Found %d levels via %s", #levels, method))
        Reply(id, true, string.format("Found %d levels", #levels))
    end)
end

-- perf test: frame timing for N seconds with the old player lookup (a full object search once a second),
-- then N seconds with the new one. Written to perf.txt in the bridge folder.
local Fast = require("fast")
local perf = nil
function StartPerf(id, secs)
    perf = { id = id, secs = math.max(3, math.min(60, secs)), phase = 1, t0 = os.clock(), last = os.clock(), lastSlow = 0, d = { {}, {} }, slowMs = {} }
    Log("perf test started")
end
local function PerfTick()
    if not perf then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    table.insert(perf.d[perf.phase], (now - perf.last) * 1000); perf.last = now
    if perf.phase == 1 and now - perf.lastSlow >= 1 then
        perf.lastSlow = now
        local a = os.clock(); local _ = Fast.SlowSearch(); table.insert(perf.slowMs, (os.clock() - a) * 1000)
        perf.last = os.clock()
    elseif perf.phase == 2 and now - perf.lastSlow >= 1 then
        perf.lastSlow = now
        local a = os.clock(); local _ = Fast.LocalPC(); perf.fastMs = (os.clock() - a) * 1000
    end
    if now - perf.t0 >= perf.secs then
        if perf.phase == 1 then perf.phase = 2; perf.t0 = now; return end
        local function stats(t) local n, sum, mx, big = #t, 0, 0, 0; for _, v in ipairs(t) do sum = sum + v; if v > mx then mx = v end; if v > 50 then big = big + 1 end end
            return string.format("ticks=%d avg=%.1fms max=%.1fms over50ms=%d", n, n > 0 and sum / n or 0, mx, big) end
        local sm = 0; for _, v in ipairs(perf.slowMs) do sm = sm + v end
        local out = string.format("old: %s | full search avg %.1fms\nnew: %s | fast lookup %.3fms\nsaved changes: slowest put-back %.1fms, slowest single lookup %.1fms\n", stats(perf.d[1]), #perf.slowMs > 0 and sm / #perf.slowMs or 0, stats(perf.d[2]), perf.fastMs or -1, Editor.layMs or 0, Editor.lookMs or 0)
        Editor.layMs = 0; Editor.lookMs = 0
        WriteFile(BridgeDir .. "perf.txt", out)
        Reply(perf.id, true, out:gsub("\n", " / "))
        perf = nil
    end
end

local function HandleCommand(line)
    local id, verb, arg = line:match("^(%d+)|([%w_]+)|?(.*)$")
    if not id then return end
    arg = (arg or ""):gsub("[\r\n]", "")
    if Editor.Handle(verb, arg) then return end
    if verb == "perf" then StartPerf(id, tonumber(arg) or 10)
    elseif verb == "list" then ListLevels(id)
    elseif verb == "open" and arg ~= "" then OpenLevel(id, arg)
    elseif verb == "reload" then
        if CurrentMap ~= "unknown" then OpenLevel(id, CurrentMap) else Reply(id, false, "Current level isn't known yet.") end
    elseif verb == "freecam" then
        ExecuteInGameThread(function()
            local want = nil
            if arg == "on" then want = true elseif arg == "off" then want = false end
            local ok, res, msg = pcall(Freecam.Toggle, want)
            if ok then Reply(id, res, msg) else Reply(id, false, "Freecam error: " .. tostring(res)) end
        end)
    elseif verb == "fcspeed" then
        ExecuteInGameThread(function()
            local v = Freecam.SetSpeed(tonumber(arg) or 1.0)
            Reply(id, true, string.format("Freecam speed %.2fx", v))
        end)
    elseif verb == "tp" then
        ExecuteInGameThread(function()
            local ok, res, msg = pcall(Freecam.TeleportPlayer)
            if ok then Reply(id, res, msg) else Reply(id, false, "Teleport error: " .. tostring(res)) end
        end)
    elseif verb == "ping" then Reply(id, true, "pong")
    else Reply(id, false, "Unknown command: " .. verb) end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks & loop
-- New level loaded: noticed by the bridge loop (the world object changes). UE4SS's own "map loaded" hook isn't
-- used any more: on some games (High on Life) it hands Lua a broken level address and the game crashes.
local lastWorldName = nil
local function CheckWorldChanged()
    local w = UEHelpers.GetWorld()
    if not w or not w:IsValid() then return end
    local ok, full = pcall(function() return w:GetFullName() end)
    if not ok or not full then return end
    local addr = ""
    pcall(function() addr = string.format("%x", w:GetAddress()) end)
    local key = full .. "@" .. addr
    if key == lastWorldName then return end
    local first = lastWorldName == nil
    lastWorldName = key
    UpdateCurrentMap(w)
    if not first then
        pcall(Freecam.OnMapChanged)
        pcall(Editor.OnMapChanged)
    end
end
Editor.Init(BridgeDir, Freecam)

-- Freecam settings come from the launcher (config.txt) and are re-read every couple of seconds.
Freecam.dir = BridgeDir
Freecam.ApplyConfig(ReadFile(BridgeDir .. "config.txt"))
Freecam.RegisterHotkeys()
Freecam.RegisterSpeedKeys()
ExecuteInGameThread(function()
    local w = UEHelpers.GetWorld()
    if w and w:IsValid() then UpdateCurrentMap(w) end
end)

local beat = 0
local modMs = 0      -- time this mod spent on the game thread since the last heartbeat (reported in status.txt)
local frameQueued = false
-- Move the freecam inside Unreal's own per-frame camera update, right before the view is worked out:
-- every frame, at the game's frame rate, with no delay. (Falls back to the timer job above if a game
-- never calls it.)
local camHookAt = -1
pcall(function()
    RegisterHook("/Script/Engine.PlayerCameraManager:BlueprintUpdateCamera", function()
        if Editor.PossessActive() then Editor.possByHook = true; pcall(Editor.PossessFrame) end
        if Editor.ViewMode and Editor.ViewMode() ~= "off" then Editor.viewByHook = true; pcall(Editor.ViewFrame) end
        if not Freecam.active then return end
        camHookAt = os.clock()
        local t0 = camHookAt
        pcall(Freecam.Frame)
        modMs = modMs + (os.clock() - t0) * 1000
    end)
    Log("Camera hook ready")
end)
-- The bridge loop. It runs on the GAME thread (LoopInGameThreadWithDelay) so it never runs at the same moment as
-- the camera hook: Lua isn't thread-safe, and the old LoopAsync timer (a second thread) slowly corrupted the
-- mod's Lua state until the game crashed. LoopAsync is only used on old UE4SS builds that can't do this.
local function Tick(onGameThread)
    if onGameThread then pcall(PerfTick) end
    -- Nothing going on (editor closed, freecam off): look for commands about 15 times a second instead of every
    -- frame. Opening a file every frame on the game thread shows up as lag in big games (and antivirus scans it).
    local idle = not (Freecam.active or Editor.Busy())
    beat = beat + 1
    if idle and beat % 4 ~= 0 then return end
    beat = beat - 1
    -- The launcher writes one or more commands (one per line) and only writes again once we've removed the file.
    local cmd = ReadFile(BridgeDir .. "command.txt")
    if cmd and cmd ~= "" then
        os.remove(BridgeDir .. "command.txt")
        for line in cmd:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
            local ok, err = pcall(HandleCommand, line)
            if not ok then Log("Command failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
        end
    end
    -- per-frame work (editing camera, editor state, gizmo camera, model pictures)
    if Freecam.active or Editor.Busy() then
        local camByHook = (os.clock() - camHookAt) < 0.25   -- the camera hook is moving the freecam every frame
        if onGameThread then
            if not camByHook then pcall(Freecam.Frame) end
            pcall(Editor.Frame)
        elseif not frameQueued then
            frameQueued = true
            ExecuteInGameThread(function()
                if not camByHook then pcall(Freecam.Frame) end
                pcall(Editor.Frame)
                frameQueued = false
            end)
        end
    end
    beat = beat + 1
    if beat % 20 == 0 then
        if onGameThread then pcall(CheckWorldChanged) else ExecuteInGameThread(function() pcall(CheckWorldChanged) end) end
    end
    if beat % 60 == 0 then  -- heartbeat about once a second
        local spent = modMs; modMs = 0
        WriteFile(BridgeDir .. "status.txt", string.format("map=%s\nfreecam=%s\nfcmode=%s\ncam=%s\nrot=%s\nfckey=%s\nfcspeed=%.3f\nmodms=%.1f\n",
            tostring(CurrentMap), Freecam.active and "on" or "off", Freecam.kind, Freecam.camText, Freecam.rotText, Freecam.cfg.key, Freecam.speed, spent))
        if onGameThread then pcall(Freecam.UpdateCameraInfo) else ExecuteInGameThread(function() pcall(Freecam.UpdateCameraInfo) end) end
    end
    if beat % 120 == 0 then Freecam.ApplyConfig(ReadFile(BridgeDir .. "config.txt")) end
end

local loopStarted = false
if type(LoopInGameThreadWithDelay) == "function" and EngineTickAvailable ~= false then
    loopStarted = pcall(LoopInGameThreadWithDelay, 16, function()
        local t0 = os.clock()
        local ok, err = pcall(Tick, true)
        modMs = modMs + (os.clock() - t0) * 1000
        if not ok then Log("Loop error: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end)
    if loopStarted then Log("Bridge loop on the game thread") end
end
if not loopStarted then
    LoopAsync(16, function()
        local ok, err = pcall(Tick, false)
        if not ok then Log("Loop error: " .. tostring(err)) end
        return false  -- keep looping
    end)
    Log("Bridge loop on a timer thread (this UE4SS can't loop on the game thread)")
end

Log("Ready")
```

`bundle/Mods/LineTraceMod/Scripts/main.lua`:

```lua
-- LineTrace
local UEHelpers = require("UEHelpers")

-- Importing functions to the global namespace of this mod just so that we don't have to retype 'UEHelpers.' over and over again.
local GetKismetSystemLibrary = UEHelpers.GetKismetSystemLibrary
local GetKismetMathLibrary = UEHelpers.GetKismetMathLibrary
local GetPlayerController = UEHelpers.GetPlayerController

local IsInitialized = false

local function Init()
    if not GetKismetSystemLibrary():IsValid() then error("KismetSystemLibrary not valid\n") end
    
    print(string.format("[LineTraceMod] KismetSystemLibrary: %s\n", GetKismetSystemLibrary():GetFullName()))
    
    if not GetKismetMathLibrary():IsValid() then error("KismetMathLibrary not valid\n") end
    
    print(string.format("[LineTraceMod] KismetMathLibrary: %s\n", GetKismetMathLibrary():GetFullName()))

    IsInitialized = true
end

Init()

local function GetActorFromHitResult(HitResult)
    if UnrealVersion:IsBelow(5, 0) then
        return HitResult.Actor:Get()
    elseif UnrealVersion:IsBelow(5, 4) then
        return HitResult.HitObjectHandle.Actor:Get()
    else
        return HitResult.HitObjectHandle.ReferenceObject:Get()
    end
end

local function GetObjectName()
    if not IsInitialized then return end
    local PlayerController = GetPlayerController()
    local PlayerPawn = PlayerController.Pawn
    local CameraManager = PlayerController.PlayerCameraManager
    local StartVector = CameraManager:GetCameraLocation()
    local AddValue = GetKismetMathLibrary():Multiply_VectorInt(GetKismetMathLibrary():GetForwardVector(CameraManager:GetCameraRotation()), 50000.0)
    local EndVector = GetKismetMathLibrary():Add_VectorVector(StartVector, AddValue)
    local TraceColor = {
        ["R"] = 0,
        ["G"] = 0,
        ["B"] = 0,
        ["A"] = 0,
    }
    local TraceHitColor = TraceColor
    local EDrawDebugTrace_Type_None = 0
    local ETraceTypeQuery_TraceTypeQuery1 = 0
    local ActorsToIgnore = {
    }
    print("[LineTraceMod] Doing line trace\n")
    local HitResult = {}
    local WasHit = GetKismetSystemLibrary():LineTraceSingle(
        PlayerPawn,
        StartVector,
        EndVector,
        ETraceTypeQuery_TraceTypeQuery1,
        false,
        ActorsToIgnore,
        EDrawDebugTrace_Type_None,
        HitResult,
        true,
        TraceColor,
        TraceHitColor,
        0.0
    )

    if WasHit then
        HitActor = GetActorFromHitResult(HitResult)
        print(string.format("[LineTraceMod] HitActor: %s\n", HitActor:GetFullName()))
    else
        return print("[LineTraceMod] Nothing hit.\n")
    end
end

RegisterKeyBind(Key.F3, GetObjectName)
```

`bundle/Mods/SplitScreenMod/Scripts/main.lua`:

```lua
local UEHelpers = require("UEHelpers")

-- Importing functions to the global namespace of this mod just so that we don't have to retype 'UEHelpers.' over and over again.
local GetGameplayStatics = UEHelpers.GetGameplayStatics
local GetGameMapsSettings = UEHelpers.GetGameMapsSettings

-- Set this value to true if you wish for the first controller to control player 1, or false if you want the first controller to control player 2
local bOffsetGamepad = true

local PlayerControllerTable = {}

local function Init()
    GetGameMapsSettings().bUseSplitscreen = true
    GetGameMapsSettings().bOffsetPlayerGamepadIds = bOffsetGamepad
    print(string.format("[SplitScreenMod] UseSplitScreen: %s\n", GetGameMapsSettings().bUseSplitscreen))
    print(string.format("[SplitScreenMod] OffsetPlayerGamepadIds: %s\n", GetGameMapsSettings().bOffsetPlayerGamepadIds))

    IsInitialized = true
end

local function CachePlayerControllers()
    PlayerControllerTable = {}
    local AllPlayerControllers = FindAllOf("PlayerController") or FindAllOf("Controller")
    for Index, PlayerController in pairs(AllPlayerControllers) do
        if PlayerController:IsValid() and PlayerController.Player:IsValid() and not PlayerController:HasAnyInternalFlags(EInternalObjectFlags.PendingKill) then
            PlayerControllerTable[PlayerController.Player.ControllerId + 1] = PlayerController
        end
    end
end

Init()

local function CreatePlayer()

    print("[SplitScreenMod] Creating player..\n")
    CachePlayerControllers()

    print(string.format("[SplitScreenMod] GameplayStatics: %s\n", GetGameplayStatics():GetFullName()))
    ExecuteInGameThread(function()
        NewController = GetGameplayStatics():CreatePlayer(PlayerControllerTable[1], #PlayerControllerTable, true)

        if NewController:IsValid() then
            table.insert(PlayerControllerTable, NewController)
            print(string.format("Player %s created.\n", #PlayerControllerTable))
        else
            print("Player could not be created.\n")
        end
    end)
    
end

function DestroyPlayer()

    -- The caller is caching the player controllers so that it can output that the correct player is being destroyed.
    CachePlayerControllers()
    
    if #PlayerControllerTable == 1 then
        print("[SplitScreenMod] Player could not be destroyed, only 1 player exists.\n")
        return
    end
    print(string.format("[SplitScreenMod] GameplayStatics: %s\n", GetGameplayStatics():GetFullName()))

    local ControllerToRemove = PlayerControllerTable[#PlayerControllerTable]
    print(string.format("[SplitScreenMod] Removing %s\n", ControllerToRemove:GetFullName()))
    if not ControllerToRemove:IsValid() then print("[SplitScreenMod] PlayerController to be removed is not valid.\nPlayerController could not be destroyed.\n") return end
    
    ExecuteInGameThread(function()
        GetGameplayStatics():RemovePlayer(ControllerToRemove, true)
    end)
end

function TeleportPlayers()

    CachePlayerControllers()

    if #PlayerControllerTable == 1 then
        print("[SplitScreenMod] Players could not be teleported, only 1 player exists.\n")
        return
    end

    local DidTeleport = false
    
    print(string.format("[SplitScreenMod] Attempting to Teleport to Player 1..\n"))
    
    ExecuteInGameThread(function()
        PlayerPawn = PlayerControllerTable[1].Pawn
        PlayerPawnLocationVec = PlayerPawn.RootComponent:K2_GetComponentLocation()
        PlayerPawnLocationRot = PlayerPawn.RootComponent:K2_GetComponentRotation()
        local HitResult = {}
        for i, EachPlayerController in ipairs(PlayerControllerTable) do
            if i > 1 and EachPlayerController.Pawn:IsValid() then
                EachPlayerController.Pawn:K2_SetActorLocationAndRotation(PlayerPawnLocationVec, PlayerPawnLocationRot, false, HitResult, false)
                DidTeleport = true
            end
        end

        if DidTeleport then
            print("Players teleport to Player 1.\n")
        else
            print("No players could be teleported\n")
        end
    end)
end


RegisterKeyBind(Key.Y, {ModifierKey.CONTROL}, CreatePlayer)

RegisterKeyBind(Key.U, {ModifierKey.CONTROL}, DestroyPlayer)

RegisterKeyBind(Key.I, {ModifierKey.CONTROL}, TeleportPlayers)
```
