```inc
            if (okPin) MeLink(ip, n->id, g_meLinkOut);
            else if (okIn) MeLinkIn(ni, ii, n->id, g_meLinkOut);
            else if (n && hov && ip < 0 && ni < 0 && MeHitNode(org, m) < 0) {   // let go on empty graph: pick a node to wire it into (like Unreal)
                M.rclickAt = m; g_meWireToNew = n->id; g_meWireToNewOut = g_meLinkOut; ImGui::OpenPopup("##meadd");
            }
            M.linkFrom = -1;
        }
    }
    // hints
    {
        ImGui::PushFont(F_small);
        const char* hint = "Drag from a pin to wire it  \xC2\xB7  right-click: add a node  \xC2\xB7  right-drag: pan  \xC2\xB7  wheel: zoom  \xC2\xB7  drag on empty: select  \xC2\xB7  Ctrl+C / V / D / Z / Y  \xC2\xB7  C: comment  \xC2\xB7  Alt+click a pin: break";
        dl->AddText(ImVec2(org.x + Px(14), end.y - Px(22)), IM_COL32(130, 130, 138, 255), hint);
        ImGui::PopFont();
    }
    dl->PopClipRect();
    // keys (while the graph has the focus and nothing is being typed)
    bool keys = ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows) && !io.WantTextInput && hov;
    if (keys || (ImGui::IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootAndChildWindows) && !io.WantTextInput)) {
        if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Delete) || (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Backspace) && hov)) MeDeleteSelected();
        if (io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_C, false)) MeCopy();
        if (io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_X, false)) { MeCopy(); MeDeleteSelected(); }
        if (io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_V, false)) { ImVec2 gp = MeToGraph(org, hov ? m : ImVec2(org.x + size.x / 2, org.y + size.y / 2)); if (const char* c = ImGui::GetClipboardText()) MePasteText(c, gp.x, gp.y); }
        if (io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_D, false)) MeDuplicate();
        if (io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_A, false)) { M.selSet.clear(); for (auto& n : M.nodes) if (!n.output) M.selSet.insert(n.id); }
        if (io.KeyCtrl && !io.KeyShift && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Z, false)) MeUndo();
        if (io.KeyCtrl && (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Y, false) || (io.KeyShift && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Z, false)))) MeRedo();
        if (!io.KeyCtrl && hov && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_C, false)) MeCommentAroundSelection();
        if (!io.KeyCtrl && hov && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Home, false)) M.fitted = false;
    }
    // menus
    if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##meadd")) {
        ImVec2 gp = MeToGraph(org, M.rclickAt);
        size_t before = M.nodes.size();
        MeAddMenu(gp.x, gp.y);
        if (M.nodes.size() > before && g_meWireToNew >= 0) {     // a node picked for a dragged wire: plug it into its first input
            int id = M.nodes.back().id; if (MeNode* nn = MeFind(id)) if (!MeNodeIns(*nn).empty()) MeLinkIn(id, 0, g_meWireToNew, g_meWireToNewOut);
            g_meWireToNew = -1;
        }
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    } else g_meWireToNew = -1;
    if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##menode")) {
        MeNode* n = MeFind(M.sel);
        auto sel = MeSelection();
        if (n && !n->output) {
            if (n->kind == MEK_TEX) {
                if (ImGui::MenuItem("Pick a texture from the game...")) { ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup(); MeOpenPicker(1, n->id); }
                if (ImGui::MenuItem("Pick a picture file...")) MePickFile(n->id);
                ImGui::Separator();
                if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_DOWNLOAD "  Export texture")) MeExportTexture(MeParamValue(*n), MeFeeds(n->id));
                if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_FOLDER_OPEN "  Open exported textures folder")) MeOpenExportDir();
                ImGui::Separator();
            }
            if (n->kind == MEK_MAT && ImGui::MenuItem("Pick a material...")) { ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup(); MeOpenPicker(2, n->id); }
            if ((n->kind == MEK_SCA || n->kind == MEK_VEC || n->kind == MEK_TEX) && ImGui::MenuItem(MeIsParam(*n) ? "Convert to constant" : "Convert to parameter")) {
                if (MeIsParam(*n)) n->name.clear(); else n->name = n->kind == MEK_TEX ? "Texture" : n->kind == MEK_VEC ? "Color" : "Scalar";
            }
            if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_COPY "  Copy", "Ctrl+C")) MeCopy();
            if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_CLONE "  Duplicate", "Ctrl+D")) MeDuplicate();
            if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_COMMENT "  Comment around the selection", "C")) MeCommentAroundSelection();
            if (ImGui::MenuItem("Break all its wires")) {
                std::vector<int> pins; for (auto& l : M.links) if (l.second == n->id) pins.push_back(l.first); for (int p : pins) MeUnlink(p);
                std::vector<long long> ins; for (auto& kv : M.nin) if (kv.second.first == n->id || (int)(kv.first / 64) == n->id) ins.push_back(kv.first);
                for (auto key : ins) MeUnlinkIn((int)(key / 64), (int)(key % 64));
            }
            ImGui::Separator();
            if (ImGui::MenuItem(sel.size() > 1 ? (ICON_TRASH "  Delete " + std::to_string(sel.size()) + " nodes").c_str() : ICON_TRASH "  Delete", "Del")) MeDeleteSelected();
        } else EdLabel("The material's output can't be removed.");
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
}
// ---- the game's own picture of the material (the game renders a sphere with it): for the material's own settings,
// which the launcher's preview can't know (only the game has its shader)
static void MeGamePreview() {
    float w = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x, h = std::max(Px(80), ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - ImGui::GetTextLineHeightWithSpacing() * 2);
    ImVec2 a = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos(), b(a.x + w, a.y + h);
    ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    dl->AddRectFilledMultiColor(a, b, IM_COL32(58, 64, 74, 255), IM_COL32(58, 64, 74, 255), IM_COL32(22, 23, 26, 255), IM_COL32(22, 23, 26, 255));
    ID3D11ShaderResourceView* srv = nullptr;
    if (!M.prevPng.empty() && FileExists(U2W(M.prevPng))) srv = MatThumbFor(U2W(M.prevPng));
    static ID3D11ShaderResourceView* lastSrv = nullptr;
    if (srv) lastSrv = srv;
    float side = std::min(w, h) * 0.92f, cx = (a.x + b.x) / 2, cy = (a.y + b.y) / 2;
    if (lastSrv) dl->AddImage((ImTextureID)lastSrv, ImVec2(cx - side / 2, cy - side / 2), ImVec2(cx + side / 2, cy + side / 2));
    else { ImGui::PushFont(F_small); dl->AddText(ImVec2(a.x + Px(10), a.y + Px(10)), ImGui::GetColorU32(P.dim), "Asking the game for a picture..."); ImGui::PopFont(); }
    if (!M.prevPng.empty() && !srv && GetTickCount64() - M.prevAsked > 4000 && FileExists(U2W(M.prevPng.substr(0, M.prevPng.size() - 4) + ".fail"))) {
        ImGui::PushFont(F_small); dl->AddText(ImVec2(a.x + Px(10), b.y - Px(22)), ImGui::GetColorU32(P.dim), "The game couldn't make a preview."); ImGui::PopFont();
    }
    ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(w, h));
    ImGui::PushFont(F_small); EdLabel("The material as the game draws it (its own shader), on a sphere. Changes to its settings show here."); ImGui::PopFont();
}

// a row in the Details: label on the left, the control on the right (like Unreal's property grid)
static float g_meLabelW = 0;
static void MeProp(const char* label, const char* tip = nullptr) {
    ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, P.dim); ImGui::TextUnformatted(label); ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    if (tip && ImGui::IsItemHovered()) ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", tip);
    ImGui::SameLine(g_meLabelW); ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
}
// the material's own properties (shown when the output node, or nothing, is selected)
static void MeMaterialProps() {
    bool ch = false;
    SectionLabel("Material");
    const char* blends[] = { "Opaque", "Masked", "Translucent", "Additive" };
    MeProp("Blend Mode", "Opaque: solid. Masked: Opacity Mask cuts holes. Translucent: Opacity blends it. Additive: adds light (glow, fire).");
    ch |= ImGui::Combo("##blend", &M.props.blend, blends, 4);
    const char* shading[] = { "Default Lit", "Unlit" };
    int sh = M.props.unlit ? 1 : 0;
    MeProp("Shading Model", "Unlit: only Emissive Color shows (no light)");
    if (ImGui::Combo("##shade", &sh, shading, 2)) { M.props.unlit = sh == 1; ch = true; }
    MeProp("Two Sided"); ch |= ImGui::Checkbox("##two", &M.props.twoSided);
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(M.props.blend != BLEND_MASKED);
    MeProp("Opacity Mask Clip Value", "Below this, a Masked material is cut away"); ch |= ImGui::SliderFloat("##clip", &M.props.clip, 0, 1, "%.3f");
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    MeProp("Displacement Scale", "How far Displacement moves the surface (preview)"); ch |= ImGui::DragFloat("##disp", &M.props.dispScale, 0.002f, -1, 1, "%.3f");
    MeProp("World Position Offset Scale"); ch |= ImGui::DragFloat("##wpos", &M.props.wpoScale, 0.01f, 0, 10, "%.2f");
    if (ch) { MeStdChanged(); if (!M.asset.empty()) M.dirty = true; }
    ImGui::PushFont(F_small); ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, P.dim); ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0);
    ImGui::TextUnformatted("In the game, the material keeps its own blend mode and shading (a shipped game can't change them); the preview shows them as set here.");
    ImGui::PopTextWrapPos(); ImGui::PopStyleColor(); ImGui::PopFont();
    if (M.cur < (int)M.slots.size() && M.asset.empty()) {
        const MeSlot& s = M.slots[M.cur];
        SectionLabel("In the game");
        EdLabel("Material"); ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", s.mat.c_str());
        if (!s.base.empty() && s.base != s.mat) { EdLabel("Based on"); ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", s.base.c_str()); }
        EdLabel("Used by"); ImGui::TextWrapped("%s, slot %d%s", (s.comp.rfind("#", 0) == 0 ? "part " + s.comp.substr(1) : s.comp).c_str(), s.slot, s.slotName.empty() ? "" : (" (" + s.slotName + ")").c_str());
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, Px(4)));
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, P.dim);
        ImGui::TextWrapped("The output's first inputs are this material's own settings (%d): they change in the game straight away. The Unreal inputs below them are worked out by the launcher and baked into textures, which go into the material's texture slots.", M.stdStart - 1);
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_WAND "  Start from this material's textures", ImVec2(-1, 0))) MeUseItsTextures();
    }
}
static void MeOpenTexLibraryPicker(int node);
static void MeDetails() {
    g_meLabelW = std::min(Px(150), ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.45f);
    auto sel = MeSelection();
    MeNode* n = MeFind(M.sel);
    if (sel.size() > 1) {
        ImGui::PushFont(F_h2); ImGui::Text("%d nodes selected", (int)sel.size()); ImGui::PopFont();
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_COMMENT "  Comment around them", ImVec2(-1, 0))) MeCommentAroundSelection();
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_CLONE "  Duplicate", ImVec2(-1, 0))) MeDuplicate();
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_COPY "  Copy", ImVec2(-1, 0))) MeCopy();
        ImVec4 e = P.err; if (GhostButton(ICON_TRASH "  Delete them", ImVec2(-1, 0), &e)) MeDeleteSelected();
        return;
    }
    if (!n || n->output) { MeMaterialProps(); return; }
    std::string title = n->kind == MEK_COMMENT ? "Comment" : MeNodeTitle(*n);
    ImGui::PushFont(F_h2); ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", title.c_str()); ImGui::PopFont();
    if (n->kind == MEK_OP) { ImGui::PushFont(F_small); EdLabel(g_meOpHelp[n->op]); ImGui::PopFont(); }
    std::vector<std::string> feeds; for (auto& l : M.links) if (l.second == n->id) feeds.push_back(M.pins[l.first].kind == MEK_MAT ? "Material" : M.pins[l.first].name);
    for (auto& kv : M.nin) if (kv.second.first == n->id) if (MeNode* d = MeFind((int)(kv.first / 64))) { auto ins = MeNodeIns(*d); feeds.push_back(MeNodeTitle(*d) + " (" + (kv.first % 64 < (long long)ins.size() ? ins[kv.first % 64] : "?") + ")"); }
    std::string fl; for (size_t i = 0; i < feeds.size(); i++) fl += (i ? ", " : "") + feeds[i];
    if (n->kind != MEK_COMMENT) { ImGui::PushFont(F_small); EdLabel(feeds.empty() ? "Not plugged in" : ("Plugged into: " + fl).c_str()); ImGui::PopFont(); }
    std::string err = MeNodeError(n->id);
    if (!err.empty()) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, P.err); ImGui::TextWrapped(ICON_WARN "  %s", err.c_str()); ImGui::PopStyleColor(); }
    ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, Px(4)));
    float w = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
    ImDrawList* dl = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    // parameters (Scalar / Vector / Texture Parameter): their name, which material instances use
    if (n->kind == MEK_SCA || n->kind == MEK_VEC || n->kind == MEK_TEX) {
        bool isParam = MeIsParam(*n);
        MeProp("Parameter", "A named value: material instances of this material can change it");
        if (ImGui::Checkbox("##isparam", &isParam)) n->name = isParam ? (n->kind == MEK_TEX ? "Texture" : n->kind == MEK_VEC ? "Color" : "Scalar") : "";
        if (MeIsParam(*n)) {
            char nb[96]; snprintf(nb, sizeof nb, "%s", n->name.c_str());
            MeProp("Parameter Name");
            if (ImGui::InputText("##pname", nb, sizeof nb) && nb[0]) n->name = nb;
            for (auto& o : M.nodes) if (o.id != n->id && o.name == n->name && MeIsParam(o) && o.kind != n->kind) { ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, P.err); ImGui::TextWrapped("Another parameter of a different type has this name"); ImGui::PopStyleColor(); break; }
        }
    }
    if (n->kind == MEK_TEX) {
        float s = std::min(w, Px(160));
        ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
        MeTexBox(dl, n->value, p, ImVec2(p.x + s, p.y + s), Px(4));
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(s, s));
        ImGui::PushFont(F_small); ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", n->value.rfind("file:", 0) == 0 ? n->value.substr(5).c_str() : n->value.empty() ? "(no texture)" : n->value.c_str()); ImGui::PopFont();
        if (AccentButton(ICON_SEARCH "  From the game...", ImVec2(w / 2 - Px(2), 0))) MeOpenPicker(1, n->id);
        ImGui::SameLine(0, Px(4));
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_IMAGE "  Texture library...", ImVec2(-1, 0))) MeOpenTexLibraryPicker(n->id);
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_FILE_IMPORT "  Picture file...", ImVec2(w / 2 - Px(2), 0))) MePickFile(n->id);
        ImGui::SameLine(0, Px(4));
        if (ImGui::Button(ICON_DOWNLOAD "  Export texture", ImVec2(-1, 0))) MeExportTexture(n->value, MeFeeds(n->id));
        SectionLabel("Sampler");
        bool ch = false;
        const char* st[] = { "Color", "Normal", "Masks (linear)" };
        MeProp("Sampler Type", "How the texture is read: Color is sRGB, Normal unpacks a normal map, Masks reads plain numbers (roughness, metal...)");
        ch |= ImGui::Combo("##smp", &n->sampler, st, 3);
        const char* fl2[] = { "Bilinear", "Nearest (pixelated)", "Anisotropic" };
        MeProp("Filter"); ch |= ImGui::Combo("##filter", &n->filter, fl2, 3);
        MeProp("Tiling", "How many times across (U, V)"); ch |= ImGui::DragFloat2("##tile", n->tile, 0.02f, -256, 256, "%.2f");
        MeProp("Offset"); ch |= ImGui::DragFloat2("##off", n->off, 0.005f, -16, 16, "%.3f");
        MeProp("Rotation", "Degrees, around the middle"); ch |= ImGui::DragFloat("##rot", &n->rot, 0.5f, -360, 360, "%.1f\xC2\xB0");
        if (ch) MeStdChanged();
        if (n->value.rfind("file:", 0) != 0 && !n->value.empty() && MeTexturePic(n->value) == nullptr) {
            ImGui::PushFont(F_small); EdLabel("(no picture of it: the launcher couldn't read it from the game's files)"); ImGui::PopFont();
        }
    } else if (n->kind == MEK_VEC) {
        float c[4]; MeColour(n->value, c);
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
        if (ImGui::ColorPicker4("##col", c, ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float | ImGuiColorEditFlags_HDR | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar | ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerHueWheel)) {
            char t[96]; snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f", c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]); n->value = t; MeNodeChanged(*n, false);
        }
        if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()) MeNodeChanged(*n, true);
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
        if (ImGui::DragFloat4("##colv", c, 0.005f, -100, 100, "%.3f")) { char t[96]; snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f", c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]); n->value = t; MeNodeChanged(*n, false); }
        if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()) MeNodeChanged(*n, true);
        ImGui::PushFont(F_small); EdLabel("Values over 1 make it glow, where the material uses the colour as light."); ImGui::PopFont();
    } else if (n->kind == MEK_SCA) {
        float v = (float)atof(n->value.c_str());
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
        bool ch = ImGui::SliderFloat("##sl", &v, 0, 1, "%.3f");
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
        ch |= ImGui::DragFloat("##dr", &v, 0.01f, 0, 0, "%.3f");
        if (ch) { char t[32]; snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%.4f", v); n->value = t; MeNodeChanged(*n, false); }
        if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()) MeNodeChanged(*n, true);
    } else if (n->kind == MEK_OP) {
        auto ins = MeNodeIns(*n);
        bool ch = false;
        auto constFor = [&](int k, int inIdx, const char* label, float lo, float hi) {
            if (inIdx >= 0 && inIdx < (int)ins.size() && M.nin.count(MeInKey(n->id, inIdx))) { MeProp(label); ImGui::TextDisabled("(plugged in)"); return; }
            MeProp(label); ch |= ImGui::DragFloat((std::string("##c") + label).c_str(), &n->c[k], 0.01f, lo, hi, "%.3f");
        };
        switch (n->op) {
        case OP_TEXCOORD: MeProp("Tiling"); ch |= ImGui::DragFloat2("##tile", n->c, 0.05f, -64, 64, "%.2f"); break;
        case OP_ADD: case OP_SUB: case OP_MUL: case OP_DIV: case OP_MIN: case OP_MAX: constFor(0, 0, "Const A", 0, 0); constFor(1, 1, "Const B", 0, 0); break;
        case OP_LERP: constFor(0, 0, "Const A", 0, 0); constFor(1, 1, "Const B", 0, 0); constFor(2, 2, "Const Alpha", 0, 1); break;
        case OP_POW: constFor(0, 0, "Const Base", 0, 0); constFor(1, 1, "Const Exponent", 0, 16); break;
        case OP_CLAMP: constFor(0, 0, "Const Input", 0, 0); constFor(1, 1, "Min", 0, 0); constFor(2, 2, "Max", 0, 0); break;
        case OP_DESAT: constFor(1, 1, "Fraction", 0, 1); break;
        case OP_SIN: case OP_COS: constFor(0, -1, "Period", 0, 0); break;
        case OP_FRESNEL: constFor(0, 0, "Exponent", 0, 64); constFor(1, 1, "Base Reflect Fraction", 0, 1); break;
        case OP_NORMALSTR: constFor(1, 1, "Strength", -8, 8); break;
        case OP_PANNER: MeProp("Speed", "UV per second (X, Y)"); ch |= ImGui::DragFloat2("##spd", n->c, 0.005f, -16, 16, "%.3f"); break;
        case OP_ROTATOR: MeProp("Centre"); ch |= ImGui::DragFloat2("##ctr", n->c, 0.005f, -4, 4, "%.3f"); constFor(2, -1, "Speed", -16, 16); break;
        case OP_TIME: constFor(0, -1, "Speed", -16, 16); break;
        case OP_BUMPOFFSET: constFor(0, 2, "Height Ratio", -1, 1); constFor(1, -1, "Reference Plane", 0, 1); break;
        case OP_MASK: {
            MeProp("Channels");
            const char* cn[4] = { "R", "G", "B", "A" };
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { if (k) ImGui::SameLine(); bool b = n->c[k] > 0.5f; if (ImGui::Checkbox(cn[k], &b)) { n->c[k] = b ? 1.f : 0.f; ch = true; } }
            break;
        }
        case OP_LAYERBLEND: {
            EdLabel("Layers (each layer's preview weight, unless its Weight input is plugged in)");
            int del = -1;
            for (int l = 0; l < (int)n->layers.size(); l++) {
                ImGui::PushID(l);
                char nb[64]; snprintf(nb, sizeof nb, "%s", n->layers[l].first.c_str());
                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.42f);
                if (ImGui::InputText("##ln", nb, sizeof nb) && nb[0]) n->layers[l].first = nb;
                ImGui::SameLine(); ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - Px(30));
                ch |= ImGui::SliderFloat("##lw", &n->layers[l].second, 0, 1, "weight %.2f");
                ImGui::SameLine();
                if (ImGui::SmallButton(ICON_TRASH)) del = l;
                ImGui::PopID();
            }
            if (del >= 0 && n->layers.size() > 1) {
                std::map<long long, std::pair<int, int>> keep;
                for (auto& kv : M.nin) {
                    if ((int)(kv.first / 64) != n->id) { keep[kv.first] = kv.second; continue; }
                    int in = (int)(kv.first % 64);
                    if (in / 2 == del) continue;
                    keep[MeInKey(n->id, in / 2 > del ? in - 2 : in)] = kv.second;
                }
                M.nin.swap(keep); n->layers.erase(n->layers.begin() + del); ch = true;
            }
            if (n->layers.size() < 8 && ImGui::Button(ICON_PLUS "  Add layer", ImVec2(-1, 0))) { n->layers.push_back({ "Mat" + std::to_string(n->layers.size() + 1), 0.f }); ch = true; }
            break;
        }
        default: break;
        }
        if (ch) MeStdChanged();
        if (MeHasPreview(*n)) if (ID3D11ShaderResourceView* pv = MePreviewOf(n->id)) {
            ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, Px(4))); EdLabel("What it makes (on a flat square, at time 0)");
            float s = std::min(w, Px(160)); ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
            dl->AddImage((ImTextureID)pv, p, ImVec2(p.x + s, p.y + s)); ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(s, s));
        }
    } else if (n->kind == MEK_COMMENT) {
        static char buf[1024]; snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%s", n->name.c_str());
        MeProp("Text");
        if (ImGui::InputTextMultiline("##ct", buf, sizeof buf, ImVec2(-1, Px(70)))) n->name = buf;
        MeProp("Colour");
        for (int k = 0; k < (int)(sizeof g_meCommentCols / sizeof g_meCommentCols[0]); k++) {
            if (k) ImGui::SameLine(0, Px(4));
            ImGui::PushID(k);
            ImVec4 c = Hex(g_meCommentCols[k]);
            if (ImGui::ColorButton("##cc", c, ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoTooltip, ImVec2(Px(22), Px(22)))) n->col = g_meCommentCols[k];
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        MeProp("Size"); float sz[2] = { n->w, n->h }; if (ImGui::DragFloat2("##csz", sz, 1, 160, 4000, "%.0f")) { n->w = sz[0]; n->h = sz[1]; }
    } else if (n->kind == MEK_MAT) {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", n->value.empty() ? "(none)" : n->value.c_str());
        if (AccentButton(ICON_SEARCH "  Pick a material...", ImVec2(-1, 0))) MeOpenPicker(2, n->id);
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, P.dim); ImGui::TextWrapped("Plugged into Material, it replaces the whole material: the graph then shows the new material's settings."); ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    }
    // settings this node feeds that the material had differently: show the original
    for (auto& l : M.links) if (l.second == n->id && !MeIsStd(l.first) && M.pins[l.first].kind != MEK_MAT && M.pins[l.first].orig != n->value) {
        const MeParam& p = M.pins[l.first];
        ImGui::PushID(l.first);
        ImGui::PushFont(F_small);
        std::string o = p.kind == MEK_TEX ? MeShort(p.orig) : p.orig;
        EdLabel((p.name + " was " + o).c_str());
        ImGui::PopFont();
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::SmallButton("Put back")) { n->value = p.orig; MeNodeChanged(*n, true); }
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, Px(6)));
    ImVec4 e = P.err;
    if (GhostButton(ICON_TRASH "  Delete node", ImVec2(-1, 0), &e)) MeDeleteSelected();
}

// ---- Stats: what the compiler said, and what the shader costs
static void MeStatsPanel() {
    ImGui::PushFont(F_small);
    if (g_msBusy) EdLabel("Compiling...");
    int errs = 0;
    for (auto& e : g_ms.src.errs) {
        errs++;
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, P.err);
        std::string t = std::string(ICON_CIRCLE_XMARK "  ") + (e.first >= 0 ? "[" + (MeFind(e.first) ? MeNodeTitle(*MeFind(e.first)) : std::string("node")) + "] " : "") + e.second;
        if (ImGui::Selectable(t.c_str()) && e.first >= 0) { MeSelectOnly(e.first); if (MeNode* n = MeFind(e.first)) { (void)n; } }
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    }
    if (!g_ms.log.empty()) {
        std::istringstream ss(g_ms.log); std::string line;
        while (std::getline(ss, line)) {
            if (line.empty()) continue;
            bool isErr = line.find("error") != std::string::npos || line.find(": E") != std::string::npos;
            if (isErr) errs++;
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, isErr ? P.err : P.warn);
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s  %s", isErr ? ICON_CIRCLE_XMARK : ICON_WARN, line.c_str());
            ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        }
    }
    for (auto& w : g_ms.src.warns) {
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, P.warn);
        std::string t = std::string(ICON_WARN "  ") + (w.first >= 0 && MeFind(w.first) ? "[" + MeNodeTitle(*MeFind(w.first)) + "] " : "") + w.second;
        if (ImGui::Selectable(t.c_str()) && w.first >= 0) MeSelectOnly(w.first);
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    }
    if (g_ms.ok) {
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, P.ok);
        ImGui::Text(ICON_CIRCLE_CHECK "  Compiled in %.0f ms", g_ms.ms);
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    }
    int nodes = 0; for (auto& n : M.nodes) if (!n.output && n.kind != MEK_COMMENT) nodes++;
    EdLabel(("Base pass shader: " + std::to_string(g_ms.psInstr) + " instructions  \xC2\xB7  vertex shader: " + std::to_string(g_ms.vsInstr) + " instructions").c_str());
    EdLabel(("Texture samplers: " + std::to_string(g_ms.src.tex.size()) + " / " + std::to_string(MS_MAX_TEX) + "  \xC2\xB7  texture lookups: " + std::to_string(g_ms.psTex) +
             "  \xC2\xB7  values: " + std::to_string(g_ms.src.slots) + " / " + std::to_string(MS_MAX_SLOTS) + "  \xC2\xB7  nodes: " + std::to_string(nodes)).c_str());
    if (!M.bakeNote.empty()) EdLabel(("Game: " + M.bakeNote).c_str());
    ImGui::PopFont();
}

#include "mgtex.inc"
#include "mgasset.inc"

// ---- the whole editor (replaces the tabs while it's open), laid out like Unreal 5's Material Editor:
// toolbar on top; Palette (node library) on the left; the graph in the middle with Stats under it; Viewport and
// Details on the right. Tabs switch to the Texture Editor and the Material Instance editor.
static float g_meSplitR = 0.46f;            // viewport height / right column
static bool g_meTabJump = false; static int g_meTabWas = 0;
static bool g_meVpJump = false;
static int g_meVpTab = 0;                    // the viewport shows the launcher's preview (0) or the game's own picture (1)      // (a tab chosen by the program, not a click)
static void MeToolButton(const char* icon, const char* label, bool enabled, const char* tip, const std::function<void()>& f, bool accent = false) {
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(!enabled);
    ImGui::BeginGroup();
    float w = std::max(Px(52), ImGui::CalcTextSize(label).x + Px(12));
    ImGui::PushID(label);
    bool hit = accent ? AccentButton((std::string(icon) + "##b").c_str(), ImVec2(w, Px(28))) : ImGui::Button((std::string(icon) + "##b").c_str(), ImVec2(w, Px(28)));
    ImGui::PopID();
    ImGui::PushFont(F_small);
    float tw = ImGui::CalcTextSize(label).x; ImGui::SetCursorPosX(ImGui::GetCursorPosX() + (w - tw) / 2); ImGui::TextUnformatted(label);
    ImGui::PopFont();
    ImGui::EndGroup();
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenDisabled) && tip) ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", tip);
    if (hit) f();
    ImGui::SameLine(0, Px(4));
}
static void MeFileMenu() {
    bool asset = !M.asset.empty();
    if (ImGui::IsWindowAppearing()) MeLibReload();          // (files may have changed outside the launcher)
    if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_PLUS "  New Material")) MeNewAsset();
    if (ImGui::BeginMenu(ICON_FOLDER_OPEN "  Open from the library")) { MeLibraryMenu(false); ImGui::EndMenu(); }
    ImGui::Separator();
    if (asset && ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_FLOPPY "  Save", "Ctrl+S")) { MeSaveAsset(); if (!g_meInst.empty()) MeSaveInstance(); }
    if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_FLOPPY "  Save as material asset...")) {
        std::string base = asset ? W2U(M.asset.substr(M.asset.find_last_of(L"\\/") + 1)) : "M_" + (M.cur < (int)M.slots.size() ? MeShort(M.slots[M.cur].mat) : std::string("Material"));
        if (base.find('.') != std::string::npos) base = base.substr(0, base.find_last_of('.'));
        MakeDirs(MeLibDir());
        OvBrowse(L"Material (*.uemat)\0*.uemat\0", L"Save the graph as a material asset", MeLibDir() + L"\\", true, MeSafeName(base), L"uemat", [](std::wstring f) {
            if (f.empty()) return;
            if (Lower(f).size() < 6 || Lower(f).substr(f.size() - 6) != L".uemat") f += L".uemat";
            if (MeSaveAssetAs(f)) { g_toasts.push_back({ "Saved " + W2U(f), false, GetTickCount64() }); if (!M.asset.empty()) { M.asset = f; M.dirty = false; } }
        });
    }
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(!asset);
    if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_SLIDERS "  New Material Instance of this")) MeNewInstance();
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if (!asset && ImGui::BeginMenu(ICON_FILE_IMPORT "  Load a material from the library into this slot")) { MeLibraryMenu(true); ImGui::EndMenu(); }
    ImGui::Separator();
    if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_FILE_CODE "  Export shader code (.hlsl)...")) MeExportShader();
    if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_FILE_EXPORT "  Export baked textures...")) MeExportBaked();
    if (asset && ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_CUBE "  Apply to the selected object")) MeApplyAssetToSelected();
    ImGui::Separator();
    if (ImGui::MenuItem(ICON_CIRCLE_XMARK "  Close the material editor")) MatEdClose();
}
static void MatEdDraw() {
    MePollGraph();
    MeFlush();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_meExMx);
        for (auto& m : g_meExMsgs) { g_toasts.push_back({ m.first, m.second, GetTickCount64() }); Log(U2W("Material editor: " + m.first), m.second ? LOG_WARN : LOG_INFO); }
        g_meExMsgs.clear();
    }
    bool asset = !M.asset.empty();
    if (!asset && M.loaded && !M.slots.empty() && M.builtFor != M.cur) MeBuild();
    MePendingStep();
    MeHistoryTrack();
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    if (io.KeyCtrl && ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_S, false) && !io.WantTextInput) { if (asset) { MeSaveAsset(); if (!g_meInst.empty()) MeSaveInstance(); } else if (!M.builtKey.empty()) { MeSaveGraphFile(M.builtKey, MeTakeCustom()); g_toasts.push_back({ "Saved the graph", false, GetTickCount64() }); } }

    // ---- toolbar
    if (ImGui::Button(ICON_BARS " File")) ImGui::OpenPopup("##mefile");
    if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##mefile")) { MeFileMenu(); ImGui::EndPopup(); }
    if (!M.open) return;
    ImGui::SameLine(0, Px(10));
    ImVec2 tb = ImGui::GetCursorPos();
    MeToolButton(ICON_FLOPPY, "Save", true, asset ? "Save the material asset (Ctrl+S)" : "Save the graph (it's also kept with the level's layout). File > Save as material asset to keep it in the library.", [&]() {
        if (asset) { MeSaveAsset(); if (!g_meInst.empty()) MeSaveInstance(); } else if (!M.builtKey.empty()) { MeSaveGraphFile(M.builtKey, MeTakeCustom()); g_toasts.push_back({ "Saved the graph", false, GetTickCount64() }); }
    });
    MeToolButton(ICON_HAMMER, "Compile", !g_msBusy, "Compile the graph into a shader now (it also compiles by itself as you work)", []() { g_msForce = true; });
    if (!asset) MeToolButton(ICON_CIRCLE_CHECK, M.baking ? "Baking..." : "Apply", !M.baking && MeStdUsed(), "Bake what's wired into the Unreal inputs and put it on the object in the game", []() { MeStartBake(); }, true);
    else MeToolButton(ICON_CIRCLE_CHECK, "Apply", !g_ed.sel.empty(), g_ed.sel.empty() ? "Select an object in the game first, then apply this material to it" : "Apply this material to the selected object (baked into its textures)", []() { MeApplyAssetToSelected(); }, true);
    MeToolButton(ICON_UNDO, "Undo", !g_meUndo.empty(), "Undo (Ctrl+Z)", []() { MeUndo(); });
    MeToolButton(ICON_REDO, "Redo", !g_meRedo.empty(), "Redo (Ctrl+Y)", []() { MeRedo(); });
    MeToolButton(ICON_EXPAND, "Home", true, "Show the whole graph (Home)", []() { M.fitted = false; });
    MeToolButton(ICON_SITEMAP, "Arrange", true, "Arrange the nodes automatically", []() { MeAutoArrange(); });
    MeToolButton(ICON_GEAR, "Settings", true, "Editor settings", []() { ImGui::OpenPopup("##meset"); });
    if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##meset")) {
        ImGui::Checkbox("Live node previews", &g_meNodePreviews);
        if (!asset) {
            ImGui::Checkbox("Live Update (bake into the game a moment after every change)", &M.live);

    if (M.picker) { if (!ImGui::IsPopupOpen("##mepick")) ImGui::OpenPopup("##mepick"); MePickerPopup(); }

```

`mgasset.inc`:

```inc
// ---- Material assets (.uemat) and material instances (.uemi), in LauncherBridge\material library
// A material asset is a whole graph (its nodes, wires and properties) that isn't tied to one object: open it, edit
// it, preview it, then apply it to any object's material slot (it's baked into textures there, like any graph).
// A material instance points at a material asset and changes only its parameters (Scalar / Vector / Texture
// Parameter nodes), like Unreal's Material Instance Constant: no new shader, just other values.

static std::wstring MeLibDir() { return DirOf(ModelsRoot()) + L"\\material library"; }
static std::wstring g_mePendingAsset; static bool g_mePendingBake = false;   // an asset to load into an object's slot once its graph is read
struct MeLibItem { std::wstring file; std::string name; bool inst = false; std::string parent; };
static std::vector<MeLibItem> g_meLib; static bool g_meLibLoaded = false;
static void MeLibReload() {
    g_meLib.clear(); g_meLibLoaded = true;
    for (const wchar_t* ext : { L"*.uemat", L"*.uemi" }) {
        WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd; HANDLE f = FindFirstFileW((MeLibDir() + L"\\" + ext).c_str(), &fd);
        if (f == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) continue;
        do {
            MeLibItem it; it.file = MeLibDir() + L"\\" + fd.cFileName; std::wstring n = fd.cFileName; it.inst = n.size() > 5 && Lower(n.substr(n.size() - 5)) == L".uemi";
            it.name = W2U(n.substr(0, n.find_last_of(L'.')));
            if (it.inst) { std::string d; if (MeReadAll(it.file, d)) { size_t p = d.find("parent\t"); if (p != std::string::npos) it.parent = d.substr(p + 7, d.find('\n', p) - p - 7); } }
            g_meLib.push_back(it);
        } while (FindNextFileW(f, &fd));
        FindClose(f);
    }
    std::sort(g_meLib.begin(), g_meLib.end(), [](const MeLibItem& a, const MeLibItem& b) { return a.inst != b.inst ? !a.inst : W2U(Lower(U2W(a.name))) < W2U(Lower(U2W(b.name))); });
}
static bool MeWriteFile(const std::wstring& f, const std::string& o) {
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(f.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;
    DWORD w = 0; bool ok = WriteFile(h, o.data(), (DWORD)o.size(), &w, nullptr) && w == o.size(); CloseHandle(h); return ok;
}
// the graph as a standalone material (the object's own settings nodes come along as ordinary nodes)
static std::string MeAssetText() {
    std::string o = "UEMAT 1\n" + MePropsLine(M.props);
    for (auto& n : M.nodes) if (!n.output && n.kind != MEK_MAT) { MeNode k = n; o += MeNodeLine(k); }
    for (auto& kv : M.nin) o += "i\t" + std::to_string(kv.first / 64) + "\t" + std::to_string(kv.first % 64) + "\t" + std::to_string(kv.second.first) + "\t" + std::to_string(kv.second.second) + "\n";
    for (auto& l : M.links) if (MeIsStd(l.first)) o += "s\t" + std::to_string(l.first - M.stdStart) + "\t" + std::to_string(l.second) + "\t" + std::to_string(M.linkOut.count(l.first) ? M.linkOut[l.first] : 0) + "\n";
    return o;
}
static bool MeParseAsset(const std::string& d, MeCustom& c) {
    if (d.rfind("UEMAT", 0) != 0) return false;
    std::istringstream ss(d); std::string line;
    while (std::getline(ss, line)) {
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        auto t = MeTabs(line); MeNode n;
        if (MeParseNode(t, n)) c.nodes.push_back(n);
        else if (MeParseProps(t, c.props)) c.hasProps = true;
        else if (t.size() >= 5 && t[0] == "i") c.nin[MeInKey(atoi(t[1].c_str()), atoi(t[2].c_str()))] = { atoi(t[3].c_str()), atoi(t[4].c_str()) };
        else if (t.size() >= 4 && t[0] == "s") c.std[atoi(t[1].c_str())] = { atoi(t[2].c_str()), atoi(t[3].c_str()) };
    }
    return true;
}
static bool MeSaveAssetAs(const std::wstring& f) {
    MakeDirs(MeLibDir());
    if (!MeWriteFile(f, MeAssetText())) { g_toasts.push_back({ "Couldn't save " + W2U(f), true, GetTickCount64() }); return false; }
    g_meLibLoaded = false;
    return true;
}
// add an asset's nodes to the graph now open (to the left of everything), wired into the Unreal inputs as saved
static void MeMergeAsset(const MeCustom& c, bool replaceStd) {
    float minX = 0; for (auto& n : M.nodes) minX = std::min(minX, n.x);
    float ax = 1e9f, ay = 1e9f, bx = -1e9f; for (auto& n : c.nodes) { ax = std::min(ax, n.x); ay = std::min(ay, n.y); bx = std::max(bx, n.x + MeNodeW(n)); }
    float dx = M.slots.empty() ? 0 : (minX - 80) - bx, dy = M.slots.empty() ? 0 : -ay;
    std::map<int, int> idMap;
    for (auto& n : c.nodes) { MeNode k = n; k.id = M.nextId++; k.x += dx; k.y += dy; idMap[n.id] = k.id; if (k.kind == MEK_COMMENT) M.nodes.insert(M.nodes.begin(), k); else M.nodes.push_back(k); }
    for (auto& kv : c.nin) { int a = (int)(kv.first / 64), in = (int)(kv.first % 64); if (idMap.count(a) && idMap.count(kv.second.first)) M.nin[MeInKey(idMap[a], in)] = { idMap[kv.second.first], kv.second.second }; }
    for (auto& kv : c.std) if (idMap.count(kv.second.first) && kv.first < STD_N) {
        int pin = M.stdStart + kv.first;
        if (!replaceStd && M.links.count(pin)) continue;
        M.links[pin] = idMap[kv.second.first]; M.linkOut[pin] = kv.second.second;
    }
    if (c.hasProps) M.props = c.props;
    MeStdChanged(); M.fitted = false;
}
// ---- opening an asset on its own: the output node has only Unreal's inputs
static void MatEdClose();
static void MeOpenAsset(const std::wstring& file) {
    std::string d; MeCustom c;
    if (!MeReadAll(file, d) || !MeParseAsset(d, c)) { g_toasts.push_back({ "Couldn't open " + W2U(file), true, GetTickCount64() }); return; }
    if (M.open) MatEdClose();
    M.open = true; M.actor.clear(); M.asset = file; M.dirty = false; M.slots.clear(); M.cur = 0; M.loaded = true; M.err.clear(); M.name.clear(); M.model.clear();
    M.nodes.clear(); M.links.clear(); M.linkOut.clear(); M.nin.clear(); M.pins.clear(); M.pend.clear(); M.selSet.clear(); M.sel = -1; M.builtKey.clear();
    M.stdStart = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < STD_N; k++) { MeParam sp; sp.kind = MEK_STD; sp.name = g_meStd[k]; M.pins.push_back(sp); }
    MeNode out; out.id = M.nextId++; out.output = true; M.nodes.push_back(out);
    M.props = MeProps();
    MeMergeAsset(c, true);
    M.builtFor = 0; M.fitted = false; M.tab = g_meInst.empty() ? 0 : 2;
    MeHistoryReset();
    g_meOverride.clear();
    // (the editor window: big, as for an object's material)
    if (g_edWnd && !M.resized) {
        GetWindowRect(g_edWnd, &M.oldRect);
        HMONITOR mon = MonitorFromWindow(g_edWnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST); MONITORINFO mi{ sizeof mi }; GetMonitorInfoW(mon, &mi);
        RECT wa = mi.rcWork;
        int w = std::min<int>(wa.right - wa.left - 40, (int)Px(1500)), h = std::min<int>(wa.bottom - wa.top - 40, (int)Px(900));
        SetWindowPos(g_edWnd, nullptr, wa.left + 20, wa.top + 20, w, h, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
        M.resized = true;
    }
}
static void MeSaveAsset() {
    if (M.asset.empty()) return;
    if (MeSaveAssetAs(M.asset)) { M.dirty = false; g_toasts.push_back({ "Saved " + W2U(M.asset.substr(M.asset.find_last_of(L"\\/") + 1)), false, GetTickCount64() }); }
}
static std::wstring MeFreeLibName(const std::string& base, const wchar_t* ext) {
    MakeDirs(MeLibDir());
    std::wstring b = MeSafeName(base), p = MeLibDir() + L"\\" + b + ext;
    for (int i = 2; FileExists(p); i++) p = MeLibDir() + L"\\" + b + L" " + std::to_wstring(i) + ext;
    return p;
}
static void MeNewAsset() {
    std::wstring f = MeFreeLibName("M_NewMaterial", L".uemat");
    std::string o = "UEMAT 1\n" + MePropsLine(MeProps());
    // a starting point like Unreal's: a Vector Parameter into Base Color, a Scalar into Roughness
    MeNode a; a.id = 1; a.kind = MEK_VEC; a.name = "BaseColor"; a.value = "0.8000,0.8000,0.8000,1.0000"; a.x = -320; a.y = 20;
    MeNode b; b.id = 2; b.kind = MEK_SCA; b.name = "Roughness"; b.value = "0.5000"; b.x = -320; b.y = 160;
    o += MeNodeLine(a) + MeNodeLine(b) + "s\t" + std::to_string(STD_BASE) + "\t1\t0\ns\t" + std::to_string(STD_ROUGH) + "\t2\t0\n";
    if (!MeWriteFile(f, o)) { g_toasts.push_back({ "Couldn't create a material in " + W2U(MeLibDir()), true, GetTickCount64() }); return; }
    g_meLibLoaded = false; g_meInst.clear();
    MeOpenAsset(f);
}
// ---- instances
static void MeSaveInstance() {
    if (g_meInst.empty() || M.asset.empty()) return;
    std::string o = "UEMI 1\nparent\t" + W2U(M.asset.substr(M.asset.find_last_of(L"\\/") + 1)) + "\n";
    for (auto& kv : g_meOverride) o += "ov\t" + MeEsc(kv.first) + "\t" + kv.second + "\n";
    if (MeWriteFile(g_meInst, o)) g_toasts.push_back({ "Saved " + W2U(g_meInst.substr(g_meInst.find_last_of(L"\\/") + 1)), false, GetTickCount64() });
    g_meLibLoaded = false;
}
static void MeOpenInstance(const std::wstring& file) {
    std::string d; if (!MeReadAll(file, d) || d.rfind("UEMI", 0) != 0) { g_toasts.push_back({ "Couldn't open " + W2U(file), true, GetTickCount64() }); return; }
    std::string parent; std::map<std::string, std::string> ov;
    std::istringstream ss(d); std::string line;
    while (std::getline(ss, line)) {
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        auto t = MeTabs(line);
        if (t.size() >= 2 && t[0] == "parent") parent = t[1];
        else if (t.size() >= 3 && t[0] == "ov") ov[MeUnesc(t[1])] = t[2];
    }
    std::wstring pf = MeLibDir() + L"\\" + U2W(parent);
    if (!FileExists(pf)) { g_toasts.push_back({ "Its parent material " + parent + " isn't in the library", true, GetTickCount64() }); return; }
    g_meInst = file;
    MeOpenAsset(pf);
    g_meOverride = ov; M.tab = 2;
}
static void MeNewInstance() {
    if (M.asset.empty()) return;
    std::string base = W2U(M.asset.substr(M.asset.find_last_of(L"\\/") + 1)); base = base.substr(0, base.find_last_of('.'));
    if (base.rfind("M_", 0) == 0) base = base.substr(2);
    if (M.dirty) MeSaveAsset();
    std::wstring parent = M.asset;
    g_meInst = MeFreeLibName("MI_" + base, L".uemi");
    g_meOverride.clear(); MeSaveInstance();
    M.tab = 2;
}
// the parameters of the material, for the instance editor (unique by name, like Unreal)
static void MeInstancePanel() {
    if (g_meInst.empty()) {
        EdLabel("A material instance changes this material's parameters without changing its graph.");
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(M.asset.empty());
        if (AccentButton(ICON_PLUS "  Create a Material Instance of this material")) MeNewInstance();
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        if (M.asset.empty()) EdLabel("(save this graph as a material asset first: File > Save as material asset)");
        return;
    }
    ImGui::PushFont(F_h2); ImGui::TextUnformatted(W2U(g_meInst.substr(g_meInst.find_last_of(L"\\/") + 1)).c_str()); ImGui::PopFont();
    EdLabel(("Parent: " + W2U(M.asset.substr(M.asset.find_last_of(L"\\/") + 1))).c_str());
    std::map<std::string, MeNode*> params;
    for (auto& n : M.nodes) if (MeIsParam(n) && !params.count(n.name)) params[n.name] = &n;
    if (params.empty()) { ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0); EdLabel("The parent has no parameters. Turn a Constant, Constant Vector or Texture Sample into a parameter (its Details) to change it here."); ImGui::PopTextWrapPos(); }
    g_meLabelW = std::min(Px(170), ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.4f);
    bool ch = false;
    for (auto& kv : params) {
        MeNode& n = *kv.second;
        ImGui::PushID(kv.first.c_str());
        bool on = g_meOverride.count(kv.first) > 0;
        if (ImGui::Checkbox("##ov", &on)) { if (on) g_meOverride[kv.first] = n.value; else g_meOverride.erase(kv.first); ch = true; }
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered()) ImGui::SetTooltip("Override the parent's value");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(!on);
        std::string v = on ? g_meOverride[kv.first] : n.value;
        ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding(); ImGui::TextUnformatted(kv.first.c_str()); ImGui::SameLine(g_meLabelW + Px(30)); ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
        if (n.kind == MEK_SCA) { float f = (float)atof(v.c_str()); if (ImGui::DragFloat("##v", &f, 0.005f, 0, 0, "%.3f")) { char t[32]; snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%.4f", f); g_meOverride[kv.first] = t; ch = true; } }
        else if (n.kind == MEK_VEC) { float c[4]; MeColour(v, c); if (ImGui::ColorEdit4("##v", c, ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float | ImGuiColorEditFlags_HDR)) { char t[96]; snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f", c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]); g_meOverride[kv.first] = t; ch = true; } }
        else if (n.kind == MEK_TEX) {
            ImVec2 p = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos(); float s = Px(48);
            MeTexBox(ImGui::GetWindowDrawList(), v, p, ImVec2(p.x + s, p.y + s), Px(3)); ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(s, s)); ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::BeginGroup();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(v.rfind("file:", 0) == 0 ? MeFileName(v).c_str() : MeShort(v).c_str());
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Texture library...")) { g_txPickNode = -2; g_txPickOpen = true; g_meInstTexParam = kv.first; if (!g_txLoaded) TxReload(); }
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Picture file...")) { std::string pn = kv.first; OvBrowse(L"Pictures (*.png, *.jpg, *.tga, *.bmp)\0*.png;*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.tga;*.bmp\0", L"A texture for the parameter", ImpStartDir(), false, L"", nullptr, [pn](std::wstring f) { if (!f.empty()) g_meOverride[pn] = "file:" + W2U(f); }); }
            ImGui::EndGroup();
        }
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    if (ch) MeStdChanged();
    ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, Px(8)));
    if (AccentButton(ICON_FLOPPY "  Save instance")) MeSaveInstance();
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::Button("Close instance (edit the parent)")) { g_meInst.clear(); g_meOverride.clear(); M.tab = 0; }
}

// ---- export
static void MeExportShader() {
    MsCompiled c = MsGenerate();
    std::string base = !M.asset.empty() ? W2U(M.asset.substr(M.asset.find_last_of(L"\\/") + 1)) : (M.cur < (int)M.slots.size() ? MeShort(M.slots[M.cur].mat) : "material");
    base = base.substr(0, base.find_last_of('.') == std::string::npos ? base.size() : base.find_last_of('.'));
    std::string text = c.hlsl;
    OvBrowse(L"HLSL shader (*.hlsl)\0*.hlsl\0", L"Export the shader code", L"", true, MeSafeName(base), L"hlsl", [text](std::wstring f) {
        if (f.empty()) return;
        bool ok = MeWriteFile(f, text);
        g_toasts.push_back({ ok ? "Exported the shader to " + W2U(f) : "Couldn't write " + W2U(f), !ok, GetTickCount64() });
    });
}
// bake every Unreal input into textures in a folder you pick (the same textures the game gets)
static void MeExportBaked() {
    MgProg P; std::string made;
    if (!MgCompile(P, made)) { g_toasts.push_back({ "Nothing is wired into Base Color, Normal, Roughness... to bake", true, GetTickCount64() }); return; }
    std::string base = !M.asset.empty() ? W2U(M.asset.substr(M.asset.find_last_of(L"\\/") + 1)) : (M.cur < (int)M.slots.size() ? MeShort(M.slots[M.cur].mat) : "material");
    base = base.substr(0, base.find_last_of('.') == std::string::npos ? base.size() : base.find_last_of('.'));
    int res = M.bakeRes;
    OvBrowse(L"PNG (*.png)\0*.png\0", L"Export baked textures (one PNG per input: _basecolor, _normal, _orm...)", L"", true, MeSafeName(base), L"png", [P, made, res](std::wstring f) {
        if (f.empty()) return;
        std::wstring prefix = f; if (Lower(prefix).size() > 4 && Lower(prefix).substr(prefix.size() - 4) == L".png") prefix = prefix.substr(0, prefix.size() - 4);
        std::thread([P, made, res, prefix]() { MgBake(P, made, res, prefix, ""); }).detach();
    });
}
// ---- applying: a material asset (or instance) onto an object's material slot
static void MeLoadAssetIntoSlot(const std::wstring& file) {
    std::string d; MeCustom c;
    std::map<std::string, std::string> ov; std::wstring f = file;
    if (Lower(file).size() > 5 && Lower(file).substr(file.size() - 5) == L".uemi") {     // an instance: its parent, with its values written in
        if (!MeReadAll(file, d)) return;
        std::istringstream ss(d); std::string line, parent;
        while (std::getline(ss, line)) { if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back(); auto t = MeTabs(line); if (t.size() >= 2 && t[0] == "parent") parent = t[1]; else if (t.size() >= 3 && t[0] == "ov") ov[MeUnesc(t[1])] = t[2]; }
        f = MeLibDir() + L"\\" + U2W(parent);
    }
    if (!MeReadAll(f, d) || !MeParseAsset(d, c)) { g_toasts.push_back({ "Couldn't read " + W2U(f), true, GetTickCount64() }); return; }
    for (auto& n : c.nodes) if (MeIsParam(n) && ov.count(n.name)) n.value = ov[n.name];
    MeMergeAsset(c, true);
    MeAutoArrange();
}
static void MeApplyAssetToSelected() {
    if (M.asset.empty()) return;
    if (g_ed.sel.empty()) { g_toasts.push_back({ "Select an object in the game (or the Outliner) first", true, GetTickCount64() }); return; }
    if (M.dirty) MeSaveAsset();
    std::wstring what = g_meInst.empty() ? M.asset : g_meInst;
    if (!g_meInst.empty()) MeSaveInstance();
    std::string actor = g_ed.sel;
    g_meInst.clear(); g_meOverride.clear();
    M.asset.clear(); M.resized = false; M.open = false;
    MatEdOpen(actor);
    g_mePendingAsset = what; g_mePendingBake = true;
}
// once the object's graph is built: put the waiting asset in and bake it
static void MePendingStep() {
    if (g_mePendingAsset.empty() || !M.loaded || M.slots.empty() || M.builtFor != M.cur) return;
    MeLoadAssetIntoSlot(g_mePendingAsset);
    g_mePendingAsset.clear();
    if (g_mePendingBake) { g_mePendingBake = false; MeStartBake(); }
}
// the File menu's "Load material from the library" list
static void MeLibraryMenu(bool forSlot) {
    if (!g_meLibLoaded) MeLibReload();
    if (g_meLib.empty()) { EdLabel("(the library is empty)"); return; }
    for (auto& it : g_meLib) {
        std::string l = std::string(it.inst ? ICON_SLIDERS "  " : ICON_CUBE "  ") + it.name + (it.inst ? "   (instance of " + it.parent + ")" : "");
        if (ImGui::MenuItem(l.c_str())) {
            if (forSlot) MeLoadAssetIntoSlot(it.file);
            else if (it.inst) MeOpenInstance(it.file); else { g_meInst.clear(); MeOpenAsset(it.file); }
        }
    }
}
// the texture editor needs the material editor open: an empty material to start with if nothing is open
static void MeNewAssetOrBlank() {
    if (!g_meLibLoaded) MeLibReload();
    for (auto& it : g_meLib) if (!it.inst) { MeOpenAsset(it.file); return; }
    MeNewAsset();
}
// ---- Content Browser: the material library

                                           : "Double-click to open in the material editor. Select an object in the game, then use Apply to object in the editor.");

```

`mgedit.inc`:

```inc
// ---- Material graph editing: undo / redo, copy / paste, the node library (palette), live node previews,
// automatic arrangement. (Included by mated.inc, after the graph's data and before the canvas.)


// ---- undo / redo: the whole graph is kept after every change (they're small)
struct MeState { std::vector<MeNode> nodes; std::map<int, int> links, linkOut; std::map<long long, std::pair<int, int>> nin; MeProps props; };
static std::vector<MeState> g_meUndo, g_meRedo;
static MeState g_meLast; static std::string g_meLastKey; static bool g_meHaveLast = false;
static std::string MeStateKey(const MeState& s) {
    std::string k = MePropsLine(s.props);
    for (auto& n : s.nodes) k += MeNodeLine(n);
    for (auto& l : s.links) k += "l" + std::to_string(l.first) + "," + std::to_string(l.second) + "," + std::to_string(s.linkOut.count(l.first) ? s.linkOut.at(l.first) : 0) + ";";
    for (auto& kv : s.nin) k += "i" + std::to_string(kv.first) + "," + std::to_string(kv.second.first) + "," + std::to_string(kv.second.second) + ";";
    return k;
}
static MeState MeCapture() { MeState s; s.nodes = M.nodes; s.links = M.links; s.linkOut = M.linkOut; s.nin = M.nin; s.props = M.props; return s; }
static void MeHistoryReset() { g_meUndo.clear(); g_meRedo.clear(); g_meHaveLast = false; }
// what a setting of the material gets from the graph (its node's value, or the material's own when nothing feeds it)
static std::string MePinValue(const MeState& s, int pin) {
    auto it = s.links.find(pin);
    if (it == s.links.end()) return M.pins[pin].kind == MEK_MAT ? "" : M.pins[pin].orig;
    for (auto& n : s.nodes) if (n.id == it->second) return MeParamValue(n);
    return M.pins[pin].orig;
}
// once a frame, when nothing is being dragged: if the graph changed since last time, that's one step to undo
static void MeHistoryTrack() {
    if (ImGui::IsMouseDown(ImGuiMouseButton_Left) || ImGui::GetIO().WantTextInput || ImGui::IsAnyItemActive()) return;
    MeState cur = MeCapture(); std::string key = MeStateKey(cur);
    if (!g_meHaveLast) { g_meLast = cur; g_meLastKey = key; g_meHaveLast = true; return; }
    if (key == g_meLastKey) return;
    g_meUndo.push_back(std::move(g_meLast)); if (g_meUndo.size() > 200) g_meUndo.erase(g_meUndo.begin());
    g_meRedo.clear();
    g_meLast = std::move(cur); g_meLastKey = key;
    if (!M.asset.empty()) M.dirty = true;
}
static void MeRestore(const MeState& s) {
    MeState before = MeCapture();
    M.nodes = s.nodes; M.links = s.links; M.linkOut = s.linkOut; M.nin = s.nin; M.props = s.props;
    M.selSet.clear(); if (!MeFind(M.sel)) M.sel = -1;
    // the material's own settings follow the graph back
    for (int i = 0; i < M.stdStart && i < (int)M.pins.size(); i++) if (MePinValue(before, i) != MePinValue(s, i)) MeSend(i, MePinValue(s, i), true);
    MeStdChanged();
    g_meLast = s; g_meLastKey = MeStateKey(s); g_meHaveLast = true;
}
static void MeUndo() { if (g_meUndo.empty()) return; g_meRedo.push_back(MeCapture()); MeState s = g_meUndo.back(); g_meUndo.pop_back(); MeRestore(s); if (!M.asset.empty()) M.dirty = true; }
static void MeRedo() { if (g_meRedo.empty()) return; g_meUndo.push_back(MeCapture()); MeState s = g_meRedo.back(); g_meRedo.pop_back(); MeRestore(s); if (!M.asset.empty()) M.dirty = true; }

// ---- selection
static bool MeSelected(int id) { return M.sel == id || M.selSet.count(id) > 0; }
static std::vector<int> MeSelection() {
    std::set<int> s = M.selSet; if (M.sel >= 0) s.insert(M.sel);
    std::vector<int> v; for (int id : s) if (MeNode* n = MeFind(id)) if (!n->output) v.push_back(id);
    return v;
}
static void MeSelectOnly(int id) { M.selSet.clear(); M.sel = id; if (id >= 0) M.selSet.insert(id); }
static void MeDeleteSelected() { for (int id : MeSelection()) MeDeleteNode(id); M.selSet.clear(); M.sel = -1; }

// ---- copy / paste (as text on the clipboard, so a graph can go from one material to another)
static std::string MeCopyText(const std::vector<int>& ids) {
    std::set<int> in(ids.begin(), ids.end());
    std::string o = "UEGRAPHCLIP 1\n";
    for (int id : ids) if (MeNode* n = MeFind(id)) if (!n->output) o += MeNodeLine(*n);
    for (auto& kv : M.nin) if (in.count((int)(kv.first / 64)) && in.count(kv.second.first))
        o += "i\t" + std::to_string(kv.first / 64) + "\t" + std::to_string(kv.first % 64) + "\t" + std::to_string(kv.second.first) + "\t" + std::to_string(kv.second.second) + "\n";
    return o;
}
static void MeCopy() { auto ids = MeSelection(); if (!ids.empty()) ImGui::SetClipboardText(MeCopyText(ids).c_str()); }
// pasted around a point of the graph
static bool MePasteText(const std::string& text, float gx, float gy) {
    if (text.rfind("UEGRAPHCLIP", 0) != 0) return false;
    std::istringstream ss(text); std::string line; std::vector<MeNode> nodes; std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> ins;
    while (std::getline(ss, line)) {
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        auto t = MeTabs(line); MeNode n;
        if (MeParseNode(t, n)) nodes.push_back(n); else if (t.size() >= 5 && t[0] == "i") ins.push_back(t);
    }
    if (nodes.empty()) return false;
    float x0 = 1e9f, y0 = 1e9f; for (auto& n : nodes) { x0 = std::min(x0, n.x); y0 = std::min(y0, n.y); }
    std::map<int, int> idMap; M.selSet.clear();
    for (auto& n : nodes) {
        if (n.kind == MEK_MAT && M.slots.empty()) continue;
        MeNode k = n; k.id = M.nextId++; k.x = gx + (n.x - x0); k.y = gy + (n.y - y0); k.output = false;
        idMap[n.id] = k.id; M.nodes.push_back(k); M.selSet.insert(k.id); M.sel = k.id;
    }
    for (auto& t : ins) {
        int a = atoi(t[1].c_str()), in = atoi(t[2].c_str()), s = atoi(t[3].c_str()), o = atoi(t[4].c_str());
        if (idMap.count(a) && idMap.count(s)) M.nin[MeInKey(idMap[a], in)] = { idMap[s], o };
    }
    MeStdChanged();
    return true;
}
static void MeDuplicate() {
    auto ids = MeSelection(); if (ids.empty()) return;
    float x0 = 1e9f, y0 = 1e9f; for (int id : ids) if (MeNode* n = MeFind(id)) { x0 = std::min(x0, n->x); y0 = std::min(y0, n->y); }
    MePasteText(MeCopyText(ids), x0 + 40, y0 + 40);
}

// ---- comments (boxes around nodes, with a title)
static const unsigned g_meCommentCols[] = { 0x3C5A78u, 0x4E6A3Cu, 0x7A5A2Cu, 0x6A3C5Au, 0x5A5A5Au, 0x2C6A6Au };
static int MeAddComment(float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& text) {
    MeNode n; n.id = M.nextId++; n.kind = MEK_COMMENT; n.x = x; n.y = y; n.w = std::max(160.f, w); n.h = std::max(90.f, h); n.name = text; n.col = g_meCommentCols[0];
    M.nodes.insert(M.nodes.begin(), n);              // (comments are drawn behind everything)
    MeSelectOnly(n.id);
    return n.id;
}
static float MeNodeW(const MeNode& n); static float MeNodeH(const MeNode& n);
static void MeCommentAroundSelection() {
    auto ids = MeSelection();
    float x0 = 1e9f, y0 = 1e9f, x1 = -1e9f, y1 = -1e9f; int count = 0;
    for (int id : ids) if (MeNode* n = MeFind(id)) if (n->kind != MEK_COMMENT) { x0 = std::min(x0, n->x); y0 = std::min(y0, n->y); x1 = std::max(x1, n->x + MeNodeW(*n)); y1 = std::max(y1, n->y + MeNodeH(*n)); count++; }
    if (!count) return;
    MeAddComment(x0 - 30, y0 - 60, x1 - x0 + 60, y1 - y0 + 90, "Comment");
}

// ---- the node library (Unreal's Palette): everything that can be added, by category

static const struct { const char* name; int from, to; } g_mePalCats[] = {
    { "Constants and parameters", 0, 5 }, { "Textures", 5, 7 }, { "Coordinates", 7, 11 }, { "Math", 11, 31 }, { "Utility", 31, 37 },
    { "Vectors", 37, 40 }, { "Material", 40, 41 }, { "Comments", 41, 42 } };
static const char* MePalHelp(const MePalItem& it) { return it.help ? it.help : it.kind == MEK_OP ? g_meOpHelp[it.op] : ""; }
// a node from the library, at a point of the graph
static void MeOpenPicker(int which, int node); static void MePickFile(int node);
static int MeAddFromPalette(int i, float gx, float gy) {
    const MePalItem& it = g_mePal[i];
    if (it.kind == MEK_COMMENT) return MeAddComment(gx, gy, 400, 240, "Comment");
    if (it.kind == MEK_MAT && M.slots.empty()) return -1;
    int id = MeAddNode(it.kind, gx, gy, "", it.op);
    if (MeNode* n = MeFind(id)) {
        if (it.param) {                                // a name nobody else has
            std::string base = it.param, nm = base; int k = 1;
            for (;;) { bool used = false; for (auto& o : M.nodes) if (o.id != id && o.name == nm) used = true; if (!used) break; nm = base + std::to_string(++k); }
            n->name = nm;
        }
        if (it.kind == MEK_VEC && !it.param) n->value = "1.0000,1.0000,1.0000,1.0000";
        if (it.kind == MEK_SCA) n->value = it.param ? "0.5000" : "1.0000";
    }
    MeSelectOnly(id);
    if (it.kind == MEK_MAT) MeOpenPicker(2, id);
    MeStdChanged();
    return id;
}
static bool MePalMatches(int i, const std::string& f) {
    if (f.empty()) return true;
    std::string l = W2U(Lower(U2W(g_mePal[i].label))), h = W2U(Lower(U2W(MePalHelp(g_mePal[i]))));
    return l.find(f) != std::string::npos || h.find(f) != std::string::npos;
}
// the Palette panel: search, then the library by category; drag a node onto the graph (or double-click it)
static void MeTextureLibraryItems();
static void MePalettePanel() {
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
    ImGui::InputTextWithHint("##palf", ICON_SEARCH "  Search nodes", M.palFilter, sizeof M.palFilter);
    std::string f = W2U(Lower(U2W(M.palFilter)));
    ImGui::BeginChild("##pallist", ImVec2(0, 0));
    for (auto& cat : g_mePalCats) {
        bool any = false; for (int i = cat.from; i < cat.to; i++) if (MePalMatches(i, f)) any = true;
        if (!any) continue;
        if (cat.from == 40 && M.slots.empty()) continue;
        ImGui::SetNextItemOpen(true, f.empty() ? ImGuiCond_Once : ImGuiCond_Always);
        if (!ImGui::CollapsingHeader(cat.name)) continue;
        for (int i = cat.from; i < cat.to; i++) {
            if (!MePalMatches(i, f)) continue;
            ImGui::PushID(i);
            ImGui::Selectable(g_mePal[i].label, false, ImGuiSelectableFlags_AllowDoubleClick);
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered() && ImGui::IsMouseDoubleClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Left)) M.dragNew = "pal:" + std::to_string(i) + ":centre";
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered() && *MePalHelp(g_mePal[i])) ImGui::SetTooltip("%s\n\nDrag it onto the graph, or double-click", MePalHelp(g_mePal[i]));
            if (ImGui::BeginDragDropSource()) {
                ImGui::SetDragDropPayload("MENODE", &i, sizeof i);
                ImGui::TextUnformatted(g_mePal[i].label);
                ImGui::EndDragDropSource();
            }
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
    }
    // textures from the texture library, ready to drop in
    MeTextureLibraryItems();
    ImGui::EndChild();
}

// ---- live node previews: each maths node shows what it makes, worked out on a small square in the background
struct MePrevPic { ID3D11ShaderResourceView* srv = nullptr; };
static std::map<int, MePrevPic> g_mePrev;
static std::mutex g_mePrevMx; static std::map<int, std::vector<unsigned char>> g_mePrevDone; static std::atomic<bool> g_mePrevBusy{ false };
static std::string g_mePrevKey; static bool g_meNodePreviews = true;
static const int ME_PREV = 48;
static void MePreviewsUpdate() {
    if (!g_meNodePreviews) return;
    // finished pictures -> textures
    {
        std::map<int, std::vector<unsigned char>> done;
        { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mePrevMx); done.swap(g_mePrevDone); }
        for (auto& kv : done) {
            MePrevPic& p = g_mePrev[kv.first]; MsRel(p.srv);
            D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC d{}; d.Width = d.Height = ME_PREV; d.MipLevels = 1; d.ArraySize = 1; d.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM; d.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
            d.Usage = D3D11_USAGE_IMMUTABLE; d.BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE;
            D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA sd{ kv.second.data(), ME_PREV * 4, 0 }; ID3D11Texture2D* t = nullptr;
            if (g_dev && SUCCEEDED(g_dev->CreateTexture2D(&d, &sd, &t))) { g_dev->CreateShaderResourceView(t, nullptr, &p.srv); t->Release(); }
        }
    }
    if (g_mePrevBusy) return;
    static ULONGLONG last = 0; if (GetTickCount64() - last < 250) return; last = GetTickCount64();
    std::string key; for (auto& n : M.nodes) key += MeNodeLine(n) + MeParamValue(n);
    for (auto& kv : M.nin) key += std::to_string(kv.first) + ">" + std::to_string(kv.second.first) + "," + std::to_string(kv.second.second) + ";";
    if (key == g_mePrevKey) return;
    g_mePrevKey = key;
    MgProg P; std::map<int, int> idx; P.paks = PaksDir();
    std::vector<int> want;
    for (auto& n : M.nodes) if (n.kind == MEK_OP) { if (MgAddNode(P, idx, n.id) >= 0) want.push_back(n.id); }
    if (want.empty()) return;
    std::map<int, int> place; for (int id : want) place[id] = idx[id];
    g_mePrevBusy = true;
    std::thread([P, place]() mutable {
        if (g_mgSrgbLut[255] == 0) for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) g_mgSrgbLut[i] = (float)(i / 255.0 <= 0.04045 ? i / 255.0 / 12.92 : pow((i / 255.0 + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4));
        for (auto& n : P.n) if (n.kind == MEK_TEX) n.img = MgLoadImg(n.tex, P.paks);
        std::map<int, std::vector<unsigned char>> out;
        for (auto& kv : place) out[kv.first].assign(ME_PREV * ME_PREV * 4, 255);
        std::vector<MgV> val(P.n.size());
        for (int y = 0; y < ME_PREV; y++) for (int x = 0; x < ME_PREV; x++) {
            MgEvalPixel(P, (x + 0.5f) / ME_PREV, (y + 0.5f) / ME_PREV, val);
            for (auto& kv : place) {
                const MgV& v = val[kv.second]; unsigned char* o = &out[kv.first][(y * ME_PREV + x) * 4];
                float c[3];
                if (v.n == 1) c[0] = c[1] = c[2] = v.v[0];
                else for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) c[k] = k < v.n ? v.v[k] : 0.f;
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) o[k] = (unsigned char)lround(MgToSrgb(c[k]) * 255);
                o[3] = 255;
            }
        }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mePrevMx); for (auto& kv : out) g_mePrevDone[kv.first] = std::move(kv.second);
        g_mePrevBusy = false; g_framesLeft = 3;
    }).detach();
}
static ID3D11ShaderResourceView* MePreviewOf(int id) { auto it = g_mePrev.find(id); return it == g_mePrev.end() ? nullptr : it->second.srv; }

// ---- automatic arrangement: columns by how far a node is from the output, ordered so wires cross less
static void MeArrangeLayered() {
    MeNode* out = MeOutput(); if (!out) return;
    std::map<int, int> depth;                  // node id -> column (1 = feeds the output directly)
    std::function<void(int, int)> walk = [&](int id, int d) {
        if (d > 60) return;
        auto it = depth.find(id); if (it != depth.end() && it->second >= d) return;
        depth[id] = d;
        for (auto& kv : M.nin) if ((int)(kv.first / 64) == id) walk(kv.second.first, d + 1);
    };
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)M.pins.size(); i++) { auto it = M.links.find(i); if (it != M.links.end()) walk(it->second, 1); }
    int maxD = 1; for (auto& kv : depth) maxD = std::max(maxD, kv.second);
    std::vector<int> loose; for (auto& n : M.nodes) if (!n.output && n.kind != MEK_COMMENT && !depth.count(n.id)) loose.push_back(n.id);
    // order inside a column: by the place of what they feed (the output's pin, or the node they plug into)
    std::map<int, float> key;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)M.pins.size(); i++) { auto it = M.links.find(i); if (it != M.links.end() && !key.count(it->second)) key[it->second] = (float)i; }
    out->x = 0; out->y = 0;
    float right = -80;
    for (int d = 1; d <= maxD; d++) {
        std::vector<MeNode*> col;
        for (auto& n : M.nodes) if (depth.count(n.id) && depth[n.id] == d) col.push_back(&n);
        for (MeNode* n : col) if (!key.count(n->id)) {
            float best = 1e9f;
            for (auto& kv : M.nin) if (kv.second.first == n->id) { int to = (int)(kv.first / 64); if (key.count(to)) best = std::min(best, key[to] + (kv.first % 64) * 0.01f); }
            key[n->id] = best;
        }
        std::stable_sort(col.begin(), col.end(), [&](MeNode* a, MeNode* b) { return key[a->id] < key[b->id]; });
        float w = 0; for (MeNode* n : col) w = std::max(w, MeNodeW(*n));
        float y = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < col.size(); i++) { col[i]->x = right - w; col[i]->y = y; key[col[i]->id] = (float)i; y += MeNodeH(*col[i]) + 30; }
        right -= w + 90;
    }
    float y = -60; for (int id : loose) if (MeNode* n = MeFind(id)) { n->x = right - MeNodeW(*n); n->y = y; y += MeNodeH(*n) + 30; }
    M.fitted = false;
}

```

`mgshader.inc`:

```inc
// ---- Material graph -> HLSL, compiled with D3DCompile, and the real-time 3D preview (Direct3D 11, the launcher's
// own device). Everything the graph does is turned into one shader: every node becomes a float4 (with a known number
// of components, like Unreal's float1..float4), the material's inputs come out of Eval(), and the pixel shader lights
// it (metal / roughness, GGX, image-based light from the environment). The game itself can't compile shaders, so
// in the game the same graph is baked into textures (MgBake); this shader is the preview, and can be exported.
//
// Every value you can edit (numbers, colours, a maths node's constants, a texture's tiling) lives in a constant
// buffer, so changing it is instant; the shader is only rebuilt when the graph's shape changes (nodes, wires,
// textures, the material's blend mode...).
#include <d3dcompiler.h>
#include <d3d11shader.h>

static const int MS_MAX_TEX = 14;                 // t0..t13 for the graph's textures, t15 the environment
static const int MS_MAX_SLOTS = 256;              // float4 P[256] in the parameter buffer

struct MsTexSlot { int node = 0; std::string value; int sampler = 0; int filter = 0; };
struct MsCompiled {                                // what the code generator made
    std::string hlsl, key;
    std::vector<MsTexSlot> tex;
    std::map<int, int> slotOf;                     // node id -> first constant slot
    int slots = 0;
    std::vector<std::pair<int, std::string>> errs; // (node id or -1, message)
    std::vector<std::pair<int, std::string>> warns;
    MeProps props;
};
// the compiled shader, ready to draw
static struct MsShader {
    ID3D11VertexShader* vs = nullptr; ID3D11PixelShader* ps = nullptr; ID3D11InputLayout* il = nullptr;
    MsCompiled src; bool ok = false;
    std::string log;                               // the compiler's messages
    int vsInstr = 0, psInstr = 0, psTex = 0; double ms = 0;
    std::string builtKey;                          // the graph shape it was built from
} g_ms;
// compiling runs in the background (D3DCompile can take a moment); the result is picked up on the main thread
struct MsJob { MsCompiled c; ID3DBlob* vs = nullptr; ID3DBlob* ps = nullptr; std::string log; bool ok = false; double ms = 0; int vsI = 0, psI = 0, psT = 0; };
static std::mutex g_msJobMx; static std::unique_ptr<MsJob> g_msDone; static std::atomic<bool> g_msBusy{ false };
static std::string g_msWantKey; static ULONGLONG g_msWantAt = 0; static bool g_msForce = false;

// ---- code generation
struct MsGen {
    MsCompiled* out;
    std::map<int, int> n;                          // node id -> components (1..4), 0 = not made yet, -1 = being made
    std::string body;
    std::set<int> errNodes;
    int ensureSlot(int id, int count = 1) {
        auto it = out->slotOf.find(id); if (it != out->slotOf.end()) return it->second;
        int s = out->slots; out->slots += count; out->slotOf[id] = s; return s;
    }
    void err(int id, const std::string& m) { if (!errNodes.count(id)) { out->errs.push_back({ id, m }); errNodes.insert(id); } }
    static std::string P(int slot) { return "P[" + std::to_string(slot) + "]"; }
    // a value with c components, broadcast / padded the same way the CPU evaluator does
    static std::string Fit(const std::string& e, int c) {
        switch (c) { case 1: return "(" + e + ").xxxx"; case 2: return "float4((" + e + ").xy, 0, 0)"; case 3: return "float4((" + e + ").xyz, 0)"; default: return e; }
    }
    // the value going into input k of a node, as a float4 expression, and its components
    std::pair<std::string, int> in(const MeNode& node, int k, const std::string& def, int defN = 1) {
        auto it = M.nin.find(MeInKey(node.id, k));
        if (it == M.nin.end()) return { def, defN };
        MeNode* s = MeFind(it->second.first); if (!s) return { def, defN };
        int c = make(*s); if (c <= 0) return { def, defN };
        return swz(*s, it->second.second, c);
    }
    std::pair<std::string, int> swz(const MeNode& s, int outIdx, int c) {
        std::string v = "v" + std::to_string(s.id);
        if ((s.kind == MEK_TEX || s.kind == MEK_VEC) && outIdx >= 1 && outIdx <= 4) { const char* ch = "xyzw"; return { v + "." + std::string(4, ch[outIdx - 1]), 1 }; }
        if ((s.kind == MEK_TEX || s.kind == MEK_VEC) && outIdx == 0) return { "float4(" + v + ".xyz, 0)", 3 };
        return { v, c };
    }
    // emit a node (and what feeds it); returns its components
    int make(const MeNode& nd) {
        int& st = n[nd.id];
        if (st > 0) return st;
        if (st < 0) { err(nd.id, "This node feeds itself (a loop)"); return 0; }
        st = -1;
        std::string v = "v" + std::to_string(nd.id), e; int c = 1;
        auto C = [&](int k) { int s = ensureSlot(nd.id, nd.op == OP_LAYERBLEND ? 3 : 1); const char* ch = "xyzw"; return P(s) + "." + std::string(4, ch[k]); };
        auto Ck = [&](int k) { int s = ensureSlot(nd.id, nd.op == OP_LAYERBLEND ? 3 : 1); const char* ch = "xyzw"; return P(s) + "." + std::string(1, ch[k]); };
        std::string uvDef = "float4(c.uv, 0, 0)";
        if (nd.kind == MEK_SCA) { e = P(ensureSlot(nd.id)) + ".xxxx"; c = 1; }
        else if (nd.kind == MEK_VEC) { e = P(ensureSlot(nd.id)); c = 4; }
        else if (nd.kind == MEK_TEX) {
            int slot = ensureSlot(nd.id, 2);
            int t = (int)out->tex.size();
            if (t >= MS_MAX_TEX) { err(nd.id, "Too many Texture Samples (the preview can use " + std::to_string(MS_MAX_TEX) + ")"); st = 0; return 0; }
            MsTexSlot ts; ts.node = nd.id; ts.value = nd.value; ts.sampler = nd.sampler; ts.filter = nd.filter; out->tex.push_back(ts);
            if (nd.value.empty()) out->warns.push_back({ nd.id, "A Texture Sample has no texture (it reads as grey)" });
            auto uv = in(nd, 0, uvDef, 2);
            std::string uvn = "uv" + std::to_string(nd.id);
            body += "    float2 " + uvn + " = TexXf((" + uv.first + ").xy, " + P(slot) + ", " + P(slot + 1) + ".x);\n";
            std::string smp = "SMP(T" + std::to_string(t) + ", S" + std::to_string(t) + ", " + uvn + ")";
            if (nd.sampler == 1) e = "UnpackNormal(" + smp + ")";
            else e = smp;
            c = 4;
        } else if (nd.kind == MEK_OP) {
            switch (nd.op) {
            case OP_TEXCOORD: e = "float4(c.uv * " + P(ensureSlot(nd.id)) + ".xy, 0, 0)"; c = 2; break;
            case OP_ADD: case OP_SUB: case OP_MUL: case OP_DIV: case OP_MIN: case OP_MAX: {
                auto a = in(nd, 0, C(0)), b = in(nd, 1, C(1)); c = std::max(a.second, b.second);
                const char* o = nd.op == OP_ADD ? "+" : nd.op == OP_SUB ? "-" : "*";
                if (nd.op == OP_DIV) e = "SafeDiv(" + a.first + ", " + b.first + ")";
                else if (nd.op == OP_MIN) e = "min(" + a.first + ", " + b.first + ")";
                else if (nd.op == OP_MAX) e = "max(" + a.first + ", " + b.first + ")";
                else e = "(" + a.first + " " + o + " " + b.first + ")";
                break;
            }
            case OP_LERP: { auto a = in(nd, 0, C(0)), b = in(nd, 1, C(1)), t = in(nd, 2, C(2)); c = std::max(a.second, b.second);
                if (t.second > 1 && t.second != c) out->warns.push_back({ nd.id, "Lerp's Alpha has a different number of channels from A / B" });
                e = "lerp(" + a.first + ", " + b.first + ", " + (t.second == 1 ? t.first : t.first) + ")"; break; }
            case OP_ONEMINUS: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); c = a.second; e = "(1.0 - " + a.first + ")"; break; }
            case OP_POW: { auto a = in(nd, 0, C(0)), x = in(nd, 1, C(1)); c = std::max(a.second, x.second); e = "pow(max(" + a.first + ", 0.0), " + x.first + ")"; break; }
            case OP_CLAMP: { auto a = in(nd, 0, C(0)), lo = in(nd, 1, C(1)), hi = in(nd, 2, C(2)); c = a.second; e = "min(max(" + a.first + ", " + lo.first + "), " + hi.first + ")"; break; }
            case OP_DESAT: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"), f = in(nd, 1, C(1)); c = a.second;
                e = "(" + a.first + " + (dot(" + a.first + ".xyz, float3(0.3, 0.59, 0.11)).xxxx - " + a.first + ") * (" + f.first + ").x)"; break; }
            case OP_MASK: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); std::vector<std::string> comps; const char* ch = "xyzw";
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) if (nd.c[k] > 0.5f) comps.push_back("(" + a.first + ")." + std::string(1, ch[k]));
                if (comps.empty()) { err(nd.id, "Component Mask keeps no channels"); comps.push_back("0.0"); }
                c = (int)comps.size(); std::string j; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) j += (k ? ", " : "") + (k < c ? comps[k] : std::string("0.0"));
                e = "float4(" + j + ")"; break; }
            case OP_APPEND: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"), b = in(nd, 1, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); std::vector<std::string> comps; const char* ch = "xyzw";
                for (int k = 0; k < a.second; k++) comps.push_back("(" + a.first + ")." + std::string(1, ch[k]));
                for (int k = 0; k < b.second; k++) comps.push_back("(" + b.first + ")." + std::string(1, ch[k]));
                if (comps.size() > 4) { err(nd.id, "Append makes more than 4 channels (" + std::to_string(comps.size()) + ")"); comps.resize(4); }
                c = std::max(1, (int)comps.size()); std::string j; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) j += (k ? ", " : "") + (k < (int)comps.size() ? comps[k] : std::string("0.0"));
                e = "float4(" + j + ")"; break; }
            case OP_LAYERBLEND: {
                int s = ensureSlot(nd.id, 3); std::string acc = "lb" + std::to_string(nd.id), sum = "lw" + std::to_string(nd.id);
                body += "    float4 " + acc + " = 0; float " + sum + " = 0;\n"; int cc = 1;
                for (size_t l = 0; l < nd.layers.size() && l < 8; l++) {
                    auto L = in(nd, (int)(2 * l), "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); cc = std::max(cc, L.second);
                    const char* ch = "xyzw";
                    std::string wdef = P(s + 1 + (int)l / 4) + "." + std::string(1, ch[l % 4]);
                    auto W = in(nd, (int)(2 * l + 1), "(" + wdef + ").xxxx");
                    bool plugged = M.nin.count(MeInKey(nd.id, (int)(2 * l + 1))) > 0;
                    std::string w = plugged ? "saturate((" + W.first + ").x)" : "max(" + wdef + ", 0.0)";
                    body += "    { float w = " + w + "; " + acc + " += " + L.first + " * w; " + sum + " += w; }\n";
                }
                c = cc; e = "(" + sum + " > 0 ? " + acc + " / " + sum + " : 0.0.xxxx)"; break;
            }
            case OP_SATURATE: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); c = a.second; e = "saturate(" + a.first + ")"; break; }
            case OP_ABS: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); c = a.second; e = "abs(" + a.first + ")"; break; }
            case OP_FRAC: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); c = a.second; e = "frac(" + a.first + ")"; break; }
            case OP_FLOOR: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); c = a.second; e = "floor(" + a.first + ")"; break; }
            case OP_SQRT: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); c = a.second; e = "sqrt(max(" + a.first + ", 0.0))"; break; }
            case OP_SIN: case OP_COS: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); c = a.second;
                e = std::string(nd.op == OP_SIN ? "sin(" : "cos(") + a.first + " * Period(" + Ck(0) + "))"; break; }
            case OP_DOT: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"), b = in(nd, 1, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); int m = std::max(a.second, b.second);
                if (a.second > 1 && b.second > 1 && a.second != b.second) err(nd.id, "Dot: A has " + std::to_string(a.second) + " channels and B has " + std::to_string(b.second));
                e = m == 1 ? "((" + a.first + ").x * (" + b.first + ").x).xxxx" : "dot(" + Fit(a.first, m) + " * Mask" + std::to_string(m) + ", " + Fit(b.first, m) + ").xxxx"; c = 1; break; }
            case OP_NORMALIZE: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 0, 0)"); c = a.second;
                e = c == 1 ? "sign(" + a.first + ")" : "SafeNormalize(" + a.first + " * Mask" + std::to_string(c) + ")"; break; }
            case OP_FRESNEL: { auto x = in(nd, 0, C(0)), b = in(nd, 1, C(1)); c = 1;
                e = "Fresnel(c, (" + x.first + ").x, (" + b.first + ").x).xxxx"; break; }
            case OP_NORMALSTR: { auto a = in(nd, 0, "float4(0, 0, 1, 0)", 3), s = in(nd, 1, C(1)); c = 3;
                e = "float4(normalize(float3((" + a.first + ").xy * (" + s.first + ").x, (" + a.first + ").z)), 0)"; break; }
            case OP_TIME: e = "(c.time * " + Ck(0) + ").xxxx"; c = 1; break;
            case OP_PANNER: { auto uv = in(nd, 0, uvDef, 2), t = in(nd, 1, "c.time.xxxx"); c = 2;
```
